tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'od gsal nyams kyi brda sgrom las kong the'u rang gi ra rdzong phab pa 'dzam gling chos kyi rgyal po'i rtogs brjod dpal gyi be'u zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

ra byu/ / na sna gu 2 6) padma 11 dha ra dza yā: 'di la byung tshul dang dngos kyi tshul dang gnyis las da po ni bskal pa chu sbrul lo' zla tshes su 'byul sna kun gzhi'i mkha' ru bsdus nas 'od gsal gyi snang ba phyogs med du brdal ba'i skabs su gnam babs lha yi lcam mo gnyan gyi sras btsun klu yi 'dzum gsar chen mo tha le 'od dkar yin zer ba zhig dab sngon bee ḍārya ya dar 'a 'a lnga'i 'od gor gya sbubs nas byung la 'di skad gyer ā skye med chos la brda phyag 'tshal glu tha la tha rgyal tha shing lo: mtha'i rgyal khab 'khrul pa the'u rang srid: gnam chu mo sbrul lo log min du: mes sad mda' dmar mo mtha' la lhung: chu sngon mo khro zhun tshe na 'khrugs: tshe bsod nams dbang thang rlung rta rgud: dpal dam pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan bskyod: mtha'i phra min mu stegs bstan pas khyab: sngon smon log klu yi khyab 'jug des rtag chad kyi lta la lag par gnas: lha dga' byed dbang phyug srung mar 'grogs: yang nyi ma'i mig ldan rje bor gyur: yul 'dzam gling tha gru dbang du byed mi rje bo thams cad dug mtshor 'du: des ngan pa'i blo sems drag por bsgyur: bstan dgon gyi me tog ha lor 'gyur: gos gong nga'i mdzes byed gshin thang

༄༅/ / nag: dmag bsu sgras bdag po spud skabs 'dir: dpal sngags kyi bdag mo'i mchi ma 'khrugs: dpal 'dzam gling chos kyi rgyal po yis: kong the'u rangar rdzong phab pa'i tshul don 'dra ma yag gi rnam thar de shar khyung tshang spre'u'i rdzong na yod: da ma 'dug ma nyal ma yengs par: chos ka dar bstan pa yar dar phyir: dpal zlagazhon g.yu me 'bum pa khyod: gter nam mkha' mdzod 'di brda las byung : sog mi zan mgo 'phang dma' nas 'gro: krong ye min dug sprin dbus nas gtor: da dgos pache'o don med min: rang srid kyang rdo rje brag la zug: gzhan sde la gser gyi dar chen bsgreng : gtam go na snyan brgyud sems la zhog: de ma go 'khrul ba'i 'dam gting bying zhes pas bskul ba la brten nas dgongs pa chos nyid kyi don la bzhag rig gdangs rdo rje rnon po'i gzi ngar shar khyung tshang spre'u'i rdzong la gtad tsa na gnyan mo me chu rlung gi 'dab ma can zhes bya bas phyogs bzhi'i bdud po' snying khragagis bris pa'i brda shog dmar lam me ba zhig sprad nas a sngon dbyi sa kyi dkyil nas 'ja' tshon gyi gur phub bzhin du 'dra ma yag ga glu 'di 'dra zhig blangs byung ngo

oṃ dam chos ma ṇi padme /:chos mdo sngags bstan pa dar bar shog:deng nor bu go leb tshur la gson:'khor 'das gnyis stong sgog gcig pa la:khyed dgongs pa'i gziradon rten 'brel che:ngas 'dra ma yag gi rnam thar dran:bu seng chen dgra bla'i dbang phyug gis:phyogs bzhi'i dgra bdud cham la phab de'i yan lag rdzong brgyad mnga' dbang bsgyur:phrin las bzhis nor drangs nor gter bkug:don de la ya mtshan bgrang las 'das:da mi smra re zhig gu hya rgya shar tsi na'i yul nas bshol rta bskrad bco brgyad pakha che'i ra rdzong ngam:kong the'u rang ra rdzong phab pa'i tshul:don go na sangs rgyas bstan pa srung :ma go'i bu la ngo mtshar med:gling tsho drug skyid pa'i 'dun ma yin:sman na chung bu57'i gzugs legs mas:dus phyi rabs bskal pa'i 'phel 'grib 'byung :phyogs mtha' dmag gdung bas gzengs pa langs:chos sangs rgyas bstan pa'i che ba nyams yongs 'gro ba'i bde skyid dpal 'byor 'phrog rtag chad kyi lta la rab tu dril:bod mi re'i snying la 'dre re zhugs:the'u rang gi lha srung byed pa'i dus:brtan g.yo'i khams sdug

༄༅/ / pa'i dus yin pas: brda 'di tsho rgud pa gso ba'i phyir: gling spyi dpon a myes sprul pa yis: khyod dam tshig sgog la dbab tsa na ma mkha' 'gro'i brda risathob la sprod: da ma bul ma 'gyang yig ris mdzod bstan 'dzin gyi sku tshe bsring don ched: chos dgon la has grib g.ya' mi zhugs: sngags snying po'i bstan pa mdog mi'agyur: 'brog sbra nag can la phan thog 'gyur: rong shing sgo can rnams khra bor byed: rje bsod nams can gyi bsam pa 'grub: gtam de tsho go na bdud rtsi yin ma go ba'i glenapa rang ma11nga can: de dag la bka' gartsigs phyag rgyas 17mas: zhes zer nas brag dkar byang sems spre'u'i rdzong la yal song ngo phyas su mnyam bzhag 'od gsal gyi sgrom rgyar shar ba'i brda don rjes thob snangaba'i rol mtshor gdul bya'i rgud pa sel phyir gsal bar bkod pa ni na mo gu ru o rgyan mtsho gling padma'i sdong po las: rang byung sangs rgyas skye 'chi gnyis mi mnga': padma 'byung gnas dri med gangs chen mtsho'i: mngon spyod drag po'i mdzad tshul rgya

mtsho las: thigs pa tsam zhig kong the'u dzadang phab tshul legs par gsal bgyis gdul dka' 'dul bar regag: ces smon tshig gis bskul te/ rtsa ba'i sa bcad dngos kyi tshul ni/ 'dzam slongaseng chen yid bzhin nor bu dgra 'dul rtsal gyis bstan pa snga dar la ser po hor spug po 'jang nag ngo bdud khra bo mon rnams kyi lta ba log pa tshar bcad bdud dam sri'i rigs kyi dpa' bkong las smon 'phro 'dzom rnamasagling dkar po' chos la bsgyur sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gzhi bzu nyan bshad sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs gli bla ma rnams kyi thugs bzhed 'grub rgyal po rnams kyi dgo sa pa bde ma sru thams cad chos la spyod skyid pa yag ga rnam thar gter kha gong ma rnams las gsal ba ltar dang bar dar la phran las bzha'i ra/dzad pa 'i thabs mang gis sog li khri'i rdzong khag bzhi dang bal bo rgya la sogs pa 'i rdzong chen bcu gnyas mnga' dbang du bsgyur bod bsod nams kyi dpal kha bskyed lta log bon gyi bstan pa bsgrubs gsang sngags bstan pa'i sgrub sde btsugs dab chen rta mchog rol pa dngos su mi yi rdzu ru phebs pa spyi dpo na khro thung rgyal po'i tshogs rje mdzad dgong pa chosadabyingasadater la longs spyod zag med thams cad mkhyen pa 'i gling tsho drug la gye dkar ngo bde skyid la bkod skabs gur kha khra dang dgu brgya sbra sde 'bum tsho bco brgyad mkhar khag wa stong lnga bcu

ra dzi/ / gtsug lag sum brgya sum stong 'dzoms pa 'i dus skabs se chen skyes bu don 'grub chos thang padma'i ra ba chen po na 'od gsal chos nyid kyi sgrub pa chen po mdzad nas spyi bdud cham la phab nang bdud rang grol la gtong ba'i dus der dus phyi mo gdul bya'i rgud pa sel phyir gnam gong lha yi bu mo chos srid bstan pa 'i sgron me seng lcam tha le 'od dkar go sman srid pa' rgyal mo zhes bya bas sngags kyi dab phyug khro thung rgyal po'i mnyamabazhag 'od gsal gyi sgrom rgyar zhal gzigs nas 'dra ma yag gi glu 'di 'dra zhig gsungs so tsho/ ka dag stong pa chos sku'i zhing : ma rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan zhal: ṇi sa ler gsal ba rnal 'dresar ma: pad chags pas ma gos bdag la rdzogs me gdul bya'i yul la gzigs pa ngoms: hūṃ dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rje lo: da 'od gsal dgongs pa'i slong nas bzhengs: glumakha' 'gro'i brda la gsan par zhu: shar dung ri dkar po'i rtse mo na: seng dkar po g.yu ral rgyas pa de: 'di 'dzam gling skyes bu don 'grub red: don ma 'grub pa la gcig yod de: de bsgrubs na a khu khyod kyis 'grub lho gser ri'i rtse na stag zhig 'bying : de gser sde'i chos 'phan dar yag red des ma thul ba la gcig yod de: de a khu khyed

kyis btul na thul:nub zangs ri'i rtse na khyung dmar 'khyug: de sdig can shan pa rme ru red: des ma sod pa la gcig yod de: de a khu khyod kyis bskul na sod: byang g.yu ri'i rtse na lcags spyang ngar: de sras chung dgra lha rtse rgyal red: de ma grags pa la gcig yod de: de a khu khyod kyis bsgrags na grags: bya 'phur 'phur a sngon dbyings la 'phur:de 'phur rtsal ldan pa 'dan sras red:rtsal ma 'gran pa la gcig yod de:de khyod kyis bskul dang rgyal kha len:'brong rwa rtse brdar brdar byang la brdar de a stag dpa' bo'i bu mo red rwas ma phug pa la gcig yod de: de khyed kyis sbran dang 'bug nges yin: nags gzig mo'i so dang sen mo brdar: de dung skyong stag lha dkar po red so sen mos ma zin pa gcig yod: de khyed kyis bskul dang gzan du byed skyogs ngar ma'i nus mthu stobs ldan pa: de 'jang phrug thog 'gyur rtsal rgod yin: skyogs ma bzlog pa la gcig yod de: mgon khyed kyis bskul dang brlag nges yin: da rten 'brel las kyi bsdus tshig la: phyir chos nyid bden pa bskru med dang : nang rten 'byung rgyu 'bras bslu med

༄༅/ / gnyis deng zung 'jug phun tshogs gling sde yis kong the'u rang ra rdzong 'bebs par mdzod: da gzigs ldan nor bu'i bang mdzod longs: rgya 'om bu mtshal can zangs sgo phyes yul rgyal khab bcu gnyis mnga' 'og bsdus: chos ga dar bstan pas skyong bar mdzod: 'di'i dpa' rtags phu nu rnams kyis len: grags rgyal kha a khu khyed kyis rted: dpal nor bu'i dga' ston nyid la 'byor: kong bu mo bsam sgron med tog skyid: khyed bde stong lam gyi grogs mo byed: sgyu lus kyang dwangs ma 'od du zhu:lha dbang chen bzhad pa dngos su 'gyur: zhing zla gam dgu rdzogs mnga' dbang bsgyur: bu khyed dang 'dra ba gcig kyang med: rdzong nyed lnga phab pa'i lde mig yin gling mi re'i kha nas gtam re sgrog: kha cig gis bon rgan khro thung zer: re 'ga' yis nang bla phyir btsong zer: du ma yis a khu sman dga' sgrog: don las bzhis bya ba gang brtsam yang: gling lha sde'i bstan pa'i so chas red: bu 'dzam gling skyes bu'i bzhed don red: chos mdo sngags bstan pas bskul ma red don gzhan phan byang sems spyod pa red: da ma bul ma

'khyang bzhes rogs mdzod: rdzong bzhi po dus gcig phab rgyu mdzod: glu go na skyid pa'i bdud rtsi yin: ma go skye med ngang la yal: zhes brjod tshe sbyi dpo na khro thu rgyal po rten med kyi mkha' la yar 'phag zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs zhal tshom g.yas la dung dkar mdud zhal tshom g.yon la 'khor lo mdud smra rar sna tshogs padma mdud ag tshom dpal gyi be'u mdud dbu skrar rdo rje'i rgya changs mdud zal bu g.yas la gdugs ris mdud zal bu g.yon la rgyal mtshan mdud zal bu rgyab mar gser nya mdud phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag bum pa' rgya phun sum tshogs pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs nasabade stong rol ba'i glu 'di ltar blangs so oṃ bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas nga'i dung khang bhanta'i dkyil 'khor na: ma brtsal ba'i lha tshogs rang 'khrungs yod: ma bsgom pa'i nyams rtogs rang byung yod: ma bshams pa'i mchod rdzas rang chas yod: da bshams na dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dgyes: thabs dbang po dwangs ma'i rtsa bzhi la: da dpa' bo pho tshogs rang chas bzhugs: pho rgyud

༄༅/ / des mda' 'phen ra ra: 'ben zhe sdang dgra bo ma gtogs med: de 'dul ba'i dpa' bo a khu yin g.yon dbang po dwangs ma'i rtsa bzhi la: lhan skyes pa'idapa' mo mo tshogs bzhugs: mo rgyud des glu len kyu ru phu glu de yis gdul bya 'dod chags gdon de bde mchog rgyal po nga yis 'dul: sku bde ba chen po'i grong khyer red gnas yul dang dur khrod he ru ga'i: dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i nye 'du mdzad: nga chags pa'i rdo rje gzhan las 'phags: gsung bde chen chos kyi bang mdzod red: de phyes na'agro drug chos la bkod: sngon las smon gyi 'brel ba'i skal ldan la tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas gdams ngag sbyin: thugs mi 'gyur lhun po sangs rgyas dngos sprul gzhi nidabang chen he ru ka sprul pa po a khu khro rgyal 'bum: nga'i btsan phyug 'phan dar 'dzoms pa srid che rgyud gser shog bco brgyad yin: nga'i stobs rtsal nus mthu ldan pa'i srid 'bring rgyud 'om bu tsho drug yin: nga'i sbyor sgrol 'dren pa'i phrin las srid: chung rgyud dmu spyang sde bzhi yin: sku ma g.yos ri rgyal lhun po 'dra: g.yos na khams gsum mnga'

dbang bsgyur: gsung ma bsgrags bkra shis dung dkar yin: da bsgrags na khams gsum chos la bkod: thugs ma g.yos nang dbyings 'od gsal yin: g.yos na sum stong chos skur 'god: nga 'gran gyi do med khro thung rgyal: ma mkha' 'gro'i brda lung ngo mtshar che: sgyid la de las che ba med: sems la de las dga' ba med dga' bzhis drangs pa'i rol ston des: kong the'u rang chos la 'god par shog: ra ba'i rdzong khag lon par shog: nor bu'i bang mdzod rnyed par shog gling tsho drug lha sde phyug par shog: ma mkha' 'gro zos skyong grogs su sbran: nga a khus ḍā ki'i bka' bzhin sgrub: don gegs med yid bzhin 'grub par smon: zhes zer nas bkra shis lha dung dkar mo 'bud du bcug chos srid dpal gya gser rnga brdung du bcug rgyal mtshan 'od stong 'bar ba phyar du bcug ru mtshon pha rol g.yul 'joms bsgreng bar byas nas sha thud kyi zas sna bsgrigs ja chang gi skyems sna bshams dar gos kyi maṇḍal bkod nas 'dug tshe gling tsho drug lha sde dkar pos mgyogs pa rta yis chas ring ba 'phur rtsal rgyas bsgrod nye ba rka mgyogs kyis langs nas spyi dpon khro thung rgyal po'i sgo drung du slobs tshe 'bring rgyud gzi ba mi bzhis gral bsgrigs mdzad nas/ dpon gyi dkyil

ra༅༅ gral gyi rtser sras chung dgra lha rtse rgyal bzhugs bla ma'i chos gral gyi rtser bstan skyong rdo rje gzi brjid bzhugs dpa' bo'i ra gral gya rtser 'dan sras g.yu 'od 'bar ba bzhugs nus mthu'i stobs gral gyi rtser 'brog sras jor bu don 'grub bzhugs mnga' thang che ba'i gral rtser chos 'phan dar yag bzhugs phyogs kya mgron gral gyi rtser dung khyung stag lha bzhugs gnyen gyi la gral gyi rtser 'jang phrug g.yu lha bzhugs gsodagacod gdol ba'i gral rtser shan pa rme ru bzhugs ma sru rnams kyi gral rtser 'byug mo bsam 'grub sgrol ma bzhugs spyi dpon che shos kyi gral rtser a skye khra rgan bzhugs 'dzam gling skyes bu don 'grub kyis ma mkhyen pa'i tshul mdzadanas dgongs pa'i dbyings las ma g.yos pa ra 'od gsal kya mtshams khang der bzhugs yod pa'i skabs su spya dpon khro thung rgyal pos sha 'dren dang chang 'dren mdzad dar 'bul dang gser srang 'gyed de nas bde stong sngags kyichas gos yo byad thams cad kyis brgyan nas rin chen sna bdun gyi khri steng du dar 'bol sna tshogs brtsegs pa'i khar rgyal po rol ba' thabs kyis bzhugs nas gling tsho drug lha sde dkar po la 'dra ma yag ga glu 'di ltar blangs so oṃ skye med chos sku'i pho brang nas: rdo rje 'chang dbang thug rjes gzigs ā: 'gags med longs sku'i gzhal yas nas: lha snang mtha' yas pas rtag par skyongs: ( rtsol med

sprul sku'i zhing khams nas:mgon padma rgyal pos byin gyis rlobs:gling tsho drug lha sde dkar po la:don ma cher lha dung 'bud tshul bka':khrims med na gser rnga brdung rgyuradaka':brda ma byung rgyal mtshan bsgreng rgyu min:dmag mi dgos ru dar ga la phyar:nang 'dun ma'i gtam de chang gis bskul:phyis rgyal khab phab tshul sha 'dren yin:don rtena'abrel yag de dar gser 'gyed:da rten 'brel glu yis 'phrin pa 'debs:yang gsal nyams kyi snang cha la:dga' bzhi'i mchod sprin stobs pa'i dus:sku gdung rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor sgom:mdo rgyud sems kyi chos nyid mjal:tshogs yul rtog pas ma gos par:ting nge 'dzin la mnyam bzhag tshe:gnam la bab rje btsun sgrol ma dngos gling chos sde'i a ne gong sman mas:brda skye 'gags 'gyur ba med pa'i glur:kong the'u rang ra rdzong phab ran zer:dpa' rtags phu nu rnams kyis len:bsod nams lha sde dkar por 'byor:mnga' thang gling sde yongs la dbang:snyan grags a khu nga yis rnyed bsam don 'dzam gling skyes bus 'grub:chos srid dgongs pas mtho zer skad:bshad sgrub

༄༅/ / yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel dgos pa phun tshogs de ltar mchis gling che rgyud rnams kyi thugs la zhog: 'bri rgyud rnams kyis dang len mdzod chung rgyud dgagis zhal gyis bzhes: a khu'i glu la bzlog rgyu med: thugs kyi bzhed don bskyur rgyu med: bka' bab pa'i bu rnams grogs su sbran: lha dmag bu yug 'tshub 'tshub mdzod gnyan dmag ser ba 'bab 'bab mdzod klu dmag char sprin 'thib 'thib gyis: gling thugs mthun bsam pa gcig dril gyis: kong the'u rang ra rdzong phab nus shog: ces brjodatshe 'dan sras nor bu bsam 'grub gdan las bzhengs te 'ad 'dra ba'i glu len 'bul lo oṃ dam chos ma ṇi padme sa: 'gro drug skyob la skyabs su mchi: thar ba'i zhing du lam sna drongs: glu bden tshig grub par thugs rjes zungs: gling tsho drug lha sde dkar po yis: mi re bzhin du bsam sgo ro: yod nges pa 'jig rten srid pa'i lugs: deng bdud bzhi phab nas skyid pa 'grub phyi sde khad kyis chag nas yod: nang sde chos kyis bskyangs nas yod: sgom grwa slob grwa sgrub grwa 'dzoms: bu seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul des: chos brgyad kyi spros pa bzhag pa'i

skabs: sems 'od gsal nang don skyong ba'i dus: bcol mi bra bde mor bzhugs na skyid: gling lha sder 'khrug rtsod med pa la: khyed a khu'i phung khrol ma mdzad lo don bdestong bsgoms pa'i rnal 'byor red: sngags phur thogs yongs kyi gtso bo red: bon rnga dpyang thog pa'i rgyal po red: bzhugs thub na gling sde'i spyi dpon red: blo nyes na a khu phung rgan red: da skyid thog bde thog bzhugs rgyu gyis: mi rgas pa'i blo sna ma mang lo: rta rgas pa rgyug dga' ma che lo sman rgas pas phyi brdar ma mang lo da bsgyur kha lci na yagarab sku da: gtam bo na a khu'i thugs dam yin: ma tre ci byar zad med yin: zhes btab tshe ma dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma a khus bstan gtso 'dzan dpon po rnams kyas kyang su bden 'dan sras bden akhu blo yang tsab tsub che bas bya ba brtag dgos zer de'i tshe blon spyi dpon a bye khra rgan gyis zhal 'dzum pa zhig mdzad nas kun bde khod snyoms bsam don 'grub pa'i glu 'di ltar blangs so skyed bslu med daskosnan mchog rin chen mkhyen: chos yi ge drug mas glu sna drongs: nga zag med tshe yi rig 'dzin 'grub: khra mo gling gi mi rgan yin: rang lo brgya dang brgyad cu yin: gling snga dar rnams kyi rgyal tshab

༄༅// yin bar dar rnams kyi blo rten yin:phyi dar thams cad nga la nyon:kha dge ba'i gtam la nyan long yod:gling che 'bring chung la khyad par med:bsam pa na gar po dung las lhag:bsam khog drang ba mda' las legs:regang yangs che ba nam mkhar mnyam rig pa gsar ba nyi zla 'dra lkog gyur shes pa mngon mkhyen ltar ma rig mi mnga' sgon me 'dra gling tsho drug lha sde dkar pos nyon:yang dgos bu tsha yang tshas nyon:spyi dpon lha mgon khro thung rgyal:ma mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan 'bral med 'grogs:rdzong khag bco brgyad lde mig yin:a nu yo ga'i rnal 'byor mchog:rlung gtum mo gnyis la rang dbang thob rdzu 'phrul grub rtags thogs rdugs med:lha padma'i spyan sngar smon lam thebs:yongs bod khams skyid pa'i gzhi ma yin ma mkha' 'gro'i lung la bslu ba med:'dun phug ge sar rgyal po'i mdzod:'dun ma dpa' thul rnams kyis skrubs:yang dgos chung rgyud rnams kyis mdzod:da spyi dpon a byes bsgo ba ltar:gling lha sde dkar po'i sgrub grogs mdzod glu go na kun bde lam yag 'byung :ma go dred po mgo

riX ra yin: zhes gsungs tshe sras chung dgra lha rtse rgyal gyis a khu spyi dpon rin po che'i bka' ltar sgrub los dgos a khu khro thung gsungs la yin pa 'a yod min pa' yod pas gling la sde dkar po 'i chos rgyal 'dzam gling seng rtsen nor bu dgra 'dul gyis bka' ci gan gsung ci bstsal ltar ra re rnams kyis bsgrubs na snyam 'dug de la zhu ba phul mi 'dan sras da du skyong g.yu la rnams chung rgyud nas phebs 'bru sras dang gza ba mi thung a nu dpa 'a seng gsum 'brang rgyud nas phebs stag ro chos 'phan dang dar yag gdung sras gsum che rgyud nas phebs la zhu ba mdzod zhu sna 'dzugs ma 'byug mo dang spya dpo na gyi sras mo 'brog bza' chos sgron gsum gyis mjad dgos gsu sa gyeng tsho drug la sde dkar pos legs so zhus nas gzengs bstod la ra gnas su gyes so zhu mi bu dgu po na ge sar rgyal po 'i sgrub sgor ze bas zhu sna ba gsum gyis lha klu ma yi dar sna re ma jal rten du phupa skos se lcam 'brug mos chos nyid don la bskul ba'i glu 'di 'dra zhig phul lo oṃ dam chos ma ṇi padme sa: glu mchod gcig bka' brgyud bla ma mchod: ma 'gro ba'i don la thugs rjes gzigs gro mchod gnyis dbang chen rta mgrin mchod: bden don ye shes chos char phobs mchod gsum rje btsun sbol ma mchod: dga' bzhi'i 'dod pa sbar bar mdzod: gnas rnga

༄༅/ / yab dpal ri'i gzhal yas nas:rje sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad 'byung dang:zhal mi gnyis 'dzam gling skyes bu mchog:thugs dgongs pa chos sku'i klongalas bskul:mo nga la brtse ba'i zhal bzang ngom:bsgoms 'od gsal thun skrogs med par zhu:lha thugs rje'i khro zhal ma mdzad lo:nga khra mo gling gi mngag gzhug yin:yangadagos dgra lha rtse rgyal gyis:bka' yis gnang ba phebs pa yin:gling sngags pa nus mthu stobs 'dzoms pa'i:dpon khro thung rgyal po'i thugs dgongs la:nyams 'od gsala'adres pa'i thun gseng du:gling lha sde'i skyabs gcig gong sman gyis:brda lung byang ma 'gags sa ler bstan kong the'u rang ra rdzong phab dus zer:rdzong bco brgyad zer ba'i dus tshigs yin:da ma 'gyangs lcags pho stag gi lor thabs du ma'i sgo nas 'dul rgyu yin:gsung de bsgrags lha sde dkar po 'dus:ja sha thud chang gis ston mo mdzad gtam len pa 'dan sras nyid nas gsungs:bka' mi sgrub zer ba'i btsan gtam lags:gling skyid po sdug la ma gtugs zer:chos mdzad kyi spyod pa ma bsgyur zer:gling ge

sar sku srog 'gel rgyu mdzad: gros ma mthun spyi dpon rgyal po yis bka' rin chen gser gyi bdud rtsi gnang: lung yin min khyod la 'dri rgyu byas: rdzong phab dang mi phab grosargyu byas: gsungs nyan mir che chung 'bring rgyud nas bka' babs pa'i mi dgu sgo drung 'tshogs zhu sna nged gsum 'dzugs dgos byung: thugs brtse ba chen po'i bzhes rogasamadzod: zhal 'dzum pas mdangs bzang bstan tu gsol: spyan zil mig dga' ba stsal tu gsol: gsungs ldem dgongs med par gnang bar zhu: zhu rten lha klu mi yi dar: zhumi sgol ma rnam gsum gyi: sprul pa nged cag rjes bzung 'tshal: zhu 'phrin nyi zla'i ga'ur bcug gsung lan bdud rtsi'i char rgyun stsol: zhesagasol ba btab nas phyag dang maṇḍal phul tshe 'dzam gling skyes bu don 'grub kyis bco lnga' zla zhal ro ma nas tshangs pa'i glu dbya sa kyi rta la drang sa te chos bde skyid 'dzoms pa'i gsung lan 'di ltar byung ngo glu dam chos ma ṇi padme /: lha mchog gsum thugs rjesabazung du gsol glu a la skye ba med pa yin: tha la 'gags pa med pa'i brda ma tha la rtsol med phrin las glu: pha rgyud gling gi khyad chos yin: ma rgyud gling gi 'gugs lugs

༄༅/ / yin: 'dra ma yag gi brda sprod yin nga'i 'od gsal nyams kyi snang cha la: steng bee ḍūrya yis gdugs zhig phub: rma bya'i sgro yis lhab lhub bskon: gser nyi zla nor bu'i tog zhig btsugs: ngas lta bas rdzong chen zin thal snyam: pha brgyud bla ma'i gdung 'tshob snyam: thugs dgongs brgyud byin rlabs thebs so snyam: nga'i blo phug chos ltar 'byung ngo snyam: de rjes nyams kyi snang cha la: nyi zla gdan du gting ba la: shel gong lag tu thogs pa las zer gyis rgyal khams khyab par 'dug ngas bsgom pa'i 'od gsal mjal 61 snyam: rnam rtog gi dgra bo sod thal snyam bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal thal snyam: bsgoms pas 'phrang kun brgal lo snyam: lhag lhas rjes su zin thal snyam: brda rgyud byin rlabs thob bo snyam: 'dun ma'i yang rtse 'grub song snyam: de rjes nyams kyi snang cha la: ra mgo bcad nas gdan du byas: khyung gi mgo nas nor bu blangs: stag gi lngags thul lus la gyon shes rab ral gri mda' gzhu thogs: dar dmar po shar gyi phyogs su brkyangs: 'brug byang mas skad bton lho la ldir rlung 'tshubs

ma nub kyi phyogs nas langs: byang nags klong me yis bsregs par byed: sa dkar po'i rtsi zhig gsol ba rmis: de dpyad na ha cang sems ma spro: don 'jig rten chos brgyad byabar rig: dgra 'dul ba'i bsod nams byed dgos 'byung: bgegs 'joms pa'i tho lum bsnun dgos thug: sems sdug kyang sdug la dga' yang dga' de los sdug lta mtshangs spyod pas phud: da los dga' 'khor 'das stong sgog 'phrog: zhi ba'i 'phrog lugs zhi gnas yin: rgyas pa'i 'phrog lugs lhag mthong yin: dbang gi 'phrog lugs bde stong yin: drag po'i 'phrog lugs sgrol ba yin: rten 'brel dus la bab pa red: mgon a khu khro thung rgyal po yi: thugs 'od gsal klong la 'khrul ba med ma mkha' 'gro'i brda la bslu ba med kong the'u rang gi ra rdzong phab pa na: gnam mtha' lcags kyi rgad po yis: 'jigs lta gsod pa'i me ro yin sa mtha' zangs kyi rgan mo yis: smon log bshig pa'i tho lum yin sog mi zan rlangs pa 'phyo ba'i tshe: de gtor byed rlung gi da la yin: lta rtag chad gnyis kyi bstan pa can gling bar kla kla'i ngad pa yis 'dzam

༄༅/ / gling mtha' dbus kun khyab tshe mun pa sel ba'i sgron me yin: sdug bsngal skyob pa'i bsil khang yin: tsha gdung skyob pa'i bdud rtsi yin rnam shes 'drenapa'i bla ma yin dam tshig srung ba'i bka' sdod yin: 'di'i 'dra ma yag gi rnam thar 'di bskal pa'i 'phel 'grib gso byed lags: mdzad pa da lta'i dus su yin: dgos pam 'ong sa phyir na che: ma rje btsun sgrol ma'i sprul pa tsho: zhu 'phrin gdab pa ngo mtshar che: zhu dar phul ba a la la: gling tsho drug lha sde dkar po nas: mi bka' bab bu dgu'ithugs la zungs: che rgyud gser re/ga bco brgyad la: ma go med par bldab grogs mdzod 'bring rgyud 'om bu tsho drug gis: phyogs min yongs la thos nges gyis: chung rgyud dmuspyang sde bzhi yis: bu dpa' rtsal ldan la lhag par smon: ma sman kun la dga' 'dzum shod: spyi dpon a khur snyan zhus dgos: dpon khro thung rgyal por zhu dar phul: zhu rtenagaser dang dngul gyis gyis yin no nges so legs so brjod: gna' mi gling gi kha sgos la: dpa' rgya tsha'i gyad kyi mi bzhi des: tshong ra khra mo'i me long las: rta rin chen rgyan

can bcu gsum dang: mdzo rgyab 'gel ldan pa bcu gsum bcas: kong the'u rang phyogs kyi nyul ma ni: go rna ring zer bas 'byer ro skad: yul kha che'i jag pa mi gsum gyis blo gros mthun lcags kyis sha zungs bskor lan ma thang yul sdes brjed nas song: ngan ma 'phrod 'gags za'i bu yis lus: da nyes bsgrags bcas te chas ran yin: gtamago na gling sde'i thugs la zhog ma go pa rnams grab nas phud: ces chos rgyal yad bzhin nor bu'i gsungs lan bdud rtsi'i thigs pa gling tsho drug lha sde dkar po la 'gyed tshe: spyi dpon khro thung rgyal po'i ngo so mtho gsung skad mtho bshad glu chen po 'don a skyes tsha lu bsam don 'grub rgyu des thugs bzhed bzhin du 'grub par shog cig nyes bsgragasakyi tshig ni de dag yin no gsu sa de nasaphu nu dpa' thul rnams kyis khrab dkar mo' rgyunathag bsdams rta mgyogs pa chas kyis gsos mtshon rnon por so ra blud mda' 'phen pa'i rtsal sbyangs byas glu dga' ba'i gros kha mthun sems 'dun ma gcig dril byas te bskal pa lcags pho stag gi lo' sa ga zla ba'i yaratshes la chos thang sa yi skyid tshal padma'i ra ba chen po la 'tshogs nas bzhugs skabs su seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul gyis dgra 'dul tshul gyi bka' yis bca' khrims 'di ltar gnang ngo

༄༅/ / oṃ dam chos ma ṇi padme hūṃ lha mchog gsum thugs rjes nyi zhal gzigs mi bdag la mgon skyabs sdong grogs mdzod: gling lha sde'i blo sems chos la drangs: bya ba sbyor sgrol brtsams na yang : byed pa 'gro don kho na grub: sangs rgyas bstan pa zin pa dang : snyigs 'gro'i rgud pa sel bar shog: kong the'u rang gi ra rdzong phab pa la: so the'u khas kha dang po na: gnam lha bab sngon gyi smon lam can: rgya khrom pa spyang thul dkar po de: dung skyong stag lha khri dkar des: dung gi zhags pas zungs la chongs sngon gyi tha tshig bzang po sgrogs lha o rgyan padma'i smon lam bzhin: nga 'dzam gling rgyal po'i bka' blon mdzod: gtam de tsho sgrogs dang sngar gnas dran: de ma thul kong the'u'adul skal med dpa' 'thab ya med pas rgya stag 'dra: gtam lab ya mi 'dang bden tshig grub: stobs ya ba mi 'dang grub pa thob: tshes bco lnga'i nya gang nyin par la: bu khyod kyang ma g.yel ma bul lo: nga'i rten 'brel gyi thog ma de dus yin: de rgyab so the'u bar ma na: lcags mi zan gyi dom bu snying sdug yod: gling a stag dpa' mo'i 'dul skal

yin:mda' nyag phran rnon po'i ngar la dril:'dren mkhan gling bla kun dga' yin:de rgyab so the'u 'gab ma na khra mgo dmar brgya shi stong gsod yod rlung bsil mar songayang mngag pa min:mda' nyag phran springs yang stobs kyis 'dzin ngan sems la 'chang na kho yis shes:de gsod pa ma byung dpa' thul sdug:'thab ya byed pa'i dpa' bodaka':gcod pa'i rno mtshon gang yang bul:las pa las la sdug rab yod:bdud dam sri mi yi gzugs can de:'dul mkhan a khu khro thung yin:gtum mo me yis mabasregs na:'jig rten me yis tshig pa min:shes rab rlung gis ma gtor na:mtshon rnon dra bas chod pa min:mnyam bzhag chu yis ma brlan na:de gsod dang 'chi ba thub mayin:lha dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rje des:stobs rdzu 'phrul grub rtags du ma yis:btul na dpa 'a rtags dgra la ngom:bshad na dpa 'a thul ngo so mtho:gling na ma 'ong rjesayi rangs:de gdul bya snga ma rnam gsum yin:rten 'brel de tsho ma 'dzoms na:yang phyis 'byung dgos pa'i rnam bshad yod:da de ring bkra shis nyi ma la:gtam de tsho dpa'

༄༅/ / thul thugs la zhog: gling tsho drug lha sde'i sku rim sgrubs thugs bzhed don bya ba mthar phyin nas dus snyigs ma'i 'gro don 'byung bar shog: gtam go nagling pas thugs la zhog: ma botsware (1 la the 31ma 'chor: zhes 'dzam gling seng chen rgyal pos bka' gnang stsal ba bzhin dung skyong stag lha khri dkar la ja 'dren dang chang 'dren mdzad lha bsang dang sku rim bsgrubs tshes de'i nya gang nyin dung rta stong ri zil ba la gser sga da g.yu stan bstad gong rmed dang glo thag bsdams dbu rmog dkar gya dar 'phru'i nyi zla khebs la khad rgyab khrab dkar gyis gling pa khyab la khad rkang sog lham gyi yob sgrasas gzhi g.yos stag tshang nas thon pa bzhin du lung chen la gom chen gyis bsgrod lung chung la gom chung gis brgal nasamathon po rtse ra dgu ldan gyi steng nas gzigs tshe kong ze'u kha che'i rgyal khab mtsho la dar chags dar la rdulabab byas nas khod snyoms su yod par gzigs yar bltas pasakong the'u yi so kha gong ma na rgya khrom pa spyang thul dkar po can de yar ldang nas phyogs kun tu bltas tshe lus che bajid ri bo lta bu gzugs bkrag mdangs nyi zla'i 'oda'abar stobs nus pa 'gran ya med pa de'i zhal dang gzugs mthong dung skyong gis dal gcig la thugasadagongs btang nasakho zin par dka' zin yang thub dka' thub na chingasadaka' chings kyang rta yis 'degasadaka' bar

'ong 'dug snyam tsa na sems la dpa 'a bskyed de gling ge sar gyi gsungasal rdzun pa med sngon smon lam gyi dge mtshan la the tshom med gling lha sde'i nang nas bka' lung babs byon skyems dang skyel ma mdzad rten 'brel gyi dang po yin pas tha tshig bsgrags pa'i glu zhig len dgongs nas 'di ltar bsgrags so oṃ dam chos ma ṇi padme sa: yongs 'gro rnams 'dren par mdzad du gsol: nga skyes pa mon gyi yul du skye: smon lam gling dkar yul la thebs: lha o rgyan padma'i thugs bskyed kyis: mon 'dul ba'i lde mig nga yis byas: mgon 'dzam gling seng chen bzhed don sgrub: da nga ngo khyod kyis shes sam ci thag ring ba gling mkhar stod nas yin: dpa' ya med dung skyong stag lha zer: mtshon rnon po'i sos btab ngar ma nyams: mda' nyag phran rtse mor btsas ma reg bu dpa' bo' sems kyi gra ma nyams steng lha dmag bu yug 'dzabs ltar yod bar gnyan dmag thog ser 'khrigs ltar yod 'og tsho dmag rgya mtsho 'byur ltar yod: gling lha sde'i las dmag bsam mtha' yas: dpa' ya med rgya tsha 'bum pa

༄༅/ / la btsan ya med kong the'u kha ches byas: deng gnam lo lcags pho stag gi lor: da gcig yod gcig med byed rgyu zer: khyod khrom pa spyang thul dkar po de gnas sa kong the'u phyogs la gnas: mngag mkhan o rgyan padma yin bu 'dzam gling skyes bu'i sku 'khor yin: sngon smon lam 'phro btsan bzang po'i tshul: nga zhu 'phrin dung skyong mngag nas byas: da ma 'khrul rang ngo shes ran red: lan pa gling gis mngag pa med: gtam de tsho thugs kyi dkyil du zhog: kong the'u rang gi ra rdzong phab pa la: khyod lde mig yin pas lus shugs phyungs: khra mo gling dkar stod la 'gro: bu 'dzam gling skyes bur mjal 'phrad byed bka' bsgros nas dam tshig ci bder gyis gtam go na sems kyi bdud rtsi yin ma bo 'i glen pa nga rgyal che: zhes 'phrin gdam tshe rgya khrom pa spyang thul dkar po des bsam pa la sngon lha bab gnam gyi rgyal po gong ma lha'i drung nas smon lam da dam tshig gcig pa ni bden yang yabazu ba'i gtam zhig ma lab na nga dpa' ya med brgya sngon gcig la mi kha che kong ze'u ra phyogs nas lab rgyu mang gling lha sde dkar pos kyang snying sdug dpa 'a med sems kyi gra sha chad pa zhig red bsam pas dpa 'a ma zhus nga ro'i

sgra yis gtam lan zhig 'debs dgos snyam nas 'di skad do glu tha la tha la tha la red ma ha la ngag gi 'gugs lugs red:sa 'di kong the'u so mkhar red:mi nga tsho sa sgo srung mi red:dpa' ya med spyang thul dkar po yin:brgya yara'agro khrims la gtug mi yin:stong mar 'ong mgo zas len mi yin gus 'dud kyi 'brin pa ma byas par:rlung bsil mar yin yang mngag le min dmag 'bum tsho mthong yangasgrag le min dpa' bdar la rgod kha 'chor mi yin:mtshon 'debs la snga phyi khos mi yin:mda' 'phen brlag dus gcig byed mi yin:ri chen po dpung khug 'jog mi yin mtsho chen po shub kyis 'debs mi yin:gling phrug a bra kha ser la mi sgrag nges pa kho thag yin:dpa' gang nas 'gran kyang nga yis bzang:stobs gang nas bdar yang nga yisabazang: 'phrul ci ltar 'gran yang nga nyid lhag: steng lha dmag mod po ming tsam snyam: nges par yod kyang lto bar rngub gnyan dmag yod pa rdzun tshig red

༄༅/ / mchis na'ang rigs sngags nus pas brlag: klu dmag yod pa rdzun pa yin: mchis na sprul pa khyung gis 'dul gling jo rus dmag sde yod nges kyang:mtshon mi dgos sa rdos 'thab dang chog: kong the'u rang gi dmag dpung langs mi dgos: dmag de tsho'i ngo len nga yis byed: khyod dung skyong stag lha khri dkar lo: nye ba mig gis ma mthong dang: ring ba lo rgyus skad cha go: gso bskyed don gsum mon gyis byas: gces pa bu las khyad ma mchis: mi ngan gsos na rang srog sdud: rta ngan gsos na ngal gso khom: zer ba'i dpe ltar cis mi bden: nang bla btsong btsong lde mig zer phyi sna khrid khrid kha smon zer ngo mi mtshar nga tsho ngo re tsha: khyod bsad na dpa' rtags ngom rgyu med:brdung na lan chags 'dags rgyu med: cab cob ma mang phyir la song: 'dun ma'i 'phrin pa bsgrigs rgyu med: nga'i kha ngo g.yung drung bon la 'khor: tshe srog the'u rang bla mar bcol kong the'u kha che'i rgyal po tsho: snying srog 'di dag khyad par med: bla mi nang dbyen mi byed lo: gtam go na dung skyong sems la zungs: ma go'i glu la bsgyur 'jog med

ra gyi/ / snying rtse gcag tu gtad 'dod dam mi 'dod ces gsungs pa la rgya spyang thul can des 'dra ma yag gi rnam thar la gus shing 'gyod bshags kyi glu 'di ltar blangs so glu ma 'gags chu bo'i gzhung ltar len: sems rnyog mas bslad pa khyed la 'chags: ye med nam mkha' stong pa la: snod bcud snang ba'i ri mo bkra: dus bzhi'i dbang gisa'agyur ldog mang: nam mkhar g.yo 'gul med lags sam: sems dngos po ma grub stong pa'i klong: tshogs brgyad yul gyi cho rol la: nyer len rtog pa'i bde sdug mang semasani 'pho 'gyur ma mchis sam: brjed ldan ri rgyal lhun po la: mngag zhug dpa' thul rtsi shing bkra: dung skyong stag lhar ngo len byas: chos rgyal la phyogs ris mi mnga'am gnod pa gang song mthol lo bshags: 'jig rten srid pa'i dpe lugs la: mi ngan sdug na gtam ngan shor sbrul ngan gcur na rkang lag mthong: zer ba'i dpe ltar ma thubanas kha bshad nga yis khe mi red: lag len kho yis btab pa red: snying nas khyod la mos na yang: rnam 'byur mos 'dod byed ngo tsha: gong lha bab padma'i smon lam las: brjed

༄༅/ / nga yongs 'gro rnams skyong phyir phebs pa yin: gti mug gnyid la 'khrul ba mang: 'od gsal snang char bag chags med: da ma 'gyangs a stag klu mo bos da nyi ma rtse shar tshun chad la: gong so the'u khas kha dang po rtsa mgyogs pa bzhon nas phebs ran red: rnon po btags nas 'gro ran red: dpa' rtags dgra la ngom ran red: lcags mi zan dom bu snying sdug 'di: khra mo gling la zon mi rung: brgya tsho kha lo byas nas 'gro stong tsho mgo lo byas nas 'gro: phu nu'i gral kha gtor nas 'gro de bas myur bar a stag chos: 'dren mkhan bla ma kun dga' phebs: sdong grogs nged tsho srung mas byed: phrin las myur mgyogs dgra blas sgrub: brda de tsho go na mgyogs ran red: ma go 21ngas kyang ci byar zad: ces gsu sa nas 'a 'a 'od lam lam nam mkha' la yal so de ma thag pa ra ma ga gzhug pho nya springs nas a stag dpa' mo 'dir shog gsungs mos lus shugs myur du phyu nas phebs tsa na bdag gi 'od gsal gyi snang char gnam go sman rgyal mos brda lu byu nas nya ma rtse shar tsam la kong the ru ra gi so kha dang po la phebs dgos mgyogs pa la sga stan myur bar gyis rnon po la so phyu tsha ra bskyed mda' nyag phran

pa dug chus ngar bskyed nasalcags mi zan dom bu snyong sdug zer ba'i 'byung po mi yi gzugs can de khyod kyas 'dul skal yin pas myur bar chas mdzod 'dren ston gling bla kun dga' bzang po yin pas de'ang khyod kyi rjes su phebs nas bsleb nges dgos zhes pas bka' bstsal a stag dpa' mos go khrab mtshon gsum lus la bgos mgyogs pa ra nag thod dkar la sga 'jog dang stan 'jog mnyam por slo len dang go rmed dus gcig tu bsdams nas sil smar gya bang rtsal dang bcas te skad cig gis nam mkha' gsal thag chod tshe so the'u khas kha dang por phebs kong the'u rang gi yul la bltas pas smag rub rdul 'tshubs kyi ngang la gnas pa mthong yang bltas pas me dmar nag tu mgrigs shing lcags kyi tshwa la phar ri tshur ri la lhang lhang 'phro zhing 'phyo ba gcig gi klong nas mi nag po dom gyi mgo can gsal shang dang mdung rang 'dzan pa gcig glog zhagasa'agyug 'byug byed bzhin du byung tsa na a stag la dpa' ra 'khrugs dug mda' la dug zer khol rwa gzhu las me rlung 'tshubs mgyogs pa de'i sga skor byed bzhin du sa la babs nas tha tshig bsgrags pa'i glu 'di ltar blangs so gru tha la badzra pa ṇi hūṃ: ngag 'gugs pa tā re hūṃ swā hā: de mchod do o rgyan padma mchod: thugs brtse bas ma dor rjes su zungs: da lcags pho mi zan dom nag lo: nyon gcig

༄7/ / nyon gnyis nyon gsum sdod nga ngo khyod kyis ma shes na a stag dpa' ba'i klu mo yin: mda' skyen po'i rang dbang thob pa yin: gar gtad 'ben la phogale yin phog pa'i yul de gtor brlag byed gzir nas shor ba yod ma myong 'phang nas thar ba yod ma yin: gong lha'i lung bstan gzengs bstod byung bar mi yi shan palag mar bskos kong the'u rang ra rdzong phab byas nas: 'dzam gling rgyal po'i chos srid spel: 'jig rten skyid pa'i 'dun pa sgrub: khyod gsod la bag tsha mi dgos dang: rnamashes 'dren pa'i bla ma yod: thar lam ston pa'i sangs rgyas yod: ngan song sgo gcod ded dpon yod: 'gro sa dag pa'i zhing las med skyel sa rig 'dzin gral las medags pa beg na snying sdug sems 75 lce/ga: ma zaga'i 〉/ shā bas05 bzhag med: ces bldabs tshe lcags kyi mi zan snying sdug des zhe sdang me ltar 'bar phrag dog rlung ltar 'tshubs nga rgyal ri ltar snyal bzhin du glu la 'di ltar blangs so glu tha drang tha drang tha drang red ma tha drang bon gyi 'gugs lugs red tshig nyon dang 'dra ma lab rgyu yod: gling a bra kha ser mnga' 'og la nag mo'i dpa' thul

yod zer bden: 'os mdud med pas har tshig mtho khyo med nag mo mgo 'phang mtho: bsad na stong med bud med yin: thub na dpa' rtags ngo so med: khyod bsad sems la sdug bsngal gzhi: gling dpa' thul rgod po gang na yod: ma ngan jo ru gang na yod: rgya tsha'i bu rgod gang na yod: rgod por dpa' shed de ring 'gran: rnon po'i so kha de ring 'gran nga'i ru mtshon dgra sde tshar gcod 'di: yar g.yug pas sra brtan brag kyang gtor: mar gzir bas rgya mtsho'i chu yang skem: dmag stong la gcig las brdeg mi dgos: khyod mi gsod nag mo phar la song: nga dpa' bo chas pa'i lam kha phyes: khra mo gling la 'gro le yin: gling pha dmag brlag nas 'ong nges yin: dpa' rgod mi zan snying sdug thog: nag mo bsad na mi kha che: bo na sems kyi dkyil du zhog: ma bo/ glen pa lam nas 'chi: zhes zer bas lan du dpa' mos dug mda' gzhu steng du bzhag nas tshig gsum glu yi brda sprod 'ad ltar byas so skyod dkon mchog rin chen gsum la 'dud:rgyal ba sras bcas thugs rjes zungs: las ngan 'khor ba'i lam las bzlog: 'gro drug ngan song skye sgo khogs: rang snang dag pa'i zhing khams

༄༅/ / nas bka' brgyud bla ma rin po che sdig po che 'di 'dren par mdzod: 'og min me ru 'bar ba nas: yi dam lhag pa'i lha mchog gis: sdig po che 'di'adren du gsol bde stong spros bral pho brang nas ma rgyud mkha' 'gro 'dren stobs can mi las ngan 'di la thugs rjes gzigs: thar pa'i lam la drangs su gsol: dugamada' dpa' rtags mtshal leb can: dgra gsod mtshon cha rnon po 'dis: dgra dpa' rgod dom nag snying sdug gi: sgog rtsa khrag rtsa snying rtsa chod: don lnga sgod drug tshal b.ragatub: rnam regs rgyal ba'i sras dza/ 11ra: zhes brjod nas dug mda' springs pa la dpa' rgod dom nag gi dpral ba nas zug don snyi thams cad tshal bar gtubs nas bsgral ba' dus su gli bla kun dga' bzang pos rnam shes 'og min zhing du 'dren par mdzad do gzugs phung rdzu'aphrul chen pos ri rab kyi 'og tu mnan nas dam sri'i mgo 'phang sma phab par byas so de nas a stag dpa' mos dgra la dpa' rtags ngom gnyen gyi ngo so bstod bu'adzam gli skyes bu'i thugs bzhed 'grub par byas nas khra mo gling yul du phebs dus tsho drug lha sde dkar pos sna len dang rol ston phul nas dkyis par bzhugs so yang 'dzam gling skyes bu don 'grub kyis dpa' rtsal ldan pa'i bu

brgyad / mngag gzhug byed pa'i pho nya bcu dang / khyad par spyi dpon khro thung rgyal po rnams bsdusanas sha chang ja 'dren mdzad nas ge sar rgyal pos 'dra ma yag gi glu mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshag 'di ltar gsungs so oṃ dam chos ma ṇi padme hūṃ bka' yang dag chos la skyabs su mchi: ma 'gro drug thar pa'i lam la drongs: glu sna dpa' bo mkha' 'gros brten: lha o rgyan dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul nga'i mnyam bzhag 'od gsal thugs dgongs la: rlung bsil mar g.yos nas me ro bslangs: de 'bar bas tsan dan nags klong bsregs spyang rtsal ldan ngar ma cha shes tshig: 'brong bre btsan dpa' bo'i rwa ngar bud: stag 'dzum drug bkra ba'i kha dog lad: sha dgo rkyang phyogs dang phyogs la gtor de rten 'brel ya mtshan ma legs snyam:grogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gror gsol ba btab: rkyen 'phral snang 'joms pa'i srung bzlog byas: de rjes nyams kyi 'od gsal la: nub zla gam dgu rdzogs pho brang nas: lha dbang chen rta mgrin bzhad par snang glu de yis sa gsum shig shig g.yo: sgra de yis mdangs dang 'od zer gsal: mgon khro thung rgyal por phog nas thal: gling spri dpon a

rnams glen pa yin: zhes gsungs tshe spyi dpon khro thu rgyal pos dga' ba'i mdangs bstan kyang thugs la skrag sngangs yud tsam 'byung bzhin gling phu nu rnams la tshig gsum glu yas 'phrin pa 'ad ltar gdab tso1 dzadas dbyingasastong pa'i klong dkyil nas pha bka' brgyud bla ma de ring mkhyen: nga spyi dpon khro thung skyabs mgon mdzod: bsam bsam 'dun ma 'grub gyur cig: sa rgyang thag ring por 'grob la: rgyags la sha chang gling sdes sgrub: rgyus med rgyang ring gcod pa la: grogs ni dpa' bo mkha' 'gros mdzod: lus rtsal drug cung zad rgud pa la: tshe bsam don 'grubapas bskyed du gsol: gling lha sde dkar po bde mor bzhugs: a khus bsam don 'grub kyang thang: rten 'brel log 'chi min dang ni: a khu phyir la ma thon na: dge ba'i ra mda' tsha bus mdzod: lus sems 'brel thag chad dgos na: sha len stong snyogs tsha bus mdzod bde bar phyir la 'khod byung na phyag rgyas dga' ston btsal rogs mdzod gtam de tsho 'dzam gling thugs la zhog: gling tsho drug lha sdes ma brjed gsungs: zhes pas glu blangs tshe gli gzhan nu thams cad 'dzum pa shor dpa' bo rnams kyang ma na pa badzad ge

༄༅/ / rang sems zangs lcags ga'u nas bon gses stag lha me 'bar dgongs:de ring bdag la zhal gyis phyogs:ngan pa phar la ma byas kyang :gnod pa tshur la ston pa yi gling phrug a bra kha ser dang: phung rgan gling gi khro thung lo nga'i khog stod lcags las grub pa yin:lcags khrab stong dang 'dra sa med:khog smad bse khyung khro las byung :khro chu khol mas bzhu ba min:mgo yan lag gnam lcags ra ma lug:rno ngar mtshon gyi 'gran zla med: dpag tshad bcu gnyis dug zer 'debs rgyang grags bar la mchu yis 'bigs:rim pa bcu gsum spar mos thebs:yar dpag na gnam lcags thog la 'gran:mar 'phyo na gser mig chu 'phrad 'dra: phar rgyug na bsil mar rlung dang 'grogs: rig rig bsad pa'i shan pa yin:g.yung drung bon gyi phyag brnyan yin: the'u rang spun gsum gyi gces phrug yin:kha che rgyal po'i sgo srung yin:nor bu'i bang mdzod kyi srung ma yin: dkar po nor gyi tshong dpon yin:kong the'u rang la gcig 'byung gnyis srid red: bya ba ma ngan jo rus brtsams: byed pa bud med 'dre mos bsgrubs:smra phab

mon bla btsong mis byas: dus tshod gsum pa'i steng la phebs ser po'i dmag dpung 'khrugs kyin yod: 'bru sde'i gshed du dbab rgyu yin sngon pos dmag gapung 'tshubs nas yod: 'dan ma'i khri skor brlag rgyu yin dkar po'i dmag dpung gnam nas chas: rgya tsha'i sde tsho brlag rgyu yin dmar po'i las dmag bar snang 'byur: shan pa'i nags 1nga bsreg rgyu yin ljang gu'i dmag dpung sa 'og 'grims: gling sde kha lo bsgyur rgyu yin: khro thung zer ba a ba ris: rta tshos chung lug za sna med mi tsho nyam thag mid sna med: nga'i rang lus bon gyi dkyil 'khor la: gling mi ab sha za ba tshos: mchod pa mi lo kho thag kyang : de ring mi bza' kha med yin: gtam go na phung rgan sems la zungs: ma bo/'i shā/ la yang chosas med: ces zer tshe khro thung mi rta gnyis bya khyung gcig tu sprul nas rten med kyi nam mkha' la 'phur dus brgya gsod khra mgo dmar des 1ga dmar 'byug 'byug thog ser khol bol dug zer 'tshubs 'tshubs byas nas steng lha yul la bdas bar gnyan yul du 'ded 'og klu yul la bros ded byas nas slar yang so the'u 'gab mar zon tsha sngar gyi mi rta gnyis su gyur pa na brgya gsod khra mgo

ra༅༅/ / dmar des rang gzugs bstan nas khro thung mi rta gnyis ka gyur mid la btang tshe lcags kyi za ma tog zhig du sprul nas de'i nang du mi rta gnyis ka ma nyams par gnas bzhin du stong nyid sngags kyi zlos gar la rol ba chen po mdzad bzhin glu 'di ltar blangs so e lha dkon mchog gsum po dgongs su gsol: ma dang mkha' 'gro gsan du gsol: chos skyong srung mas snyan gsan mdzod: de ring a khu'i skyid lugs la: phyi ma ṭaṃ rū tra'i khog pa'i nang nang rin chen lcags kyi mchod sdong grub: sems 'od gsal dga' bzhi'i sgron me 'bar: nyon mongs dri mas mi gos 'dug bag chags mngal rgyal dub mi'adug: sdug bsngal btson rar dzad mi 'dug: nga da res dga' ldan lha yul phebs: khyod las sgrib de ru dag par byas: de nas bar ma gnyan yul phebs: khyod ngag gi sgrib pazad par byas: tha ma rgya mtsho kla yul byon: khyod sems kyi bag chags de ru bkras: de nas chos smra'i klong yangs las: gzugs sna khro thung mi rta ngom: khyod za dga' che bas zos

snang skyes btung dga' che bas 'thung snang skyes: bgo dga' che bas gon snang skyes: dpa' rgya tsha'i nor snyogs stong len yin: gling lha sdes brjed nas song ba min: khyed 'khrulab rang ngos e zin bsam nyes pa bshags par e 'ong bsam nyi ma de ring yan chod la: 'dun ma'i sna thag e yod snyam ma yod kho thag chod song nas: rgya spyang thul zeraba'i rgod po de: dpa' rgod ma yin kho thag chod: lcags mi zan dom bu snying sdug de: dpa' thul mi dgos nag mos sod: brgya stong gsod khra mgo mig dmar khyod: khamasagasum gnas la khrid khrid pa: mdzo mo shing sna zer dang mtshungs khong pa'i nang la rdzong btab pa: mi rabs bdun la khrel mi byang : nga'i sgyu lus spyi dpon khro thung zer: nang donadabang chen rta mgrin bu rta phag gis ru tra btul ba ltar: de ring bdud rgan 'dul rgyu yin: sdig pa'i sgyu lus phu po la: dpal khro bo bcu yi grong khyer btab: snying gi rtsa chen dkar nag la: dpa' bo mkha' 'a11sa bro gar bsgyur yan lag lhu chen bcu gnyis la: rten 'brel bcu gnyis gnas stong byed: lha legs ldan dregs tshogs gzer bus

༄༅/ / btab: nang don lnga snod drug bkod pa la: rig lnga thub drug dkyil 'khor bkod: zhi khro rab 'byams sprin ltar gtibs: gnam sa'i the'u rang gang na yod: khyod grogs po yod na 'bod ran red: dmag dpung yod na thon ran red: rdzu 'phrul yod na ston ran red: drag rtsal yod na phyung ran red: ngas gtum mo'i me chen sbar ran yin lcags khrab ngar ma e tshig ltos: tshangs pa'i rlung chen bskul ran yin: bse khyung khro zhun e gtor ltos: zag med bdud rtsi phyur ran yin: khyod gnam lcags zangs kyi ra ma lug: ming med stong par e byed ltos: gtam go na sdug rgan sems la zhog: ma go glu la 'gran ya med: ces gsungs nas dbang chen rta mchog rol pa spyi dpon khro thu rgyal pos gtum mo'i me sbar bdud po de' ro stod bsregs blugs su phul tshangs pa'i rlung g.yos ro smad kyi rdul nam mkha' la yal bar byas byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab nyon shes kyi dri ma sbya sa sems rnam shes lcags sdag mthe bongatsam pa zhig tu gyur pa de phyag mthil du bkod nas glu 'di ltar blangs so

oṃ bde stong hya ṣṭṛ wa sa: glu mchod do lhag pa'i lha la mchod lha rjes chags bzhad pa'i thugs rjes zungs: grogs mkha' 'gro chos skyong gzigs grogs mdzod: lha klu gnyanagyis blta rogs gyis: mi gcig a khu'i dpa' lugs la: gling dpa' thul su dang 'dra sa med: rta gcig 'phar bas mgyogs lugs la gling lha sde'i rta yis mchungs zla dben: mi rta gnyis don go chod lugs la: skye gnas bzhis bsdus 'gro ba yis: dpa' 'di 'dra byas rabs mtheng ma myong : mthong ba lta ci zos ma myong : ma tshad dran pa su yis spobs: gling byis pa rnams kyang a khur dgod: dgod rgyu e 'dug 'di 'dra red dpa' bo rnams kyang mkhun pa lang : snying gzer khos na 'di 'dra dgos tsha 'dzam glingaskyes bu don 'grub des: byung na a khu go chod mngag: ma byung a khu phang med byas: lha grub pa'i dbang phyug yin dbang gis: dgra su yod dbang la bsgyur ba min: rdzong phab phab a khu nga yis phab: dpa' blangs blangs a khu nga yis blangs: de dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i thugs la zhog bzhag nas gling sde dkar por re da: khyad chos rnam thar rgyal

༄༅/ / khams sgrogs: dag pa dbyings gsum pho brang nas: rgyal dgongs brda snyan bla ma mkhyen: mi sdig can las ngan rnam shes 'di: dbyings skye 'chi med parakha sbyor mdzod: nub zla gam dgu rdzongs pho brang nas: lha dbang chen rta mgrin lam sna drongs: mgon 'od dpag med pa'i thugs dkar bstim: mi 'di yis thar lam zin gyuracig: zin nas phyir mi ldog par shog: kong the'u rang gi ra rdzong phab pa la: gling dpa' thul la chags 'jig med par shog mi rta la lhung brdab med par shog snyan grags labar chad med par regag: don ci bsam 'khru1ba pa'i bkra shis regag ces brjod nas rta skad gsum bsgrags pa'i rjes ma la lus ngan can de'i rnam shes sdig pa'i gzugs de lha dbang chen rol ba'i thugs garabasre 'pho mdzad nas spyo dpon khro thung rgyal po mi rta gnyis sngar las kyang brgya 'gyur gyi bkrag mdangs 'bar bar byas nas khra mo gling yul la phebs kun gyi sde len da bsu ba dga' ston chos ston mdzad rag za gser gyi sgrolams lus phung bde ba'i me tog chags pa dang bral nas 'bul bar byas so de nas chos dung dang khrims brdungs nas slong dpa' rtsal ldan pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis gtsos dmag khra shog dgu brgya dgu bcu yang shog 'bum tsho bcu

gnyis phal ba bgrang yas nub med rnams 'tshogs par byas 'dzam gling seng chen rgyal po dang spyi dpon a mye khra rgan sngags kyi dbang phyug khro thung rnams gtso bor bzhugs nasabaka' bsgros mdzad pa la spyi dpon gyis gsungs par shog skor nyer lnga byas nas rgya li mar chu yis gab shod yan chod dang kha che'i lcags ra rngams shod man chad kong the'u brag mar gnam rdzo tshun chad bskor nas 'thab na zer spyi dpon khro thung rgyal pos de mi dgos shog brgyad labago sil ba khro ya dmag shog rtsal thob 'dan ma'i shog nas 'dul rgyu gyis kha ro ta khrag mdog gi dmag sdig can shan pa' las dmag gas 'dul rgyu gyas mthon po rta rna can gya dmag g.yu lha thog 'gyur rtsal gyi gnyan dmagagis 'dul rgyu gyis phra men sha za mo'i dmag a stag dpa' mo' dmag ngar gyisa'adul rgyu gyis spre'u dkar stong khyu zil ba'i dmag sras chung dgra lha rtse rgyal gyi lha dmag gis 'dul rgyu gyis rngams shod gtum po lag dmar gyi dmagachos 'phan dar yag gi dpa' sde'i dmag gis 'dul rgyu gyis sdig pa lcags khrab can gya dmag 'jang sras rdo rje thog rgod kyi mgon dmag gis 'dul rgyu gyis lang dkar tsha chu 'o ma'i dmag dung skyong stag lha khra dkar gyi btsan sde'idamag gis btul rgyu byas na 'dra ma yag gi rnam thar 'byung rgyu e yan snyam zer dus ge sar rgyal po' thugs dgongs btang nas gsungs par 'o spyi dpon rgyal pos gsu sa pa ltar byas na las dmag khri khri 'bum 'bum la chag

da༅tsho/ / 'jig 'gro khyab rgyar des che grags yer des mtho mnga' thang stobasa'abyor la de'i che na'ang nyes med phal ba'i dmag 'di rnams snying re rje de ltar mi byed lags skyes mchog khro thu rgyal po' gsungasapa ltar na pham rgyal res mos su 'byung zla ba bcu gnyis la mtha' mi chod dka' tshegs 'o brgyal gyi gnas bgra mtha' yas pa zhig 'byung 'dug pa sa de yang ma byed nga'i nyan par gyi bsam da pyod mtshan pos rmi lam ma mkha'a'agro'i brda lung ltar bsgrubs na 'ad ltar byed rgyu yan pas gling tsho drug lha sde dkar po mtha' dmag yang dmag da bcas pa'i thugs la 'aro ga dgos gsungs nas brda sbyor rdo nge 'i glu 'dra ma yag gi gsu sa 'di ltar gnang ro oṃ dam chos ma ṇi padme sa bka' yang dag de la skyabs su mchi ma 'gro drug thar ba'i lam la drongs: ngan song skye sgo chod gyur cig tshur gson dang lha sde dkar po lo: kong ze'u rang gi dmag cha phyogs kun khyer: tsha re da las dmag chu ltar khol: sil ba khro dmag bu yug 'tshubs: kha ro rta dmag khrag char khol mthon po rta rna'i rtsi shing nyul: phra men sha za'i ha ha rgod: spre'u dkar stong zil rlung nag 'tshubs: rngam shod gtum po mun ltar gtibs: sdig pa lcags khrab thog ser khol: lang dkar tsha chu'i 'o mtsho khol

phyogs bzhi mtshams kyi dmag sna re: dmag re thul na rdzong re lon: dmag dpon wa thul mched brgyad red: shog re la gtso bo brgya bcu yod: gtso bo la las dmag stong reyod: dpa' ngar te lhag lhag bdar nas yod gling sde 'di chom la phab bsam yod: ge sar nga'i chos srid 'phrog 'dod yod: da las pa las la chas ran yin dpa' ngar zhe sdang bskyed ran yin rnon po'i so kha skor ran yin: mda' nyag phran la ngar chu blud ran yin: mchog dkar gzhu brdung byed ran yin: mgyogs pa la rta sga stod ran yin tshesa'adi yi nyi shu gsum gang nyin: lha bsang gis nam mkha' gang le gyis: lnga dmag ni cha cha bdar bdar mdzod: dpa' bo rnams snga 'gros kher rgyug dgos: spyir bkod pa khro thungabaka' ltar yang : dmag 'tshubs ma byas nas chas pa min: shar spre'u dkar stong khyu zil ba la wa thul dpa' ngar spre'u rgod de: 'byung ba bzhi la rang dbang bsgyur: gnam lha dkar po'i kha 'dzin can: sras chung dgra lha rtse rgyal gyis: mtshon ya za'i rno la drang rgyu yin: de man sus kyang 'dul skal med: cang shes rgya bya khra bo la: dung dngul mdzes pa'i

༄༅// sga stan stod:dung gi dpa' chas lhab lhub gsol:bco lnga'i zla ba tshes ltar chos:lho sil ba khro yi las dmag gi:mgo 'dzin wa thul dpa' rgod can:grorag dkar po lcags thul can:thog ser gnyis dang mnyam chas byed:'dab chags gcig la brdzus nas chas de 'dul mkhan 'dan sras bsam 'grub rtsal mda' skyen po'i rang dbang thob mi des:mgyogs pa cang shes drel sngon la:lcags kyi sga srab myur bar zhog:lcags kyi khrab rmog 'khor gsum bskor:gnam lcags thog mda' khol mo mdzod:nub phyogs kha ro ta yi dmag:khrag mtsho khol ltar chas pa yi:wa thul a bse seng lcam rgyal:glog gi lus la khyung gi mchu seng ge dkar mo chas nas 'ong :de gsodamakhan shan pa rme ru yin:rwa nag mda' gzhu 'then skor ran:mgyogs pa cang shes ra rgod la:sprin gyi rus lngags sga stan stod zangs lcags 'dres pa'i khrab rmog gsol dmar nag khrag mtsho khol ltar chas byang phyogs phra men sha za'i dmag:rtse 'dzin wa thul ab sham dred:'brug stong lngags pa'i thul ba can:nyin mtshan med

par gsod la chas:de 'dul mkhan a stag dpa' mo dang :rgya khrom pa spyang thul dkar po gnyis lus rtsal drug dpa' mdzangs ngar cha bskyed:sems dpa' ba'i zhe sdang drag tu bskul:rta mgyogs pa stong ri ra rgod gnyis:chas yo byad sga srab 'dzoms par mdzod:mi dpa' ba'i lus la go cha bgo mtshon rno ngar 'khor gsum sked par chings:stag tshang nas thon bzhin mnyam chas mdzod:yang mthon po rta rna can gyi dmag de'i mgo 'dren wa thul btsan lha rgod:bon nus mthu'i grub pa thob pa yin:las gsod gcod shan pa'i ya gyal yin:de'i ngo len g.yu lha thog 'gyur yin:da g.yu rta dung rngog sga srab zhog:g.yu chas rdo rje'i go khrab bgos 'phrul gyi zhags pa sked la bskor dug mda' ngar ma'i rno la drongs de rgyab rngam shod gtum po'i dmag:de'i rtse 'dzin wa thul ma rung ba:dpa' glang snying rte'u mgo gtum zhing khro:dmag khri sdun gcig 'dug byed mi yin:de'i ngo len chos 'phan dar yag yin:rgya chu lcags dkar po'i khrab rmog gsol:rta dung khri rngog mar sga stan bsgrigs:nam tho rangs dkar mda' rgyug rgyug mdzod:dpa' ya med

༄༅/ / de tsho 'dul rgyu yin:yang sdig pa lcags khrab can gyi dmag:de'i rtse 'dzin wa thul dpa' mdza sa can: ha mi zan dom nag spyon pa yin: lus sra brtan khrochu ngar mas grub: mtshon mi thebs rlung gi bang rtsal thob: 'di'i ngo len 'bru sras thog rgod yin sgrogs ngar ma'i cho 'phrul ston par mdzod sngags nus mthu'i zhwa gos chalugs mdzod: rta 'brong nag mgyogs par sga stan stod: sku che brngid seng ltar 'gying bzhin song : yang lang dkar tsha chu 'o mtsho' dmag de'i gtso 'dzin wa thul rdzu 'phrulacan:mig nyi zla spyang dkar rgod po yin:'og rgya mtsho'i klong nas gyen la 'phyo: stobs thog mda'i mtshon cha 'debs nas 'ong : de'i ro len dung skyong stag lhas dgos: rta mdob dung khri 'phur shes chibs: da shel lcags 'dres ma'i khrab rmog gsol mtshon cha'i bu yug 'tshub bzhin du: dpa' mdzangs ngar dang bcas te chas: rlung bsil ma yi rtsalashugs bskyed la song yang dpa' bo kher 'gros byed pa de: sngon smon lam dag pa'i thugs bskyed can: tshe dus la bab pa gcig kyang med: lus rdo rje'i brag ni 'jig

gzhom bral: sems 'od gsal nyi zlar nub pa med: da rang rang dmag dpung chas tsa na: dpa' ya med wa thul de tsho yis dmag brgya shi stong 'gyel byed nges yin: da mnyes 'gro la sdug mi gtad: yang gnam the'u dkar po gnam las byung: de'i ngo len a khu khro thung mardzad: bar the'u khra bo gshed du ldang : de zil gnon rdo rje drag rgyal yin gling bla ma rnams kyi gdung 'tshob red: sngags pa rnams kyi drag shos yin: sa the'u nag po'i cho 'phrul 'khrigs de ngam 'dogs 'om bu'i dar lu yin: de sbas pa'i rnal 'byoradam pa red: mthu mi sdug nus pa thog las che: stobs mi zhan glog dmar rlabs las myur: yang gshin khyi spyon pa dom nag la dgra bla mtshal stag dmar po gzir: srin bya yargod khra tsha la dgra bla me khyung dmar po gzir: sdig pa sbrul nag mgo dgu la: dgra bla lce spyang ngar ma gzir: mtshal mig khrag gi ya rgod la: dgra bla dung seng dkar mo gzir mdzod mig rnam dgu de nas 'byed: dpa' ngar rdzong dgu de nas lon tshes nyer lnga nas gnam gang tshun chad la dus gcig la dpa' bsdur byed rgyu dgos: phyogs mtshams

༄༅/ / nas mnyam du slebs rgyu dgos: rdzu 'phrul dang stobs rtsal 'gran res dgos: kong the'u rdzong mnyam du 'beb rgyu dgos: las dmag rnams de dus 'tshub rgyu dgos kha je'i rgyal po lcags rna can: kong gi btsan po khrom 'bar rgyal: rgya lu mar dpa' bo stag tsha rnams: bu 'dzam gling skyes bu'i 'dul skal yin: kong me tog lha mdzes sgrol ma de: gling seng chen skyes bu'i ja ma red: mdzod so so'i lde mig so sos rnyed: skyid gdan thog gcig tu 'dzom rgyu yin: gtam go na lha sde'i thugs la chongs ma gozer shākya'i dpe med rngordo: zhes gsungs nas tshes nyer gsum gyi nyin par lha bsang rang mos nam mkha' gang lha mgron rgya mtsho' bu yug 'tshub gling lha sde dkar po'i las dmag ga khyu nas dpa' ya med grags rtsal che ba'ibu brgyad dang nus mthu phul du phyin pa 'i rnal 'byor pa gsurmi seng chen dgra lha' rgyal po nor bu dgra 'dul rtsal rnams la la nam mkha' nas byon kha cig bar snang nas chas du ma sa gzhi nas rlung 'tshubs lang lang kong ze'u khache'i yul la phyogs mtshams steng 'og nas chas so de nas lha sras dgra lha rtse rgyal dngul chu'i rdzo spos 'dra gshibs ba nas phebs te gzigs tsa na shar spre'u dkar stong khyu zal ba'i dmag gi nang nas wa thul dpa' ngar spre'u rgod dang

'phrad tshe khams gsum dab sdud kyi glu 'di ltar blangs so oṃ dam chos ma ṇi padme sa: bka' yang dag 'di phyi'i skyabs su brten: nyon mongs las las skyes pa'i dgra: bsgral 'dren 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs: chur nyon dang wa thul spre'u rgod lo: dpa' rgya tsha dung zla dkar po de'i: zer sras chung dgra lha rtse rgyal yin: khyod kong the'u bsam sbyor ngan pa tshos: nor phrogs pa'i 'phrog lan snyogs mi yin: rta ded pa'i ra mda' thon mi yin: da yan chod shi ba ma yin te phyogs mtshams kyi rdzong khag phab byas nas khom dal nged la ma mchis pas da bar mi khom pa de lan: dpa' mdzangs stobs la skrag pa min nyi ma de ring dus tshod la: mda' ngar ma'i rno 'phrul brdar rgyu yin: dgung a sngon mthong ba da snga yin sa dog mo mthong ba de ring tsam khyod lus sems gnyis ka 'bral ran yin: sgrag mi dgos dkon mchog ra mda' yod: nga gsod gcod las kyi shan pa yin thams cad 'dren pa'i sangs rgyas yin khyod la dad

༄༅/ / pa mchis sam ci: dad na bzang 'brel chos la 'god: ma dad rno ngar mda' la 'dri: shar rdo rje sems dpa'i zhing la bkod: bon las ngan sdig pa'i lagami gtong : bdud the'u rang dam srir bla mi 'chor: khyod go na sems kyi dkyil du shog: ma go na'ang tshe dus byed: ces rdo rje'i gsungs bsgrags tshe wa thul spre'u rgod des bsam pa la 'di dpa' thuladapa 'a rgod ya med zhig yin pa ra snang yis kho thub na rab red min yang phyogs mtshams kyi wa thul gcig man na'ang gcig gis los thub snyam nas zhe sdang sbrul gyi dug lce bdar bzhin tu glu lan 'di ltar gdab bo skyed ma tri mu ye sa le 'du: bon g.yung drung lha la skyabs su mchi: the'u rang bla mi'i thugs rjes mkhyen gnam lha dkar pos kha 'dzin mdzod: rgya tsha'i bu ro ga sdug gis da bu mchi mar tshural nyon: 'byung ba sa 'di rdul la babs: khyod sha yi chu bur gtor rdugs med 'byung ba chu 'di rmang nas bskam: khyod khrag gi thigs pa zong re bkram: 'byung ba me khams thalabar byed khyod drod kyi me stag yal bar sla: 'byung ba rlung chen skad cig sdud: khyod dbug gi sbub chu 'dren rgyu med: nyi zla gdan du bting ba na: khyod rlung sems ga'u kha phrol

sla mi chung chung 'ur 'go mthon po can: rta chung chung rin gong mthon po can: stong len nor snyogs a ba ris: khyod de ring 'di nas phar mi thar: bza' rogs la chags zhenabyed khom med yul sde la kha chems 'jog khom med: phyi ma la bsam blo gtong khom med: dpa' khyod kyis sgug dang nga yis sgug ngas mda' 'phen gsod pa dus mnyam yin gtam bo na da bu'i sems la zungs ma skrag na yang bros thar dka' zhes zer ba' lan du dgra lhas mtshon ya za phyed phyung mdzad nas sga'i snga ru'i steng na phyed 'gye gis langs te tshig gsum 'dra ma'i glu 'diltar blangs so oṃ sku gsum ston mchog pad 'byung mkhyen: gnas rnga yab gling nas myur bar byon: las ngan pa'i bag chags sdug po can: 'di thar ba'i zhing la 'dren du gsol bu dpa' bo'i mtshon gyi so ngar brdar: lha chos skyong srung ma'i bu yug 'tshubs: 'di yar ngos gsum la dkar brdung byas: dkar phyogs skyong bas kha 'dzin mdzod: mar ngos gsum la nag brdung byas: nag phyogs gdug pa'i mgo 'phang gnon dkar nag 'dres mar 'jam brdung byas: 'jam mgon bla ma'i phyag mtshan yin de ring dge sdig dus

༄༅/ / babs pas: mda' khyod kyis 'phong dang nga yis sgug: mtshon nga yis dbyug go khyod kyis sgug: snga bzhugs mi dgos mnyam chas byed: rtsal ci yod pa de khyod kyis phyungs shed ci yod pa de nga yis bskyed ki bso cha'o lha rgyal ma : zhesabasgrags nas ya zi nam mkha' la phyar bas gnam ze'u dkar po'i thod rgyan me long bcad bar then bo'i lha 'dre'i bkab skung gtor sa the'u nag po'i nad kya sbal skye bral ba'i skabs su kho rang spre'u rgod kyis dug mda' ngar ma spring ba lha sman sdong grogs sum cus brten nas ngar dbyung mdzad kyang khrab dkar gyi leb byang gsum bcad nas brag sbra tsam pagacig la zebs te gtor bar byas so de nas ral gri ya zi skar bkra btab pas yung sa dkar me la bsregs pa bzhin du wa thul de'i lugasems lhag lus med par rdul du brlags spre'u dkar stong khyu'i dmag sde'i ja thab dmigasanas thab gsur gyis nam mkha' gang bred dngangs kyis dmag dpung brgyal kun gyi brgyal sangs tsa na sras chung dgra lha'i zhabs spyi bor blangasanasabran du khas blangs dung brag nor bu' rdzong gi lde mig phyag tu rted nas bsam pa'agrub bo de nas 'dan sras nor bu gzi brjid bsam 'grub rtsal rgya la mar chu yi shod mtshon cha gzengs 'dra nas phebs te gzigs tsa na lho sil mar khro yi las dmag khro chu khol ma ltar 'tshubs pa' na nas wa thul dpa'

rgod 'gran gyi do med gro rag lcags thul dkar po can da 'phrad tshe gdug pa snyi 'dar gyi glu 'di ltar bla sa so oṃ dam chos ma ṇi padme sa bka' yang dag chos la gsol ba 'debs: gnas ngan dre ngagasum gyi rba klong las: 'dren mdzad kyi bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen:tshur nyon dang wa thul gro rag lo: nga skyes bu'i rgyu mchan ma shes na: khra mo gling mkhar stod nas yin gling tshodrug lha sde dkar po las: 'dan dmag khri skor bcu gnyis kyi: rtse 'dzin 'dan ma bee ḍūrya'i: sras chung bsam 'grub thogs med yin: mngon spyod drag po sgrub mi yin: skyenapo'i rang dbang thob mi yin:grub chen sha ba ri pa yin: rje 'bangs sog po lha dpal yin gdug can gsod pa'i phur thogs yin: bsad tshad 'dren pa'i sangs rgyas yin gling chung rgyud mu spyang sde bzhi yi: rtse 'dzin rgyal po mchungs zla med dpa' rgya tsha bco lnga'i zla zhal la: mi 'tshams nyes pa sna tshogs pa khyod kong the'u phyogs kyis byas pa yin da yan chad khyod kyis zos zhim red: nyi ma de ring dus tshod la: nor len stong snogs thon ni yin: wa thul dpa' rgod gro rag lo: khyod rnam shes bsgal mkhan nga las med

༄༅/ / phung po rdul brlag mtshon cha nga: 'dren pa'i pho nyar sngags pa nga khyod dad pa bskyed na zhi bas 'dren: log 'dren rgol na drag pos 'dul: chu tshod tsam gyi dus tshod la: khyod 'di snang 'dug pa'i skal ba med: gtam go na sems kyi dkyil du zhog ma go na yang thar 'chor med: ces brda sprad kyi glu thos tshe wa thul dpa' rgod gro rag lcags thuladakar po can de'i mig gnyis nya zla'i 'od zer sbres mdzub mo 'a rtser gnam lcags kyi thog ser khol bzhin du 'gran ya med pa 'a dpa' ra gyis glu lan 'di ltar gdab bo skyed ma tri mu ye sa le 'du: g.yung drung bon la skyabs su mchi: nam mkha' sprin gyi gur nang nas: the'u rang bla ma'i skyabs mgon mdzod: dgung sngon nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor nas: la dga' rab dbang phyug gis kha 'dzin mdzod: glu sna gnam the'u dkar pos brten kha 'dzin bar the'u khra bos gyis sdong grogs sa the'u nag pos mdzod kong the'u ra srid pa gnam la 'gran: nam mkha' yangs pa'i khyab rgyar mnyam: ko the'u rang gi dpa 'a brjid sa la 'gran rgya che dpang mtho sra brtan brjid: kong the'u 'phrul rtsar 'byung bzhir 'gyed: 'dzad pa med pa bsam mtha'

mas: khyed gling sde srid pa tha ma tsam: 'dan ma sngo ske mi yi glud: khyod de bas tha chad bu ngan yin nyi ma da snga yan chod la: mi stong gsod kyi shan pa lag dmar yin: khri gsod kyi sdig can thar med yin: 'bum gsod pa'i bon gyi phyag brnyan yin: rnam smin las 'di myong sems med: lha bdud dga' rab dbang phyug de'i phyag mthil bkod nas 'jog pa yin: dmyal khams gnas la gtong ba min 'dren mkhan stag la me 'bar yod: khyod gling phrug a bra kha ser la: 'di phyi'i re ltos bcol ba min: brag ri rtse gsum la ltad mo gyis che ba mi bshig pha dang 'dra: 'bring ba mi gzhom ma dang mtshungs: chung ba de la ci 'byung ltos: phra rab rdul gyi char phye ni: las ngan khyod la de 'byung ran:3dra ma'i dpe la ltad mo gyis gtam go na gling sdug sems la zhog: ma go na'ang thar ba med ces zer nas mdzub mo'i rtse'i thog zer brag rdo rje ya gam can gyi rtse bar ma la btab pas phye phung bzhin du bshig brdul gtor gsum byas zog zer 'dan sras mi rta gnyis la reg tsa na thugs bsngangs yid tsam byung ba las gnod rgol gyi glag blta bar ma nus so de ma thag 'dan sras bsam 'grub 'bar ba rtsal gyis mda' nyag phran

༄༅/ / gzhu steng la bzhag nas mi 'gyur 'phar ldang dang bral ba'i glu 'di ltar blangs so oṃ dam chos ya ma rwa tsa sa: 'jam dpal gzhon nus glu sna drongs: gshin rje gshed pos sdong grogs mdzod: dus gsum sangs rgyas mkhyen par gsol ngas baspu med bden pa'i tshig gsum bshad: steng nam mkha' stong pa'i dbyings rum du: gza' brgyad rgyu skar bkra zhing gsal: snang dang stong pa zung 'jug 'di: stong pa rten 'byung bslu med yin dwangs shing gsal ba'i rgya mtsho ru chu zla gzugs brnyan snang ba bkra: gsal stong zung du'ajug pa'i chos: 'od gsal 'gags med bden pa yin: sems nyid bdag med dbyings klong du kun rtog 'gyu ba bgrang mtha' yas: 'gyu dang stong pa zung 'jug 'di: rigapa rang byung 'gags med yin de baspu ba med pa'i bden pa gsum: bden tshig 'gyur ba med pa'i mthus: ci bzhin 'gro don 'byung bar shog: de ring 'dra ma'i tshig gsumabashad: nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: lto 'brug byang ma lhaja lhang grags: thog ser gnyis kyis phrin las 'gyed gang btab brlag nges 'dra ma red: rgya mtsho

dwangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas:klu bdud nag po'i ngar skad 'don:mdze phol mig gnyis ka mnyam chas red:gang btab gsod nges 'dra ma red:rgya li mar khro chu'i las dmag drung btsan po rtse dgu'i brag gi gam:bu dpa' bo 'dan sras thog rgod phebs mda' nyag phran pho nya spring ba ni: rgya stag tshang nas thon pa 'dra:dom nag po khrag gis brgyag pa 'dra 'og dug mtsho 'phyur ba'i ngar rlangs 'dra:wa thul dpa' rgod lcags thul can: sbur ma me dang 'phrad pa bzhin: da ltar brlag nges 'dra ma yin:'dra ma gsum gyi bden tshag 'di:bdud ma rung sdig can 'di la rtsol: phar ltos dang lcags kyi sdong po gsum:gong ma'i steng lcags kyi bya khyung 'gyed: der mi 'phen drin chen pha dang mtshungs:'dab ma la dngul gyi dung khyung lding : der mi 'phen drin chen ma dang mtshungs: bar ma la khro chu'i khyung phrug rtse: 'di bdud rgan khyod dang 'dra le red: mda' 'phen pa'i stobs rtsal de la ltos:pha bka' brgyud bla ma drin chen mkhyen:mda' sna drongs la 'pho lam phyes:ngan song 'khor ba'i skye sgo khogs:mtho ris thar pa'i lam sna dro sa:gnas g.yu lo bkod

༄༅/ / pa 'i zhing khams nas: ma rgyud rje btsun sgrol ma mkhyen mda' sna drongs la 'pho lam phyes: ngan song 'khor ba'i skye sgo khogs: dag pa'i zhing du lam sna drongs: rang snang 'od gsal dpal ri nas: rig pa rang snang pad 'byung mkhyen: mda' sna drongs la 'pho lam phyes lta log bon gyi bstan pa bsnubs: g.yung drung bdud sde'i gshed ma khrol: rig 'dzin zhing du lam sna drongs: mda' 'phen 'phen gro rag khyod la 'phen: don rtogs rtogs gnas lugs rang ngo shes: da chos sku'i zhing la 'dun pa gtod:sprul sku'i phrin las mthar phyin regag ces zer nas mda' la ma ra mtshal gyi mag dgu can sprangs te lcags myo bar ma khro chu' khyung da bcas pa ma cam mi ma 'a bar yu med du bsregs zer ngar 'phul rtsal sngar las brgya 'gyur bcas tshur byu wa thul gro rag lcags thul dkar po can de'i don snod tshal bar gtub rnam shes dpal rir bkod nga ga rlu dang 'dres phu po rdul du bshig nas 'byung lnga'i lha la bstabs par byas sil ma khrochus dmag gi ra bsad dpa 'a bko gtso bo brgyad sgral 'dren byas 'khor gyi las dmag thams cad dbang du bsgyur nas gli chos sde' la gral la 'khod par dam mamos zhal bzhes thob pa ra 'gyur ro gser brag byu ru ra rdzo nga

gi lde'u mig phyag tu rnyed nas bsam pa 'grub bo de nas sdig can shan pa rme rus dug zer gyi bu yug 'tshubs 'tshubs mtshon cha'i sgar mda' thor thor nub gong kha'i gnam lcags brag sgo bcu gsum gtor nas ya tsha 'brug stong gi khas kha nas phebs tsa na nub kha ro ta ya las dmag khrag mtsho khol ba ltar dmar nag rub rub 'tshubs pa'i gral dbus na wa thul a bse seng lcam thog rgyal zer ba glog gi lus la khyung gi mchu can seng ge dkar mo'i bang rtsal dang ldan pas mdun thad du slebs tsa na rol ba gar gyi glu 'di ltar blangs so oṃ padma kro ta rā dza sa: gnas 'bar ba chen po'i klong dkyil nas: rme bar brtsegs pa'i thugs rjes zungs: ma la ya yi rtse mo nas: mgon po legs ldan grogs la chos byang dur khrod he chen brdal ba nas: gnod sbyin rme rus kha 'dzin mdzod: glu sna lha dang srung mas brten: tshur nyon dang wa thul a bse lo: nga ngo khyod kyis ma shes na sdig can shan pa rme ru yin hor sde cham la phab pa yis sdig pa lcags kyi bu rgod yin 'jang sde thabs kyis len pa yi: mu sprang lcags kyi sha zung yin: mon sde stobs kyis 'phrog pa yi:

༄༅/ / thog lcags rgyal gyi rgod po yin: sog li khri rang dbang bsgyur ba yi: thabs mkhas zangs kyi lde mig yin: kong the'u ra rdzong phab pa yi dpa' bo rgya stagaya med yin: dpon dgra lha'i nor khyer ra mda' yin nub kha ro ta yi dmag dpung tsho: brgya 'tshogs kha lo byed mi yin: stong 'tshogs mgo lo gtong mi yin khri 'tshogasadamar nyil brlag mi yin: 'bum tshogs rlung la gtor mi yan:khyod dpa' bo yin yang 'thab ya sdug:rnon po yod kyang g.yug ya sdug:shed can yin yang bsdur ya sdug gnam a sngon dkyil gyi nyi zla las: ngas su la mgo bos btud ma myong :sa gzhi rin chen 'di nyid las: nga'i rkang pa su la gtad ma myong :gling lha sde'i seng chen rgyal po las phar ltos dpon po yod ma myong : de ring snang ba'i skyid lugs la dpa' ngar khro chu khol khol 'dra: mngon spyod me rlung 'tshubs 'tshubs 'dra:drag rtsal gnam lcags thog zera'adra dpa' 'gran na wa thul seng lcam lo khyod la nus pa mchis sam ci:mchis na de ring bsdur ran yin:dgung a sngon las ni ltad mo med:rlung bsil mar bas ni phrin

pa med gtam bo/ na sems kyi dkyil du chogag: ma bo 'a31ra med lcags shākya'i zin: zhes bsgrags tshe wa thul a bse seng lcam thog rgyal des g.yu ral mgo nas sprugs slog dmar lus las 'tshubs khyung mchu'i skad kya nga ros ri rnams shig shig 'gul sa gzhi yol yol 'dar chu mtsho chal chal gtor bar byas nas dpa 'a ra stag mos ra glus lan 'di ltar btab bo tsho/ ma tri mu ye sa le 'du: bon g.yung dru lhal gsol ba 'debs: mi mngon stong pa'i dbyings rum nas mu stegs ston pa sde drug gis: kha 'dzin gyis la sdong grogs mdzod: phra ma mkhan khyod chur la nyon: khyod gragasayer che ba ngas ma thos: bu rgod yin pa ngas ma go: hor gur dkar rgyal pos bu bzhin bskyangs: tha ma gling la nang bla btso : gur dkar gsod pa'i nang ma yin hor sde phabapa'i phongs rgan yin: 'jang la mgo btsong 'grigs mi yin: mon ya de ltar byed mi yin: rgod po yin pa nga sa ma go: nyin nyin pho sa pa'i gzhi ma yin: kong the'u ra gi raba'i rdzong khag brgyad gces spras nor gyi gter kha brgyad yang mdzod dam pa rnam gsum 'di gnam the'u dkar po'i srung ba che: bar the'u khra bos mel tshe byed: sa the'u nag

༄༅/ / pos kha mgon mdzad: g.yung drung bon gyis srung skyob byas: mu stegs ston pa sde drug gis: phyi mi 'gyur gnam lcags gzer bus gdab: nang mi nub rinachen gter khas byur: mnga' bdag kha che kong dang rgya: de las gling phrug yin rab med: khyod da sngon skyes skyes phongs la skyes: de ring pham pham sgog la pham: yang ltos dang ltadamo 'di 'dra gda': 'brong bre btsan ru dar can gsum 'gro: snga ma mi gsod pha dang 'dra: phyi ma mi btul ma dang 'dra: bar gyi 'brong phrug ngar can la: ci 'byung khyod la 'byunganges yin yar ltos a sngon dbyings la ltos glag gshog drug rtsal ldan gsum yang 'phur: sngar ma mi gnag pha dang 'dra: phyir ma mi gtad ma da bhe 'dra: bar gyi rog mo ngaracan la: ci 'byung khyod la 'byung nges yin mar ltos tsher nag shing drung ltos: dom nag po khrag gis brdzus pa gsum: snga ma ma yin pha dang 'dra: phyi ma de bzhin ma dang 'dra bar gyi dom bu snying sdug la: ci 'byung khyod la 'byung nges yin: gtam go na gdol ba'i sems la zhog: ma go bsngangs kyang bzlog med yin: zhes zer nas khyung mchus rlung rngub byed tshe

glag rog mo bar ma de nyid gyur mid byed lag g.yas kyi sder mos brab pas 'brong dar ma bar gyi nyul ma de thal bar brlag lag g.yon gyi sder mos dom bu khrag gis bzi ba'i bar ma de rngams zas su byas rkang pa gnyis kyi sderabagrad sdig can shan pa la brgyab tshe mi rta gnyis sa la 'gyel tsam zhig byas de ma thag par sdag can shan pas rwa nag mda' gzhu 'azen skor byas mtheb mdzub gnyis kyi nga ra shed bskyed mgyogs pa cang shes ra rgod la phyed 'byi gis bcibs nas kha 'khrigs ngo 'khrags dpa' ngar 'brags nas mi thar bzlog dka'i glu 'di ltar blangs so glu ha la gling sde'i len lugs yin ma tha la ngag gi 'gugs lugs red: skyabs bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum: tshe 'di yi skyabs dang phyi ma'i mgon: mi bdag la kha 'dzin sdong grogs mdzod: las ngan pa mang bsags sdig can 'dis rtag chad kyi lta la bdag bzung byas: chags sdang gi rgyal pham a 'thas rtsod: sangs rgyas kyi bstan par rgyab 'gal byas: sems can la gnod 'tshe'i bya ba brtsams: 'jog mi lo bdud kyi grogs po yin: bsad bzhag na rnam shes thar med yin: 'dis lam sna dkon mchog

༄༅/ / gsum gyis drongs: gnas nga na song gsum gyi skye sgo khogs gling la sde chags pa chos kyis phyug: kong 'phan dar 'dzoms pa dpa 'a thul red:mgon sangs rgyas dngos byon ge sar yin:nged dpa' rgod ya med skyes bu rnams:dpal grub chen brgyad cu'i sprul pa yin:las mngon spyod thogs med 'grub pa red:sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin mi yin:sems can la bde skyid spel mkhan yin:lta log gi bstan pa snub mkhan yin:khyod kong the'u'i the'u rang ra rdzong 'di:dpa' ya med skyes bu rnam brgyad des:phyogs mtshams nas rdzong khag len rgyu yin skyabs the'u rang dam la 'dogs rgyu yin:yang gces rgyal po rnam pa gsum:rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis 'dul rgyu yin:mnga' tha stobs 'byer len rgyu yin:kong me tog lha mdzes sgrol ma de:gling ge sar zhabs tog phul mi yin: bla zog gcan gzan 'dab chags tshogs:dgra bla dag gis 'dul rgyu yin:dpa' ya med wa thul a bse rgyal:khyod 'dul mkhan nga las yod le min nga phongs rgan gyis su phongs khyod nyid pho sa:brlag rgan gyis su brlag khyod nyid

brlag lag dmar gyis su gsod khyedad nyid gsod: khyod mabo lngags bkog nas seng ltar bsha': pags thul phud nas stag ltar bsha': sder tshogs bcad nas wa ltar bsha': snying rtsa nag khro chu'i mda' yis gtor: mig nyi zla'i 'od zer mun pas bcom lus lhu drug ra ba drug la gtor: khyod zangs kyi khyi mo rnam drug 'gyed: de'i gnya' gnon dpa' rtsal gzig drug 'gyed: mtsho nag po dug gi ra ba can: de'i gting rum lcags kyi tha ram bcud: de bar bskal gcig la thar ba med: gtam de tsho go na bdud rtsi myang : ma sgo bsgral 'dren dus gcig yin: zhes zer nas rwa nag gzhu la dug mda' gdug pa 'a snying 'byin dra sa nas spri wa thul a bse se snam thog rgyal de'i ma/go snags bsas nas sga ste nu bkod pa gas zul bkog nas lus la bgos lus lhu drug yul sa drug tu gtor de zangs kyi khyi mo drug tu 'gyed na rdzu 'phrul gzig drug 'gyed nas bzung la mtsho nag dug gi ra ba can gyi gting rum lcags kyi tha ram du btsud nas brtson la bzu lasal gzhi rnam par shes pa snying rtsa nag mda' yis gtor ba dang mnyam du bde ldan padmo bkod pa 'i bya chub kyi shing dru gi pad ma'i ze 'brur bkod dpa' rtag dgra la ro ma nas mtshon brdar tshe kha ro ta'i las dam ga byis chu khra

ra༅༅/ / yas bcum pa bzhin sdig can shan pa sa bka' la nyan zhing dam la 'dusanas 'khor byas par khas blangs so nub zangs sgo'i go khrab mtshon gyi lde mig lag tu 'byor nas bsam pa 'grub bo de nas a stag dpa' ba'i klu mo dang rgya khrom pa sbyang thul dkar po gnyis me stag chad chad cha la khol khol rlung nag 'tshubs 'tshubs byas te li yul stag sgo gzig tshang rong nas chas te mthon po 'aprong nag thur rgyug gi rtse nas bud de gzigs tsa na phra men sha za 'dre mo'i dmag gis mi sha la tab thob mi khrag la tsub sgra mi rta gsod gcod kyi las byed pa'i gral nas wa thul nag mo ab sham dred kyis rngam stabs can rlung bsil mar la bcibs ma ṭaṃ mgo sgra'i zhags pa gru morabaskon ral gri ya tsa me 'bar dang bam chen ro yi phyag cha 'dzin bzhin du skad cig gas thog mda' bab bzhin dpa' yang rgod skyes bu gnyis kyi mdun du slebs tsa na rgya khrom pa spyang thul dkar po des blo sems dbang du bsgyur ba'i glu'adi ltar blangs so oṃ a dkar a dmar du tri ye: nag po zhi zhi mal mal 'du: g.yung drung bon gyi lha la 'dud gnam lha dkar po'i kha 'dzin mdzod: the'u rang bla mas glu sna 'then: tshur nyon dang

wa thul ab sham dred:kong dang kha che rgya gsum gyi:srid skyong dam pa rnam gsum de'i:dbang thang dpal kha srung ba'i mi:nga khrom pa spyang thul dkar po yin:gling phrug a bra khaser gyis mon blon dung skyong stag lha des:mi bden rdzun gyi la yog bton:nga spyang thul glen nas dbang du bsgyur:dung gi zhags pas dam du bsdams:khra mo gling gi yul lakhyer:nga'i dpa' ngar stobs rtsal ngom byas nas:gling tsho drug lha sde dkar po la mi rta chags 'jig ri ltar bsnyil:ja thab dkrugs nas bar snang bkang :gling khro thung rgyalapo'i ja ma de'i: blo sems snang ba dbang du bsgyur:kong the'u rang gnam lha'i mnga' 'og 'dir:nged gnyis ka 'dra ma yag gis phebs:dmag ra mda' byung na ji ltar byed mda' nyag phran 'gran na gang ltar dgos:stobs rdzu 'phrul 'byed na ci 'dra dgos khyod wa thul brgyad kyi yang snying yin:gtso bo brgyad kyi spyi dpon yin:kha che rgyal po'i tsha mo yin:the'u rang bla ma'i slob bu yin:dris na gtam gsal ngag na yod:brdar na rno ngar lag na yod:sbran na thogs rdugs med par yod:'byung ba lnga la rang dbang thob

༄༅/ / steng gnam lha'i zhags pa lag na yod: 'og klu yi dug mda' khong na yod: sman 'di tsho skye yag wa tsho sman: mkhon nag po'i gzhi ma 'phrog nas 'ong : rgyad nag po'i thab rdo btsugs nas yod: gling lha sde'i dmag dpung bskul nas yod: gtam de tsho sems kyi gting du 'bul: da gtam lan bdud rtsi gnang bar zhu: zhes zer tshe wa thul nag mo ab sham dred kyi rngam stabs can des lus g.yug g.yug gi thul ba sprugs mgo ral ba'i dug sprin bsdus khas mi sha gyur mad la btang nas da rgya khrom pa spyang thul dkar po 'ad bden yang srid mi rigs rus snya stobasa'agran ya dang bral ba yin rdzun ya srid gling ge sar 'di mi sprul dgu sprul khro thu tsho mi brtsam dgu brtsams da snga yang phyogs bzhi'i rdzong khag phab bdud chen sde bzhi bsgral 'dren byas da skabs kong the'u ra gi ra rdzo la chu mosbrul lo chag 'jig pho thal yod pa ze'u rang bla mas gsungs yod pas mngon par shes pas brtags dgos snyam nas sems lcags kyi bya pho bye leb tsam du sprul nas khra mo gling la bltas tshe tsho drug lha ste dkar po mtsho la dar chags dar la rdul babs byas nas 'dug gling khro thung gser ba'i shog gas rgya khrom pa dpa' bas las byas mtshon gyi ngar gzir te shi bsad kyis lung pa gang 'gro ba tsam byas song zer nas bla dra sa dang chos zhu byed pa mthong ge sar

rgyal po 'a sgom mnyam bzhag skyo zhing sgrub pa 'i mtshams khang du dam rgya bcad nas bzhugs pa da gli dpa 'a rgod dam pa sum cus gros bsgrigs nas shi pho rta la kong the'u ra rdzo pha ba dgos zer ba'i 'dun gtam pa mthong de'i tshe sems dga' ba'i lang tsho sgyu lus la brten te rgya khrom pa'i gtam la lan 'debs gser gyi me tog 'di ltar gtor ro glu tha trang tha trang tha trang len: ma tha trang ngag gi 'gug lugs yin: tsos ma tri mu ye sa le'adu: g.yung drung bon la gsol ba 'debs: mu stegs ston pas rjes su zungs: dga' rab dbang phyug kha 'dzin mdzod: the'u rang bla mas glu sna brten: tshur nyon dang khrom paspyang thul lo: khyod dpa' bo'i nang gi ya med yin dung skyong stag lha'i bcing zer te: bden yang thang la rdzun yang srid: nga'i sems gnyis zhugs pa'i rgyu ru 'dug khyod rdzu'aphrul sprul pa bsam mi khyab: mu stegs lta ba dang len byas bud med bdud mo khrid pa 'di: bden yang thang la rdzun yang srid nga yid mi ches pa'i skyon du 'dug: rgya chingasargyal po rnam gsum gyi: thugs kyi bu chen khyod yin pas: nang bla phyir btsong e yod bsam phyi sna nang khrid e yod snyam: bden gtam dris na bden tshig bshad: tshes 'di yi
