༄༅/ / nya gang nyin par la: ngas thod pa'i dug sgrom khyer ba rmis: rgya khrom pa spyang thul dkar po la: legs nyes chag 'jigs 'byung ngo snyam: de rjes rmi lamagasal ba'i ngor: mdzub sha mi yis bza' mi mthong : lcags mi zan dom bu snying sdug 'di: srin gyi rwa dzas khyer song snyam: de rjes rmi lam gsal ba'i ngor: ngas lta byed kyimig gcig zhar ba rmis brgya stong gsod bya khra mgo dmar la: gdon rta mgo can zhig zhugs par snyam so the'u khas kha rnam pa gsum: ri nyil brag zhig yul stongs byung kong the'u rang shog chen so drug la mgyogs pa'i rta sga stod shog spros: rnon po lus la thogs shog smros: dpa' rtsal dug chu 'thuja shog spros: da ma nyal ma phyi lan gsum smos rgya li mar phyogs 'di kha rgya che: stod kha che'i rgyal khab nga ro mtho: kong the'u rang rdzong khag brgyad po 'di'i: dpa' ya med wa thul brgyad pos kyang : sems mi gcig nga che ngabatsan bshad: khar sang nyi shu gsum pa la rka 'dun ma'i 'dus bshad 'grags ma thub go khrab dang mtshon ngo blang rgyu ral dgra chom la phab pa'i kha brda lhag: gnyen sgog

gcig bsre ba'i dam tshig g.yel bon mkha' 'gro'i lde mig bskungs ma thub: rdzong ra ba'i rgya sgo bcad ma thub: phyogs swā su so sor tshom 'gor byas: yul wa thul brgyad po'adzung ma 'phrod: tshag rta rgyug byed par gros ma khom: dmag thon 'ong snyam nas sems 'khrugs lang khyod bshad pa'i gtam de bden nges na ngas 'dra ma yag gi gros gtam bshad: yang nyon dang khrom pa spyang thul lo: khyod nang mi yin na snying gtam bshad sems phyir kyu yin yang la thang med: grogs bud med 'di tsho dpa' thul gzugs: dpa' ya med yin na la thang med pho sdar kha yi tshig kyan min: mo sdar lag gi zas kyang min: rang phyogs kyi mgron yag yin snyam nas: tshig gsum smra'o legs par nyon gling tsho drug lha sde'i spyi dpon de: bu ge sar rgyal po rdzu 'phrul che: mnyam bzhag ting 'dzin bden mthu thob: de'i dgongs pas bkab yog ma yin na: nged kong the'u blo rgya ring po 'dug zla ba bcu gnyis 'khrugs rtsod zer dpa' rgod rang gi ma lon na: rgyal kha mi la mi 'chor zer nang mdzod ra ba brgyad po 'di'i: phyi so srung wa thul mched brgyad yin:

༄༅// nang so chas las dmag bu yug 'tshubs:lde mig bon lha gnam )sman brgyad 'dzin mkhan yin la bar snang gnas:gsang mdzod rdzong chen rnam pa gsum srung mkhan bla mkhar dpa' rtags yin:spyod mkhan rgyal po mched gsum yin:lde mig kong sman lha mos ster:'di gnas pa rang re'i yul na gnas smon lam ge sar glingal thebs:'di'i kha ngo dkar yang e bden bsam:zhe sems drang la e gnas bsam lde mig gzhan la e ster bsam:dpal mdzod mi la e 'chor snyam:nga ma gtogasa'adi 'dra bsam mkhan med:las 'di yong thabs e yod bsam:gnam gang la gzhan dbang e bsgyur snyam:sems glo ba ma bde snying ma dga':gling rgyal khams kun labaskor ba byas:mi nyal rta nyal byas nas yod:dmag ngar bskyed bso sgra sgrog gin med mgyogs rta sga stod dang mtshon brdar med:de dmu gab min na blo sems bde 'on kyang snying sdug sangs ma thubasnyed sngon 'di 'dra sdug ma myo :de la brtag gzhig btang ba na:dbang thang mi la shor ngo 'dra:nga'i dpral ba'i dkyil gyi me long nyams

grogs dga' rab dbang phyug g.yel song snyam: sems mchong gur spug po gyes thal snyam: mda' ngar ma'i rno la e 'chor snyam: sems rlung kha'i dar cog bskyod pa 'dra gzhan pha rol dbang la 'gro shes che: ngas rang sha rang gis za ba rmis: nang mi gcig gis bla dbyen byed: de nges pa thag chod 'dra bas na: mi khyed kyang e bden bsam pa'abyung : the tshom shor ba dgra la bsgyur: rgya khrom pa spyang thul dkar po lo nged gnyis ka rgya khra gcig tu sprul steng the'u rang bla ma'i mdun la 'gro: chos srid kyi legs nyes del zhu kong the'u rang gi so chas de la 'dri: zhes zer nas rgya khra dkar nag gnyis la sprul nas steng nam mkha' la 'phur tshe gnam bsod rgyal mos thog mda' rta mgo tsam zhig springs nas wa thul gyi sprul pa'i rgya khra nag pode rdul phran bzhin du brlag tshe rnam shes rus sbal nag po mgo dgu zhig tu gyur nas hub mid kyi skad sgra da bcas te a stag klu mo'i drung du slebs tsa na thog mda' gzhu steng du bzhag nas che ba stobs da ldan pa'i glu 'ad ltar blangs so oṃ ārya tā re hūṃ swā hā: ma rgyal yum sgrol ma'i kha 'dzin mdzod: mi lus ngan dam sri mngon rgyug 'di: gnas g.yu lo bkod par lam sna drongs: skyabs bslu med o rgyan rin po

༄༅/ / ches tshe 'di phyi gnyis kyis skyabs mgon mdzod: las mang bsags bag chags 'thug po che: gnas rnga yab dpa' rir lam sna drongs: zhing o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling dbus nas ma dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i kha 'dzin mdzod: nga'i kha ngo dkon mchog gsum la 'khor: 'dun ma ge sar bzhed don sgrub: 'dun phugs dam pa'ichos 'di bsam: 'jig lta'i g.yul ngo macom na bsam: lta log bstan pa bsnubs na bsam: chos mdo sngags bstan pa dar na bsam: sgrub pa' rgyal mtshan 'dzugs nabasam: bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mang na bsam: de la dpal 'byor rgyas na bsam: ra ba'i rdzong khag 'phrog na bsam: dpal 'byor gling la rgyas na bsam: nga nag mo sdigasems che bas min bsam pa gsod la dga' bas min shan pa'i gral snyogs bsams nas min khyod las rgya dkon mchog gsum gyis zin bsgral nas dag pa'i zhing labakod sems ni dug sbal mgo dgu srid yul dgu phung pa'i smon lam btab de'i smon log gi sa bon skem pa'i phyir: nga'i ra ba'i nang nas mda' dgu blangs: mchog

dkar gzhu mo'i 'gugs la bkod: mtheb 'dzub dug mda' ngar bskyed spring : dug sbal mun pa'i mgo dgu la nga dpa' mo'i mda' dgu thebs nges byed: lha sgrub sde dgu yis lam sna drongs: 'khrul mi shes pa'i sa ru skyol gling bla ma rnams kyis thugs rjes zungs: ge sar bzhed don 'grub par 37ga ces brjod nas mda' 'phang tshe me yi tsha tsha 'phro bzhin du dug sbal mgo dgu la thebs pas bag chags bsregs las ngan sbyangs rnam shes rig 'dzan rgyal ba'i zhing du gling ge sar rgyal po' thugs bskyed kyi mthus grol bar gyur to rgya khrom pa spyang thul dkar po can des sha za mi srun sde brgyad dung gi zhags pas bcings 'phrul gyi mda' gzhus zhe sdang bcom par byas te ri rta rna 'dzin gyi byang ngos mun pa'i gling rum du pha bong mkhar tsam pa' 'og tu mnan phra men sha za'i dmag de la lcag tshan gyis brab rdo dang dbyug pas bsnun kun kyang 'dar byed byed yed med byed bzhin rgya khrom pa spyang thul dang a stag dpa 'a mo'i las dmag gi gral du 'dug par mna' bor byang lcags sgo dkar po nor gyi lde mig a stag dpa' mo la sprad nas bsam don 'grub bo de nas 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur shar lho mthon po ri drug nas brgal te rta shod rdo rje'i khra sgo mthon po nas gzags tsa na mthon po rta rna can gyi dmag rtsi shing las lhun 'thug dung ri las mdangs 'bar nags

ra byu/ / ri las dpa 'a mdzangs phyug brag ri che brjid lhun mtho las ngam nag zang nge 'dug pa mtho de'i rtse 'dzin wa thul btsan lha rgod po khyung dmar la zhon dug sgrul la rol 'phrul gyi 'khor gsum lus la bskor btsan gya zhags pa lag na thogs 'phur rtsal mchong rgyug ga ngang nas mdun thad du phebs tshe 'ang nga phrug g.yu lha' dpa' ngar 'gyur ba med pa'i glu 'di blangs so tsho/ dam chos ma ṇi padme sa: bka' yang dag chos la gsopa ba 'debs tshe 'di byi gnyis kyi skyabs mgon mdzod ma rig 'khrul 'khor zhi gyur cig: tshur nyon dang wa thul btsan lha lo: nga skyes pa 'jang gi yul du skyes:'jang sa dam rgyal po'i thugs zin yin: gnam lcags thog la 'gyur na thar : rtsal rgod thog 'gyur de nas thog: smon lam o rgyan yul nas btab: gling ge sar rgyal po'i dpung grogs su: chos mdo sngags bstan pa'i gzhi mar sprul: nga bdag thad gar bzung ba yi: rang sde'i bdud sde thar lam bkod: dpung ci yod dam pa'i chos la bkod: mdo sngags gnyis kyi bshad sgrub btsugs: 'jang grub pa thob pa bcu gsum 'byung : mkhas pa'i dbang po bcu gsum 'byung : sgom grwa sgrub grwa bcu gsum red: bshad sgrub 'dzin

grwa bcu gsum red: spyir 'gro drug sems can don phyir dang : sgos pha ma gnyis kyis gtsor byas pa'i: 'jang 'khrugs rtsod che ba'i shan pa rnams: thar pa'i lam la 'god phyir brtsams: de nas gling sde dkar por phebs 'dzam gling skyes bu don 'grub des: rang sems sa sa rgyas rang ngo sprad: 'bras bu dpung tshogs 'bum dang bcas: rig 'dzin sa la khyu ded btang : de gsang ba sngags kyi khyad chos yin: sbyor sgrol dgongs pa'i zab gnad 'di bshad mi bra rang sems dkyil na yod ston mi bra blo phug gtod yul yod:khyod de 'dra 'dod na nga phyir shog chos log mtha' ma'i bstan pa spongs: mu stegs lta ba rgyab tu dor sdig srid bon chos rgyab tu dor: da mi bsgru dkon mchog gtsug tu khur:chos yang dag mdo sngags gang mos spyod: khyod tshe 'dir rig 'dzin sa la spyod: thabs zhi ba'i sgo nas 'dzugs pa de nged gnyis la de yis dga' bar 'dug: de ma yin drag po mngon spyod kyis: khyod ma btul rang yul phyir mi log: mdzod lde mig ma rnyed 'gro ba min: dpung gcig gis rnyed dang gcig gis 'chor: de thob shor ma byas phyir mi ldog:

༄༅/ / gtam de tsho go na btsan lhas gzhig ma go na yang drang gtam yin: zhes zer ba'i lan du btsan lha rgod po des dug chu skom du 'thung dug zer rna nas 'phyur dug mda' gzhu steng du bzhag nas dpa' ngar che ba'i glu zhig blangs so skyed a dkar a dmar du tre ye: mu stegs ston pa sde drug de: snying ga'u'i dkyil du bzhugs su gsol: sa gsum na bzhugs pa'i the'u rang des: nga 'di phyi kun du kha 'dzin mdzod: mgon skyabs dang sdong grogs bon las med: bon stag lha me 'bar gyis sdong grogs mdzod nga btsan lha skyes pa brag la skyes: brag btsan dmar po'i bu yin no: nga btsan lha skyes pa mtsho las skyes gdol ba'i bu mo'i mngal las byung : nga btsan lha rgod pa khams las byung : 'byung ba lnga la rang dbang thob:der gnas dregs pa nga yi dbang : nga btsan lha dar ba kong la dar: kong rgyal khab dang mnyam du dar: rdzong khag brgyad po 'phan phyug 'dzoms: tshur nyon dang 'jang phrug ma skyes pa: khyed pha gsod shan pa'i yang tha red: ma gsod sdig rgan khrel med red: rang chos spangs pa'i lta log red gzhan chos rtsol bas blo mang red: phu na bon gyi skyabs

mgon med: mda' na mu stegs chos ra med bar na 'jang sde'i chos srid med: gling ma ngan a bra kha ser de'i: 'dab na 'dug pa ngo tsha'i gnas: nga btsan lha dpa' rgod thog rgyal des: ngo mi log kong the'u bzhed don sgrub: sa mi spo the'u rang bla ma khur: bka' mi spangs mu stegs bstan pa skyong : skyabs mi dor bon gyi lha srung bkur: gling jo ru'i 'dab nas yar mi blta: dpa' rgyal na kong the'u rgyal nas dga': de ma rgyal dpa' bo bsad na spro: dpa' ya med rgod po shi skad sgrog: ngag drag rtsal khyad chos rgyal khams sgrog 'jang phrug skye ba da snga yin: shi ba de ring dus tshod red: nga btsan lha'i lag la 'gro rgyu yin: kong the'u rang gi ha bgad byed rgyu yin: mu stegs kyi bstan pa dar bar byed rnge na gyi mdzad phrin rgyas shākyar cig: ces zer nas mda' spri dus g.yu lhas 'gyur stabs gcig byas pas mda' yas ma zin rta sga' snga phyir la khams re blangs nas brag rta mchog 'dra ba gtor te /brab sgo'i pha bo la zugago de nas 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur des rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs rtsal bskyed 'phur rtsal ldan pa 'i mda' gshog drug rtsal bu ldem pa de gzhu ste du bkod nas 'khrul pa chos skur bsre ba'i glu 'di ltar bla sa so

༄༅// oṃ ma hā gu ru sidhi hrī:gnas rnga yab zangs mdog dpal ri nas drin mtshungs med o rgyan chos kyi rje:ma dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag bcas:misdig can 'dren pa'i phrin las mdzod:gnas don yod grub pa'i zhing khams nas lha mi 'byugs mgon mchog rgyal ba dang :sras byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bcas kyis mi sdig can thar pa'i lam du drongs:gnas dur khrod me ru 'bar ba nas:dpal khrag 'thung dbang chen he ru ga:dpal sgrub sde dgu yi lha tshogs bcas:mi sdig can 'drenapa'i phrin las mdzod:mda' 'phen pa tsitta'i ngos la 'phen skyen 'dzoms pa rlung sems 'phrul rgya gtor:thabs nyi zla'i ga'u kha phrol nas:gshis shes rig dwangs ma'i thigale de rtsal dpag chen mda' 'phang ji bzhin du dbyings kun du bzang mo'i dgongs klong bsre:yul bdud bzhi'i 'phyang thag a 'thas gcod tshogs yul yang dur khrodaganas su bkod yul dpa' bo mkha' 'gros dgyes pa bskang :dus snyigs ma'i gdul bya skyob pa'i phyir phyi 'byung ba'i khams su gtor re bkod:nang sgyu lus nyer 'tshes

gdung ba zhi: 'khrugs rtsod kyi gdul dka' 'dul gyur cig: ces brjod nas mda' spra tshe dpa' ya med btsan lha rgod po de'i don lnga snod drug gtor dbang po sgo lnga bstung rnam shesa'og min gyi zhing du bkod mda' ngar gyi tsha la chad de mthon po rtse brgyad dang gdug pa'i dmag stong phrag tsam rdul du brlags de'i tshe dpa' rtags dgra la ngom pas dmag sde'i dpung tshogasa'adar shad dngangs la dpa' bkong nas gling tsho drug lha sde'i las dmagatu khasablangs mna' bor ro shar lto'i 'phyong rdzong sman gyi lde mig phyag tu rnyed na bsam don 'grub bo de nas gling che rgyud bu rgod chos 'phan dar yag de khro lcags zhun rdo yi ra ba can nas khri nyul 'bum rtse rgod po' gdong nasagazigs tsa na lho nub rngam shod gtum po' dmag skar tshogs bzhin du khra rig rig nags klong bzhin du sngo nag 'byur 'byur mgar gyi tsha la bzhin du dmar nag nyi li li 'khrugs pod pa mthong de' nang nas rtse 'dzin wa thuladapa' glang snyang rti'u mgo gtum pa'i gzugs can te lcags spyang mgo dgu la bcibs nas rlung bsil mar gyi bang rtsal dang ldan pasamadun du 'khod pa na gling chos 'phan dar yag gis bde stong rol pa chen po'i glu 'di blangs so oṃ hya ṣṭṛ wa na mo sa: gnas bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas: dbang zla gam e yi dal steng nas: dpal bde mchog 'khor lo sdom pa yi: zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs stong 'bar

༄༅/ / bzhin du: sems dga' ba 'od gsal mos ngor byon: thabs dga' ba bzhi yi phrin las kyis mi sdig can rgyud la zhi bsil rlan: las nyon mongs chagasasogs rba sang skem: dpal bde ba chen po'i gdul byar bsgyur: dbyings stong pa chos sku'i pho brang nas: don rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan zhal: 'dzum nam mkha'i bu mo'imadangs bstan nas: sku'i bde stong ba spu bskyod bzhin du: zhal utpal dri bsung nyer ngoms shing : 'dzum 'o 'dzin chu 'dzin dga' ba ngoms: lus sgyu ma'i phung por nyer tsa na sems chags pa'i mdud rgya rang grol te: don bde ba chen po'i 'char sgo phyes: rtsal rlung gi rta la rab bskyon nas: thabs bcu drug phyed phyed thig le desaḥ mi sdig can rgyud kyidri ma sbyangs: rtsal rtog pa sum cu rtsa gsum yang : dga' bzhi yis ye shes so gsum gyur: des sdig can gyi dri ma mkha' la sangs: sems las nyon gyi gcong nad sman gyisagaso: rgyud zhe sdang me dpung dbyings su bsnubs: nga yul gya bdud bzhi thad gar gcod: lha dbang chen he ru'i dgongs spyod 'grub: gnas dur khrod he ru yul so gnyis: der

bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams bro gar dang glu yis dgyes par byon:sdig can gyi 'khrul ba'i gzugs phung la:lha bde bar gshegs pa'i pho brang btab:zag pathig tsam man chad kun:rig 'dzin rgyal ba dgyes pa'i sprin:bde ba mchog gi rol ston mdzad:lus gnas lha yi dkyil 'khor tshun:zag pa'i phung po dwangs mar smin stongagasal nyi zla'i sems nyid tsham:'od gsal sgron me rang byu 'bar:bde byed bskyod ma rang sar tshim rgyu ba'i lam kun rang sar grol:'bar ba mchog gi mkha' 'gro tshim gtum mo'i bde drod mkha' ltar rgyas:bde ba mchog gi dpa' bo tshim:gang la 'jug pa'i yul kun smin:mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro'i gling dbus su:'brel tshad 'dren pa'i rtena'abrel yod:chos bde stong bsgom pa 'i ting 'dzin la:spro ba byung na las ldan yin:mi mos gdong blta kha spro btsan:'dren pa'i skal med snying rje'i yul:dpa' glang snying rte'umago tshur nyon dang :chos ga dar bstan pa dar ba'i skyid:la bla ma'i dbu 'phang mtho ba'i skyid yul rgyal khams chos la btsud pa'i skyid:lta log gi bstan pa bsnubs na skyid

༄༅/ / chos log gi bon grub stong na skyid: bsam don gyi dug mtsho skem na skyid: 'byor ldan gyi gter kha rnyed na skyid: khyod bde stong lam gyis 'dul na skyid gnas zla gam dgu rdzong pho brang nas: dpal bde mchog yab yum zhabs drung skyel: chos dga' bzhi'i rol ston spyod na skyid: khyod skyid pa'i 'dun ma sgrub ran red semasanyon mongs dpa' ngar zhi ran red nga che rgyud chos 'phan dar yag zer dpa' ngar ma'i nus stobs 'dzoms mi yin: khyod mthong nas dpa' ngar zhus pa min: lha byang chubasems dpa'i rigs lags te: sems brtse bas 'dun ma drang gtam spring : de go na sems kyi bdud rtsi yin: ma go ba rnams drag pos 'dul zhes gsungs tshe dpa' ya med gla snying rte'u mgo' bsam pa la 'dren stobs la nang pas che mthu ngan sngags la phyi pa sa myur rgyud bden drang che ba chos gral gyis legs gsod gcod dmar g.yos la bon gral spro glu 'dra ma yag de tsho bden nges che ko ze'u rang gi srid sdegato mi ru mod kya dbang gi khyad chos ston pa ra skul ba'i glu 'di bla sa so

oṃ tha trang tha trang tha trang len: ma tha trang ngag gi 'gug lugs yin: nged kong the'u srid pa gnam la mnyam: dpal 'byor gling bzhi'i khyon la mnyam: sa 'og rin chen phyur bur gtams: sa steng ra las mdzod sgo bsdams: mu stegs bstan pa zla ltar 'phel: nus mthu gnam lcags thog ngar mtshungs: bon byi chos srid dgung las mtho: mdzad pa phrin las nyi ltar gsal: gnam sa bar snang ze'u rang gis nyin rdzu mtshan gyi mel tshe byed che ba'i yon tan nam mkhar mnyam: btsan phyug 'phan dar srid na mdzes: chung ma las skyes nas kong the'us bskyangs bsam pa kong the'u phyogs la yod: ngas mi gtong sgog gi sta re 'dzin: skyabs dang skyel ma mgon dang dpung : mu stegs ston pa sde drug dang :the'u rang bla ma dbu dkar dang : bon gses stag lha me 'bar las: su yang med nas kho thag chod: ngas mi gtong sgog gi sta re 'dzin: khyod 'dra ma yag gi gtam bshad na gtam bzang po'i lan du gtam bzang sgrog khyed bde chen dbang gi dal zhal phyes: gnas bde ba chen po'i grong khyer ston lha bde mchog yab yum zhal ras ngom: don

༄༅/ / dga' bzhi stong bzhi'i 'khrul 'khor bskor: ngas kha min rgyang nas ltad mo byed: snang ba dbang du 'dus na 'dud: sems rtog la ya mtshan shar na 'khor:nga dpa' rgod glang snying rti'u mgo zer: dmag khri tsho gcig gi sngon 'dug yin: bsad pa'i sha bsnyil ri rab 'dra: khrag de bsogs na rgya mtsho tsam: rus 'gran brdal na rdza ri 'dra: gsod gcod las sna bsam mi dpog: de 'dra bshad nas sems 'khrugs na: khyod mi rta gnyis po bza' snyam lang : gling tsho drug dmag sde brlag snyam skyes: da de tsho ma yin phar la zhog don dbang gi phrin las bstan du gsol gtam go na khyod kyis khyad chos ston ma gos tshig la yang bshad med ces bskul tshe gling chos 'phan dar yag gis rtsa gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la bskul gsol gdab sems bde stong 'od gsal gyi don la mnyam par bzhag tshe nub phyogs o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling dbus nas 'ja' sprin dmar po'i lhug ma sbreng de'i sna la 'ja' 'od kyi gur khyim phub pa'i nang nas dpal bde mchog 'khor lo sdom pa yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'khril sbyor rol ba rten med kya nam mkha' la byon nas sku lus kyi bkod pa nyid la rigs lnga dbyangs kyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs

thams cad nye 'du mdzad cing bde stong dga' bzhi'i rol ston mdzad pa' snang ba mngon sum du phebs pa na gling chos 'phan dar yag gis brda bstod rdo rje'i glu 'di ltar blangs so tre: ha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa tshe: gnas bde stong spros bral pho brang nas: don dga' bzhi'i rol ston 'gyed mdzad pa'i: lha rigs lnga sgyu 'phrul sras bcas mkhyen mi 'khrul ba'i gnyis 'dzin gdon rgod thul: chos bdag med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs tshur nyon dang glang snying rti'u mgo khyod: yar ltos shig a sngon dbyings la ltos: nub dbang gi 'od byim g.yo ba'i khar rgyud nyon mongs dug lnga grol ba'i gnyen: zhing 'od lnga'i gur khyim phub pa'i klong : lha dwangs ma 'od kyi sku mchog can: tshul bee ḍūrya yi zhal bzang ngom:'di bde mchog 'khor lo sdom pa yin: gnas 'khor ba'i 'khor lo rmang nas skem: 'gro drug 'khrul ba'i sa bon bcom: bag chags ma rig mun khams sangs dpal bde ba thams cad 'byung gnas yin: sngag bsngal rgya mtsho sgem mi yin: de'i 'od gsal phyag rgya'i sku yi mdun zhal padma rā ga'i gzi byen 'khyags: don 'bar ba chen po'i 'od zer

༄༅/ / 'gyed: dpal thabs dabhe shes rab gnyis su med: gnyis med kyi ngang la snyoms zhugs mdzad: de bde chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: dga' dang stong pa tha midad sgyu lus 'od gsal dwangs ma'i klong : gnas bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo na: yul sum cu rtsa gnyis der bzhugs pa'i: dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma: donadaga' bzhi'i rol ston nyid la spyod: yang mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo na: zhing he ru'i gnas bcu'i bkod pa rdzogs yul dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma: don bde stonganye rgyu'i spyod pa ston: yang snying ga chos kyi pho brang na: yul nyer bzhi'i bkod pa ma 'dres rdzogs: dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnal 'byor ma: kun kyang bde stong nyams dgar spyod yang lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo na gnas dur khrod brgyad kyi bkod pa rdzogs: der brten pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma: kun bde stong dga' bzhi'i gsang spyod khyer: yang gsangaganas bde skyong 'khor lo na: da 'og phyogs rdul gyi bkod pa rdzogs: yul mun pa can na bzhugs pa yi: yab dpa' bo shes rab dpa' mo dang : don rdo rje rnal 'byor pho mo'

tshogs: chos bde stong dga' bzhi'i rol ston spyod: sems gnyis 'dzin gdon gyi rdul mi 'go: yang ma rig las nyon dri ma med: chags sdang rmongs nyon mongs 'khrul rtog dben: chos 'od gsal phyogs ris bral ba rba thabs shes rab rlung gi rtar bskyon nas las rlung khams 'khrul ba rang mal gsod: don dga' ba bzhi yi tshogs ston 'gyed thabs ro mnyam spyod pa dang du len: lhan skyes pa'i bde stong sgron me 'bar: lkog gyur gyi log 'khrul thad gar sangs: bying rmugs 'thib rgod po'i rtog tshogs grol: dpal zhibade mchog tu mi 'gyur bas: gnas rgyud lnga'i 'gro khams dong sprugs byed: 'di mthong na mig la bdud rtsi sbyin: sngar bsags pas sdig sgrib dag par byed: 'di dran pa'i snying la chos char 'bebs: sems da lta'i 'khrul rtog thad gar bor: sku'i cha tsam 'od la reg tsam na: da ma 'ongs bag chags mi bskyed par: zag kun zad bde chen rdo rjer grol: khyod blo sems snang ba mi spro'am: spro na rig 'dzin sras su snyogs: ma go bsgral 'dren mnyam du byed: rnam shes 'od gsal zhing 'dir smin: 'khrul ba'i skye rgyun chod pa

ra༅༅/ / yin — gtam de tsho go na sems dkyil zhog: ma go na yang yang zlos med: ces zer tshe wa thul de'i bsam pa la thams dang stobs kyis 'dren na ma gtogs blo sems brad nas dbangaṭwā ༷/ dī /rdo ༵ bya~X ༵ na ༵ ṭwāṃ // rdo/ ༷ ༵nga bon la gsol ba 'debs: nga wa thul dpa' rgod ya med des: lha gcig spangs gcig sgrub byed pa min: chos gcig spangs gcig sgomabyed pa min: grogs gcig spangs gcig 'grogs byed pa min: thabs stobs yod dbang gis bsgral 'dren mdzod: de ma yin mngon spyod drag las gyis: zhes zer nas tshom mera'adug tsa na bde mchog 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum gyi zhal gsang mnyam par sbyor bas dal du dbang gi 'od thag gis blo sems 'chug dab med par sgo gsum btsan thabs kyis bsdus nas dril yab kyisku'i dbyingasabargyud nyon shes kyi dri ma sbyangs yab kya zhal nas yum gya zhal du zhugs sku dbyi sa brgyud bsgom lam mthar phyan rtsib log g.yas nas thon ma slob pa 'i sa lam mthar phyin sras bde ba chen po he ru ka yab yum dang cha

'dra bar bsgrun te sangs rgya bar mdzad do de tshe gling chos 'phan dar yag gis mda' myur bar bsring ma shod gtum po' dmag da pon brgyad bsgral 'dren dus gcig la byas sems gnyis 'dzan gyi gdon rgod can stong lhag tsamasbyor sgrol gyi mthu la drang bar byas las dmag gzhan tham/sa cad ma 'a dbang du bsgyur gling lha sde'i las dmag gi gral du 'jug pa'i tha tshag gnyer dam mi 'dor bar bzhes so lho nub mig stong shel spos g.yu yi rdzong gi lde mig phyagatu rnyed nas bams don 'grub bo de nas 'byu sras rdo rje thog rgod des sngags brtul zhugs rol pa'i chas gos thamasacad bklubs nas mgyogs pa 'brong nag lcags rna bcibs te nub bya za sa lcags a ru mthon po nas chas te lcags kyi 'phrul zam bcu gsum bcad nas thod pa 'i ba gam can gyi la kha nas gzigs tsa na sdig pa lcags khrab can gyi dmag skyi bser khol khol rlung nag 'tshub 'tshub dug mtsho 'phyur 'byur byas nas mda' brdar dang mdu brdar gsod gcod kya dmar las byed pa'i khyu nas wa thul ha mi zan dom nag spyon pa de stag ri log tsam pa bcibs nas skad cig rlu gi bang rtsal gyis chas te mdun du slebs ca na chos nyid mi 'gyur ba'i glu 'di blangs so tsho badzra kro ta rā dza sa: rgyal kun ye shes gcig bsdus pa: che mchog dpal dgu'i lha tshogs mkhyen: bka' sdod pho nyas sdong grogs mdzod: nam mkha' 'ja' sprin 'khrigs klong nas:

༄༅/ / pha bka' brgyud bla mas thugs rjes gzigs: bar snang sprin dpung 'tshubs klong nas: ma rgyud mkha' 'gros kha 'dzin mdzod: tshur nyon dang wa thul dpa'amadzangs can ha mi zan dom nag spyon pa lo: nga 'ong ba khra mo gling nas 'ong : 'dun phugs bla ma dkon mchog yin: spyir 'dus byas chos la rtag pa med sgos skye bos tshe ni chubur 'dra: chos ma gtogs phyir na re sa med: lam phyin ci log rtog mu stegs dang : rgya hwa shang bon po'i lta ba las: thar nges na dam pa gong ma'i lugs: ngas dben pa'i ri lasgrub pa byas: chos mdo sngags gnyis la nan chags sbyangs: lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis la rang dbang 'byor: mthu mngon spyod skyogs kyi grub pa thob: ming 'bru sras rdo rje thogargod yin: bod 'dzam gling chos kyi rgyal po yis: kong the'u rang ra rdzong phab la mngag: sgos sdig pa lcags khrab gshed du bskul: don rgya tsha dung zla dkar po la: las mi'atshams 'phrog bcom byas nas zos: gnad bshags pa ma byas stong len yin: khyod bsam pa dkar po chos la 'khor: bsam khog drang mo gling la phul: go brda'i 'dra ma ngag

nas shod: blo sems legs na chos kyis 'dul: mi ngas kyang mngon spyod las mi brtsam: gtam go na chos kyi bdud rtsi yin: ma go na mngon spyod bskul ma red: cesasmras tshe wa thulades mi 'dod khros pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma bstan nas dpa' ngar khro chu khol ma'i glu 'di blangs so e ya le wa le su wa le: bon gyi ston pa gshen rab mkhyen gnam the'u dkar pos bu bzhin skyongs:bar the'u khra bos kha 'dzin mdzod: sa the'u nag pos sdong grogs mdzod: nga'i blo sna g.yung drung bon la gtad: blo phugs ston pa sde drug bcug lta spyod hwa shang dgongs pa sgrub sa bon gcig las 'bras bu ste: mthong chos 'dug pa ji bzhin du lus rten 'di brjes 'di las lhag shi bsam pa zhe la yod pa min: shi yang blo 'gyod spu tsam med: g.yung drung bon byi bstan pa srung : kong the'u rang gi dkor mdzod srung : nga'i bsam pa yar 'phel yar dar yin: lus 'di rin chen lcags las grub: gnam lcags thog gis ma bzhus na: 'jig rten mtshon gyis 'bug pa min: sems ni 'byung ba lnga las grub: 'byung lnga dbyings su ma zhig bar: skye dang 'chi ba yod pa min: chos min shwakya'i bstan pa la:

༄༅/ / mi dad nges pa kho thag chod: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gral mi snyeg: bsnyegs na nyams chung sdug thug yin: khyod 'bru sras zer ba a ba ris: gling rgya tsha bu ro ga sdug de'i srog gcod mkhan hor gyi shan pa yin: de gling sdes yod na de'i chog red sha len dgos na de la yin: stong snyog dgos na de los yin: pyol song rtsa rgye bdag med 'ga' nged kong the'u phyogs la song na yang : mkha' la bya 'phur rjes med yin: sa gzhir zos tshad stong med yin: khyod nyes skal bab te brel long long : 'chi la thug ste 'tshub long long : pha ga'i gnam lcags ri bo 'di: nga'i mdzub mo'i bskor na e 'dra red: ma ga'i rgya mtsho mer ba 'di nga'i hub kyis rngub na e 'dra red: thad kyi brag mar rtse mtho 'di: thal mos brdab na e 'dra red: khyod gsod las kyis sla ba med: spyod par brtag gzhig phyir la dengs: gsod ma dgos pa zhig 'ong na chog: de go na gling phrug sems la 61ga ma bo/ 11ga ga〈snad ro/na las byed: ces zer nas lcags kyi ri bo mdzub mo' rtse la bzhag nas bskor rgya mtsho hub kyis 'dren brag mar la thal bdob byas nas bye phu bzhin du bshig phral

byas nas tshom mer 'dug tshe 'bru sras rdo rje thog rgod rtsal ya dag ru lu 'bru brgyad kyi dgongs pa la bzhugs nas phyag mdzub g.yas kyi skyogs shing rtsa thur tsam pa sbreng g.yon skyogs she brtsegs ma bya chen gyi sgo nga 'dra ba gcigabategs nas 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi glu 'di blangs so oṃ na mo gu ru bud dngha ya skyabs bslu med sangs rgyas dkon mchog mkhyen tshe 'di phyi gnyis kyi skyabs mgon mdzod: rgo dam chos maṇi padme sa: bka' yang dag chos la gsol ba 'debs: gnas rigs drug 'khor ba'i skye sgo khogs: bde chen thar ba'i lam bzang ston mi sdig can 'dren pa'i skyabs mgonamadzod: nga sngags mkhan grub pa'i dbang phyug des: skyogs shing 31 rgyan yul nas btsal: ma mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi bla shing yin: sbyogs rdo gnam lcags ra ma lug: che ba rdo rje'i pha lam yin: 'bring ba mtshon cha'i pha lam yin chung ba gtor byed pha lam yin pha lam sde dgu bsgrigs nas brtsams: phyi brtsigs rdo rje'i thog mkhar brtsigs: nang brtsigs lha chos po ti brtsigs: rdzas sngags nus pas ngar yang blud: gnam lcags thog gis 'gran zla bral: 'di'i shar sgo 'byed mi grwa ba can dmag khri sde ming med byed rgyu

༄7/ / yin: lho sgo 'byed mi slog 'gyu ma: thog ser gyis stong dmag brlag mi yin nub sgo 'byed mi 'byung bzhi'i 'dab: phyi nang gi 'byung ba gshed bsgyur nas dmag 'bum sder phung thal gtong mi yin: byang sgo 'byed mi gyad po che sa gzhi steng 'og sgyur mi yin: gnam sa yo log byed mi yin: rgol ba drung nas 'byin mi yin: khyod ltad mo a sngon dgung la gyis de nas bar snang khams la ltos: de nas 'og the'u srid la ltos: tha ma rang gi dmag sder ltos: yang tha sgyu ma'i lus la ltos: ltad mo thengs lnga byas pa na: wa thul dang dpa' thul khyad par 'byung : khyed rang mtho na mthol lo bshags: nged tsho rgyal na a la la: zhes gsungs nas phem du ra zhes pa'i sgra bsgrags tshe phyogs bzhi'i rlu lang mtshams bzhi'i bu yug 'tshub steng nas 'byug stong gi sgra ldir 'og nas sa gzhi shig shig yom yom 'gul tshe skyogs rdo de'i phar kha zhig rdol nas steng nam mkha' la 'phag the'u rang dkar po' bla rdo gtor bar snang la 'khor the'u rang khra bo'i rlung mkhar bshag sa 'og tu song / the'u rang nag po' srid 'khor bcom yar 'phar te sdig pa lcags khrab can gyi dmag steng du 'khor tshe 'og gi dpang rgya gcag 'thor bsagatso bo brgyad dang las dmag 'bum phrag tsam

ro dang rgal gyi shul tsam yang mi mthong bar brlag pa ra byas lhag ma ha mi zan dom nag spyon pa'i steng du thon tshe bung thal gyi sgra dang bcas nas sgyu lusastag dang bcas pa lhag lus med par tshar bcad sems zangs kyi bye leb gcigatu brdzus nas rgya mtsho chen po'i gling bar mchong gi brag la gab tsa na 'bru sras thog rgod mi rta gnyis ka rlu bser mar gyi shugs dang ldan pas shel mda' rang bu ldan pa gzhu mchog la bkod de mchong brag gi thad nas glu 'di blangs so oṃ hya snyi wa na mo sa: bde ba mchog sbyin he ru ka dbang chen rta mgrin rgyal po de gdul dka' 'dul ba'i mgon la chas: dgra bla wer ma bcu gsum te: de ring skyes bu'igrogs su chas: nam mkha' 'ja' 'od 'khyel slong nas: gnam sman rgyal mo las la bzhengs: pha ki mchong brag ldem pa nas: ha mi zan dom nag spyon pa yi: rnam shes zangs kyi bye leb lo: bros na thar ba ga la srid: gab pa'i btsan rdzong yod pa min: ngas shel mda' a dkar ring bu 'dis: thebs tshad mi 'chor brlag pa yin: bsad kyang rnam shes 'dren pa yin: khyod dpa' bo yin na gzugs phung ngom sdar ma yin na gab nas sdod ngas gab skung phud la bros lam gcod: bsgral dang 'dren pa dus mnyam byed: 'og

༄༅/ / min chos dbyings pho brang nas: brgyud gsum bla mas thugs rjes zungs: las ngan ma rig sdig can 'di: bde chen thar ba'i lam la drongs: dur khrod me ru 'bar ba nas: yi dam sgrub sde'i lha tshogs mkhyen: 'khrul ba a 'thas 'ching rgya can: las ngan sbubs shig lam sna drongs: bde chen mkha' spyod gling dbus nas: 'bum phrag dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mkhyen: smon log bdud rigs dam sri 'di: rig 'dzin zhing du lam sna drongs: mda' 'phen pa gzhu mchog rgyud nas 'phang : 'phen yul mchong brag dam sri lo: khyod rgod po yin na da tshur shog: nga gling sde'i dpa' thul 'gran ya med: dpa' rtags dgra la de ring ngom: zin gyi ngo so de ring bstod: lha rtsa gsum thugs dam bskangs shākyar cig: ces zer tshe zangs kyi khyi mo kha dgu gdangs pa gcig tu brdzus nas mchong brag gi rtse nas ngar zug lan dgur byed tshe khrag gi mchi ma 'khrugs lcags kyi mche ba brdar zangs kya sder tshogs bsgrad nas nga ros mchong stabs gcig shom tsa na 'bru sras kyi mda' springs nas dpral ba'i me lo gtor klad rgya tshal bar dkrugs dam sri'i rang gzugs rdul phran du bshig nas bsgral 'dren dus gcig tu byas te sngar gyi dpa' rtags ma dzad pa'i

yul nas nga ro bsgrags pa na dmag brgya phrag tsam lhag pa des 'ab sa su khas blangs gli la sde'i las dmag ga lta spyod la zhugs gzhan pa rnams mngon spyod drag po 'i brtul zhugs la drangs so nub byang thod pa'i rdzong gi lde mgaphyag tu rted nas bsam don 'grub bo de nas dpa' bo du skyo stag la khri dkar de rta 'do ba dung khri 'phur shes la bcabs nas mtshon cha'i bu yug 'tshub bzhin dpa' 'ja sa kyi ra shugs bskyed nas rlung bser mar gyi rtsal bskyed la: la 'dam bse khra lcags rgyud zhol nas ze bas te btsan po khyung brag dmar po' rtse nas gzigs tsa na la dkar tsha chu 'o mche'i dmag tsha la bzhur bzhur dngul zhun khol khol skar mda' rgyug rgyug 'tshub rig rig byed pa'i khyu nasartse 'dzan wa thul nya zlo spyang dkar rgod po de re 'ga' rgya mtsho'i gti na rgyug bar bar nam mkha' dbya sa la 'phyo yang gcig 'byung ba bzhi la rgyu ba gcig yin yang 'di yi dus su rang gzugs mngon sum du bstan nas dung skyong stag lha' mdun thad du thon tsa na bsam pa dbyings la bor ba'i glu 'di blangs so oṃ dam chos ma ṇi padme pa: bka' yang dag chos la gsol ba 'debs: spyid stug legs nyes gang byung yang : dkon mchog gsum las re sa med: 'di phyi gnyis kyi so mtshams

༄༅/ / nas: rje bla ma nyid las skyabs mgon med de ring nyi ma'i dus gang la kha 'dzin chos skyong srung mas mdzod: bsam don dpa' bo mkha' 'gros sgrubs tshur nyon dang wa thul spyang rgod lo: dgung a sngon gnam gyi kha leb red: bu 'dzam gling chos kyi kha leb red: sa dog mo rten byed kha leb red: gnam sa gnyis po su la dbang /chos rgyal 'dzam gling skyes bur dbang : bdag po nor bu dgra 'dul red: srid skyong dpa' rgod sum cu red rdzong phab phab da sngon bcu bdun phab: ma rung dam sri thams cadabarlags: yul gling dam pa'i chos la bkod bsod nams lha sde dkar por 'byor: de ring kong the'u ra rdzong phab 'di grub tsa na bco brgyad pa da sngon ma grub gcig kyangamed de ring bya ba 'grub nges yin: bu 'dzam gling skyes bu'i thugs bzhed ltar: lang dkar tsha chu 'o mtsho'i dmag ngo len dpa' rgod nga yin gsungs gling rgya tsha'i nor khyer ramadar sbran: dpa' rgod nyi zla spyang dkar de: dam pa'i chos la e 'khor ltos: 'khod na tshe gcig sangs rgyas sbyin: mi 'khor zer na mngon spyod kyi phrin las dus la bab bo

gsungs: khyod kyi sems la gang 'dra 'dug: chos ni 'dod dam 'dod na 'grigs: sdig pa'i las la skyo'am ci skyo na bshags pas 'dag pa yin: gling lha sde'i gral la 'gro'adod dam: 'dod na dpa' bo'i gral du 'jog: gtam go na snyan pa'i khu byug yin: ma go glen pa 'chi ran red: ces bsgrags tsa na wa thul dpa' rgod de'i dug lnga 'khrugs pa'i lus 'khrung sems kyi me ro rab tu 'bar te gtum rngam dpa' skad kya glu 'di blangs so a dkar a dmar du tri ye: skyabs mgon ston pa gshen rab dang : bon skyong stag lha me 'bar mkhyen: de ring nga yi skyabs mgon mdzod: gnam sa bar snang klong dkyil nas the'u rang spun dgu'i kha 'dzin mdzod: stong pa ye med nam mkha' la ston pa sde drug mgon du phebs: rang srid skyong la kha 'dzin mdzod sdang dgra gdug pa'i klad rgya dkrugs nyon dang dung skyong stag lha lo: mon rgyal khams phung ba'i phung rgan khyod gling phrug a bra kha ser gyis: 'dab na 'dug pa ngo re tsha: las pa byed la skyug re bro: mngag pa'i pho nya

༄༅/ / a ba ris: gling khri sde'i dmag tsho ga la bskung : da dpa' rgod can rnams gang du bros: mi gcig dpa' med dpung sdug khyod: bsad na stong len snyog mi med: brdung na bar ba byed mi med: 'phrog na zhu ba phul sa med: a tse mon sdug dbang med lo: khyod kong ze'u yul la chas pa de: me lce mar me shi ran red: nya mo lcags kyu'i zin ran red: rlung sems mar me nub ran red: khyod drin chen pha dang ma lo la shi kha'i kha chems yod dang med: med na kho bo'i gsod rgyu yin: yod na da lan myur bar smos gtam bo na sems kyi dkyil du zhog: ma go'i glu la phyir cho sa med: ces zer nas mag gnyis las khro zhun dang dug chu' thog zer gnyas spros te du skyong mi rta gnyis por thugs sngangs yud tsam byung dus khrabadakar gyi logs gcig tsam zog chu'i nag por byas du rta dkar po' rnga rngog spu gzhob ser deng nge ba zhig byas tsa na dung skyong khros pa'i ros dpa' bcing bzlog med kyi glu 'di ltar blangs so oṃ ka dag chos sku'i pho brang nas dus gsum sangs rgyas rang chas yin: 'gags med gsal dag thig le'i 1nga ma ngas spyod rdzogs sku lhun gyis grub: rtsol med gdul

bya'i mos mtsho dza sprul sku'i phrin las rgyun chad med: de ring pad 'byung spyan gzigs dang rje btsun sgrol ma'i kha 'dzin mdzod: mi las ngan sdig can wa thul kho: thar ba'ilam la 'dren par mdzod:drangs nas phyir mi sdog par shog: sangs rgyas bstan pa rin po che'i: kong the'u rgyal khams skyongs gyur cig: mi rje thams cad lha rjer gyur:srida'abangs thams cad chos srid gyur wa thul nyi zla spyang dkar lo: khyod skyes bu'i rtsal rdzogs da sngon yin:shi ba'i mgron po de ring yin: gshin rje'i grong khyer 'grims kha yin mi dad pa can gyi thar lam zin: sdig po che rnams dmyal bar mnar: 'chi kha'i kha chems 'jog dbang med: lab lob mang po bshad lung med: tsab tsub mang po bsam lungamed: khyod ngar ngar nyes med khrab la ngar khrab dkar po lcags zhun ngar chu blud: khyod nyes med 'do ba'i spu la ngar: spu dkar po gser gyi kha bad btsugs: lang dkar tsha chu'o ma'i dmag:skyid sdug med kyang nga ro che: nga dpa' rgod kha nas bgad re 'chor lus rtsal drug la mtshon gyis thebs pa mon nang don snod la bug ral byung ba med:sems

༄7/ / 'od gsal la 'grib pa mi mnga' ye:khyod dpa' rgod zer ba kha tsam red:nga tsho de dang 'dra sa med:dmag brgya sngon dpa' bo gcig 'dug yin:dpa'angar stag mo kher rgyug yin:nga'i lha mtshon dung gi zhags pa 'di:lha dmag bu yugs 'tshubs dbus nas lha chen tshangs pa'i phyag nas gnang :klu mi mgon dkar po'i phyagamatshan red:dgra sde 'ching ba'i gru gu yin:gang bsam yul la thogs pa med:su dmigs dgra la 'chor sa med:khyod dung gi zhags pas bcing rgyu yin:rgya mtsho'i gting lagayug rgyu yin:lcags mkhar sgo med du brub kyi yin:ma 'ongs bskal pa'i yang tha la:thar pa'i lam la 'god rgyu yin de bar rnam smin myong rgyu yin:lang dkar tsha chu 'o ma'idamag:dung mda'i ngar la drangs rgyu yin dpa' rgod nag pos 'dul rgyu yin dkar po'i chos la 'god rgyu yin:nyi ma sang gi rtse shar la: kong the'u ra ba rdzong brgyad dang rgyal po gsum gyi mnga' thang nor:gling ge sar skyes bus len rgyu yin:khyod sems la dga' na mchod pa yin:mi dga' byu yang kho thag yin:gtam de tsho sems la dam por

zhog: bzhag nas shākya gsum e 11nga 1snad ces bsgrags nas dung gi zhags pa klad la bskor nas 'phangs pas wa thul lang dkar rgod po de'i sgo gsum grum chings byas la rgya mtsho chen po'i gting rum rim pa bdun pa'i mar zhabs gru gsum lcags kyi mkhar nang las gshin nag po'i sto bar bcug nasabaskal pa'i bar du btson la bzung ngo yang dung mda' gser gyi me tog can springs nas lang dkar tsha chu 'o mtsho'i dmag gi gtso bo da nga nag phyogs gdug pa'i sde rigs thams cad bsgral 'dren dus gcag la byas dmangs zhi zhing dkar po'i sde tshogs thams cad kyis blo sem snang ba dbang du bsgyur te gling chos sde'i lha dmag ga gral du bzhag tha tshig bsgrags 'i glu lan gsum brjod pas byang shar khro chu'i ra dkar nag khra bo' rdzong gi lde mig phyag tu rnyed nas bsam don 'grub bo de nas sngags mkhan nus mthu'i bdag po bde stong dpal gyi dbang phyug rta mchog bshad pa rtsal dang zhal mi gnyis pa spyi dpon khro thung rgyal po 'ja' lnga ldan gyi gur phub pa' nang nas ma rta gnyis tshon gang ba zhig tu sprul te gnam the'u dkar po'i cod paṇa rgya steng du 'khod nas chos dbyingasaphyogs dang bral ba' glu 'ad ltar blangs so gru ha la lha yi mchod pa red ma tha la gling pas 'gugs lugs red: nga nye nas ma yin ring nas yin: ring po gling dkar stod nas yin: gling che rgyud stag mo'i bu phrug red:

༄༅/ / 'bring rgyud 'om bu'i blo rten red: chung rgyud bsam pa 'grub mi red: 'og min lha yi gnas mchog tu: dbang lha rta mgrin dmar po yin: gnas yul dur brod he ru'i zhing : skyong mdzad bde mchog rnal 'byor yin: rgyu lus bde chen grong khyer na: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i nye 'du mdzad: dga' bzhi'i ro la rtag tu rol: 'od gsal sgron me phyogs med 'bar: sgo gsum lha sngags chos skur shar: bzang ngan 'brel ba 'jog mi kun: sangs rgyas sa la 'dren mi yin: khyod gnam lha dkar po tshur la nyon: nam mkhar g.yo ba med lags na: khyod la phyogs ris cis phyir mnga': chos dang chos min cis phyir brje: bod phung ba'i bya ba byed mi rung : dkar po dge ba'i kha 'dzin mdzod:nag po gdug pa'i mgo 'phang gnon: kong the'u rang gi ra rdzong phab pa la: kha 'dzin sdong grogs khyod kyis dgos: gtang rag mchod pa nga yis bkyags: gtam de tsho gnam lha'i thugs la chodag: ma bo na'ang 'gre1da med yin: zhes pa' sgra bsgrags tshe gnam lha dkar po de' sprul pa brgya dang nyi shu 'gyed nas nam mkha' 'ge 'gro ba tsam byas la glu lan 'ad ltar gdab bo tsos ma tri mu ye

sa le 'du: g.yung drung bon la gsol ba 'debs: bon ston drug cu'i kha 'dzin mdzod stag lha me 'bar gyi sdong grogs kyis tshur nyon dang khro thung spre'u rgan ngo : nang bla btsong btsong phyi'i ngo blang : phyi sna khrid khrid nang bcud shor: nga'i sprul pa brgya dang nyi shu 'dis gnam lcags thog zer phab rgyu yin: khro thung gi lus sems 'brel thag chod: dpa' mi thub pa de bskrur na dga': shed mi thub pa de bzhag na legs: gna' mi srid pa'i kha sgros ltar bzhag ma thub phung rgan thon le red: ngas g.yung drung bon la ngo mi log: kong the'u rang la jus gnod byed pa min: nged gnam la'i bu mo mched brgyad kyis: rdzong ra ba lde'u mig ster ba min rgyal ya med chen po rnam gsum gyi: mnga' thang gzhan la 'chor mi 'jug: gtam go na phung rgan phyir la log: ma go thog zer ngar mas bsdig: ces zer nas thog mda' dgu 'pha tsa na khro thu rgyal pos ha bgad dang bcas te gcig gis khrab dkar la gzer bu btab gcig gas rmog dkar la gza mad sa bskyedaḥ gcig gis sog larma la lcags rtsi bkyes gcag gas dpa 'a bo'i stag ral gya mda' rnams la ra chu blud gcig gis gzag shub rkya gzhi mo la zangs

ra bya/ / lcags kyi ldem bu btsugs gcig sngags pa' sked phur la mnga' gsol gzhug gsum gtor te gnam lha the'u rang ga grong khyer bcu gsum gshed du bsgyur de nas lha dbang chen rta mgrin gyi pho nya skyes mchog rdo rje legs pa bskul te nam mkha' la seng zhen brgya dang nyi shu'i sprul pa 'gyed du bcug nas slob dpon khro thung rgyal posabade stong rol ba chen po'i glu 'di ltar blangs so glu ha la mchod pa dpa' bo dgyes: ma tha la bsgrags na dpa' mo dgyes: thabs shes 'tshogs pa'i rgyang glu len: nga sngags pa bzhed don sgrub du gsol steng nam mkha' 'ja' sprin gur khang nas: 'dug mkhas na gnam lha dkar po yin: chos bon gnyis kyi grogs po yin: sems chags sdang rang mtshan 'khrul dbang gis: lam yang dag bor nas lta log bsgrubs chos spangs nas bon gyi mgon byed na khyed sngags kyi nus mthus brlag par byed: khyod the'u rang sprul pa brgya nyi shu: de'i dngos gnyen seng zhon brgya nyi shu:'di'i zhabs pad bkur na khyod kyi dpon gnam sa gnyis kyi byed po yin: tha tshig bon la gnas pa yin: 'brel ba chos la bzhag pa yin: mdo sngags gnyis kyi srung ma yin

rgya kha che kong the'u li gzhung re da: rdzong brgyad po'i wa thul dpa' rgod brgyad: dpa' kher rgyug gling gi skyes bu brgyad: ngo bzlog med dpa' shed rdzu 'phrul gyis: deng btul nas ming gi lhag med byas: mdzod brgyad po'i lde mig phyag tu rnyed: bu dpa' bo'i dpa' rtags dgra la ngom mtshon rnon po'i mngon spyod phrin las grub: khyod shi bo min na rig sa yod 'on pa min na thos sa yod: long ba min na mthong sa yod: mngon shes yod na mkhyen sa yod: rgya kha che kong gi rgyal po gsum: tshe dus byas 'og min zhing la bkod: desargyal sa 'dzam gling skyes bu'i blangs: ja ma me tog lha mdzes gi na: chos mdo sngags kyi bstan pa 'dzugs ran yin: lta log tsho' bstan pa bsnub ran yin gtam go na gnam lha'i sems la zungs: ma bo sngags pa'i e khung brub: che bu ku tri: a garsha ya dza: zhes brjod nas sked phur ye khang du gzir tsa na gnam la dkar po gcan gzan gyi mgo dgu can de lo stong da nyis brgya nyi shu'i bar du dam la btags lha bran brgya dang nyi shur spru pa de skyes bu rdo rje legs pas steng nam mkha' la rgyu ba'i 'khor du bkod tha tshig bon la gnas pa dang 'brel ba chos la gnas dgos par bka'

da༅༅/ / rtags spyi bor bcings dam chu lce la bzhag lag tu rdo rje gtad nas sa ma yu a rtsig tsig be rtsig tsag ces zer la drag po chen po' dam 'og tu bcug kha che'i rgyal po lcags rna can mgon skyabs kyi lha dang phyes nas 'dzam gling skyes bu'i 'dul skal byos yang gling bla rdo rje drag rgyal zer ba 'bri rgyud 'om bu'i mi rigs sngags gsar bu rnams kyi drag shos gong bla ma rnams kyi gdu 'tshob phur thog brgyad cu'i gtso bo de bar snang khams laskyil krung gis bzhugs nas dgongs pa chos nyid kyi don la bzhag lta ba' rdzong bzung bsgom pa'i 'phrang brgal spyod pa'i stong srog 'phrog pa' brtul zhugs drag po 'i dgo sa spyod la gnas tshe bar ze'u khra bos sprul pa brgya nyi shu'agyed nas phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas lta skabs glag tshol byas kyang rgol bas ma btub ste kho'i sems kyi dpa' sdom pa na dam can srung mas srog 'a drog ste mthong khol mngon sum du skyes mchog rdo rje legs pa bya zhen brgya dang nyi shu'i sprul pa 'gyed nas bar the'u rnams kyi gong non mdzad tsa na gli bla rdo rje drag rgyal des chos nyid bden pa' glu 'di ltar blangs so glu a la chos dbyings bden pa'i glu: ma tha la kun rdzob rgyu 'bras glu chos bden pa gnyis kyi bden tshig la: yul bar snang stong pa'i lha 'dre nyon: sngags 'bras bu dkyil 'khor gsal lugs la lta dman gyi rgol bas ga la tshug: ngas lta bas

rdzong chen zin lags pas: dgongs pa mi 'gyur gzer bu thebs: bsgom pa'i 'od gsal brkyang brkyang nas: ting 'dzin gsal bas gzer bu thebs: spyod pas stong sgoga'aphrog tsa na phrin las bzhi yi gzer bu thebs: smra brjod rang byung na dwa'i sgras: 'khor 'das snying po'i sngags gzer thebs: khyod the'u rang zer ba 'dre yi rigs: lha min grongakhyer skyong la chas: srung bya'i the'u rang ra rdzong shor: gling phu nus dpa' rtags rgyal kha blangs: rdzong brgyad po'i lde mig phyag tu 'phrod: gnam lha'i sprul gzhi dam la btags sprul pa brgya dang nyi shu de: sngags khro thung rgyal pos dam 'og bcug: khyod bar the'u ar gtad dgongs par 'dus: rgol mi thub chos sku'i sang na yod: glag mi nus longs sku'igadung rigs yin bsad lta ci sprul sku'i phrin las 'gyed: de go na lha 'dre'i sems la zhog: ma go rin chen sgog dang bral: kha so sa ti tri: a la ya dza zhes brjod nas tsher nagashing gi sgrub phur de bar the'u lcags khrab can la dug sprul gyi mgo dgu'i spud pa de skad cig kyang 'chug dbang med par g.ya' spang gi tshal bse sgrom spug por bcug nas lcags kyi tha ram brgyab la lo nyisastong dang nyis brgya nyi shu'i bar

ra gyi/ / dam la btags sprul pa brgya dang nyi shu der tri sa ku ru tsig tsag snying re ram̐ zhes tha tshag bsgrags tshe sngar nas nus mthu bsad pa'i dbang gis skyes mchog rdo rje legs pas phyag brnyan bya zhen brgya dang nyi shu'i 'bangs gral du btsud do kong gi btsan po khrom 'bar rgyal po de mgon skyabs kyi lha dang phyes nas 'dul sla bar byas so yang sbas pa'i rnal 'byor 'om bu'i chos 'bar dar lu bya ba sngags kyi grub pa thob kyang sbas tshul mdzadanas 'jig rten skye bo'i cha lugs kyis gnas na'ang 'di'i mdzad pa phrin las kyis skabs su sngagasahe ru ga' cha byad du zhugs nas gtang med rgya mtsho'i klong la phebs klu sa bdag gtod kyi sde 'khor gyis mdo rtsang bse lcags kyi ra bakhra mo gdol pa sha zan gyi gling brgya' yang steng lcagasakyi gur phub pa'i steng du rdo rje skyil krung mdzad nas dgongs pa ting nge 'dzin la gnas te lta stangs kyis gzigs tsa na bse khyung rlung gi gshog pa can zhes bya ba de'i sathe'u brgya dang nyishur sprul tshe dug zer gyis nam mkha' gang thog ser gyis rgol ba 'tshubs mi sdug pa'i cho 'phrul dang rgol ba sna dgu'i gzir ba na gang gisakyang brdzu ma zhugs par zil ba phrom mer bzhugs de'i tshe dam can rdo rje legs pas thatshig rjes su dran nas sa 'og tu ra zhen brgya dang nya shur sprul te sa ze4 rnams kyi mgo gnon mdzad cing phrin las kyis gzigs tshe ze'u rang dam sri'i sde tshogs 'dar yengs yengs bred hang hang dngang sa char chir lus pa na dgongs

pa chos nyid kyi don la gnas bzhin du tha tshag rdo rje' glu sngags pa dar lu'i glu 'di ltar blangs so glu a la sangs rgyas bstan pa bstod ma tha la 'jig rten srid pa skyongs chos 'jig rten gnyis po bde skyid phyir:glu dwangs ma'i sna len mkha' 'gros mdzod:sems gangadakar rdul gyis ma bslad na:dri med 'od kyi gong bu yin:rgyal ba dgyes pa'i sras po yin:ma rtogs 'khrul ba'i gzhi ma yin dgung a sngon bee ḍūr rdul bral nas:dpal nyizla skar tshogs bkra ba'i gzhir:yul 'gro khams mun pa sel byed red:de skyon gyis gos na mun pa red:chos sangs rgyas bstan pa srung mi de:bka' mi 'gyur dpa' rtagasagatsug tu khur:don legs nyes bden rdzun shan drangs phyes:chos mdo sngags gnyis kyi grogs po yin:bka' las 'das bdud dang dam sri'i rigs:don de tsho go'am rig pas dpyod:nga skye ba 'di yi gong rol na yul rgya gar 'phags sde'i grub mchog rgyal dpal ro lang bde ba zhes bya yin:gnas mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro'i gling la byon yul

༄༅/ / rigs sngags zhing skyes rnal 'byor ma don dga' ba bzhi yi rol ston mdzad:yang sdig can 'gro ba mang po 'dren:lha o rgyan chen po'i bka' byung nas thabs mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las des:deng lta log bstan pa bsnub pa'i phyir:rdzong bco brgyad dam ni nyer lnga po:bu 'dzam gling skyes bu'i bgo skal yin:khyed grub dbang thams cad 1snags la phebs:dpa' yang thul dam pa sum cur grags las sbyor sgrol du mas bdud dpung phab:dpal sangs rgyas bstan par so nams sgrub yongs 'a17 la bde skyid nyi ma shar:bka' de byung sgyu ma'i lus 'dir phebs:rdzong bcu bdun phab nas phrin las grub:deng the'u rang ra rdzong 'di phab na:bco brgyad kyi shwa bsgril 'grigs pa yin:ra ba'i rdzong khag brgyad po 'di:sgo srung dpa' rgod wa thul brgyad:gling dpa' bo ngar ma mched brgyad kyis thabs du mas tshar bcad rdul brlags byas dmag sde 'bangs kha lo gling la bsgyur:sems snang ba dam pa'i chos phyogs bkod:mdzod dgu po'i lde mig phyag tu rnyed:gnam bar snang the'u rang spun gnyis po:'khor 'byung po'i

zogs rnams dbang du btsud: gling sngags kyi dbang phyug rnam gnyis kyis: dam 'og du bcug nas chos la bkod: khyod sa the'u nag po lha 'dre'i tshogs: bka' rdo rjes tha tshig bsgrags la nyon: chos mdo sngags bstan pa gtsug tu khur: lha chos skyong rdo rje legs pa yis: bka'i 'khor na gnas pa'i sprul pa tsho'i: gral snyog na thabs yang phrin las 'grub yang byi rab bskal pa'i tha ma la dpal bde bar gshegs pa'i gral zin 'gyur: tri ye du tri sru tra bhyo: dri a ga ya dza dza zhes brjod nas gnam lcags kyi phur pa gzir tshe sprul bzhi bse khyung rlung gi gshog pa can mtsho mun nag lcags kyi ra ba dgu skor dang ldan pa'i ze'u 'byu lcags sgrom tha ram la bkod nas lo nyis stong dang nyis brgya nyi shur 'phar ldang 'gul bskyod mi nus par rtog med bde ba chen por brgyal bar byas nas btson du bzung ngo rgya li mar dpa' bo stag tsha sdong grogs kyi lha dang phyesanas mngon spyod drag po' 'dul sla bar byas so 'bangs the'u rang gi sprul pa brgya dang nyi shu skyes mchog rdo rje legs pa'i sprul pa ra zhen brgya dang nyi shu'i gral mthar bkod nas sang rgyas bstan pa'i srung mar bzhag go de nas dgra bla mtshal stag dmar po spug tshal dzo brag gi khrod nas slog mar 'khyug 'khyug byed bzhin du phebs dgung a sngon nam mkha'i dbyings

ra༅༅/ / nas dgra bla me khyung dmar po lcags kya mchu sder gyis 'byung po bsngangs shing rlung ga bde ga sgras srid pa gapo 'gul byed bzhan du phebs nags klong rlung 'tshubs kya khrod nas dgra bla lce spyang ngar mas ya rkan gnam la brdab ma rkan sa la bstan nas mche ba gangs ri ltar gtsigs bzhin rlung gi bang rtsal gyis phebs pa dang dgra bla dung seng dkar po gangs dkar rgya rtse nas g.yu ral lho sprin bzhin du bsags mchu sder spu gri'i rno par gzir nas phebs tsa na rten med 'ja' ya gur nang nas kha 'dzan dgra bla'i lcam mos gdug pa tshar gcod kyas glu 'di ltar blangs so oṃ tram̐ du tram̐ na tram̐ du dza: nus mthu thogs med stobs kyis rgyal drang sgong ma gatri pa la de: bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du mchod: dpa' rgod dgra bla bcu gsum gyis: de ring wer ma'i kha 'dzin mdzod: phu bo dung skyong dkar po dang : nu bo gnyan sras thogargod rtsal: tha chung klu phrug 'od ldan mkhyen: de ring wer mas kha 'dzin mdzod: gling lha sde'i kha 'dzin sdong grogs bdag: a ne gong sman rgyal po dang : sring chung tha le 'od dkaradang : tshe 'dzin bsam 'grub sgrol ma yis: de ring wer mas kha 'dzin mdzod steng slob dpon padma 'byung gnas dang byang lcang lo can nas gsang bdag rje: lho po ṭa la nas

spyan gzigs mkhyen: de ring wer mas kha 'dzin mdzod: rigs ldan shambha la'i yul nas: bcom ldan bde mchog yab yum dang : dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo mkhyen: de ring wer mas kha 'dzin mdzod gshin khyi dom nag spyon pa de: 'jang sa 'dam gdug pa'i bla stag red: de thul na smug po ming med byed 'khor ba'i sa bon skem pa yin: der dgrabla mtshal stag dmar pos gzir: bsgral 'dren dus mnyam 'byung nges mdzod: srin bya ya rgod khra tsha de: mon shing khri'i bla stag dam sri red de thul na sngon mo'i sa bon skem tshar gcod dgra bla me khyung sbran: bsgral 'dren dus mnyam 'byung bar mdzod: sdig pa sbrul nag mgo dgu de: hor sdig pa bu dgu'i srid rgod yin: de thul na ser mo ldang med 'gyur: tshar gcod dgra bla lce spyang gi: bsgral 'dren dus mnyam 'byung bar mdzod: mtshal mig khrag gi ya rgod de: brag mkhar khyung brag btsan lha'i srid: de tshar bcad khra bo'i sa bon skem: dngos gnyen dung seng dkar po sbran: bsgral 'dren dus mnyam 'byung bar mdzod mngon spyod las 'di dus gcig yin: las pa las la ma bul zhig: shan pa'i

༄༅/ / lag pa ma rdum shig: ngar ma'i mche ba ma ston zhig: rdzu 'phrul stobs rtsal ma zhan zhig: khong pa'i don snying spar mos thob: dpral ba'i mig 'byin klad rgyadamigs: 'byung bzhi'i sgyu lus bsreg blugs kyis: rdul ni rlung gis nam mkhar gtor: snyigs ma ri bo'i 'og tu gnon: 'phar ldang g.yo 'gul med par gyis: thub bstanagangs kyi ri bo la: gsang sngags gser gyi rta bdun 'byud bshad sgrub 'ja' lnga'i rgyal mtshan btsugs: rkang drug pad tshal bde skyid spyod: rdzogs ldan snang ba 'char b.rashog: ra ba'i rdzong khag lon par shog: rgyal khab rnam gsum 'dzin par shog: dam pa'i chos kyis 'tsho bar shog: don gnyis yid bzhin 'byung bar shog: chos bde skyida'ado/nga ba'i bkra shis thegag: ces gsungs sgra bsgrags tshe wer ma thams cad thog chu khol khol me rlu 'dzabs 'tshubs khra tsha 'byugs 'byugs byas nas gdug pa bdud kyi bla stag thams cad kya sgog snyi hub kyis 'dren don lnga snod drug rol sha lngags rus pa bsregs thal ba nam mkha' la rlung gis bdol zags pa ri rab kyi 'og tu dam sri btson 'dzin tshul du phyag rgyas btab bo de nas gangs can bod kyi rgyal po 'dzam bu glang gi skyes gcig yo

rgyan padma'i rgyal tshab srid gnyisaphyag gis 'dzin pa 'khor ba'i sgo 'phar gnon nang bdud dpung cham la phab nas sangs rgyasabastan pa'i so srung dgra 'dul dbang phyug chen po'i sku sprul dung zla'i 'od zer 'bar ba dung khyung dkar po'i khri la rol nas dung gi mi rta'i dmag dpung 'tshubs bzhin nam mkha' sprin gyi gur nang nas kha che'i lcags rna 'dul ba'i dgongs spyod rdo rje'i bro gar la gnas so gsung sprul padma 'bum sprin 'khrigs pa rjes chags bshad pa' dpa' skad sgrog bzhan me 'byug dmar po'i khri la rol nas glog dmar 'khyugs 'dra'i sprul pa'i las dmag bu yug 'tshub bzhin bar snang rten med kya khams nas rgya la mar stag tsha 'dul ba'i brtul zhugs mngon spyod drag po' phran las la zhugs so thugs sprul bee ḍūrya yi 'od stong 'bar bzhin 'do ba rkyang rgod 'phur shes la bcibasanas sprul pa lcags kyi mi rta thog ser 'khrigasa'akhrigs byas nas sa gzha las yar dpag pa'i cha nas chas te kong gi btsan po khrom 'bar rgyal po'i pho phrang 'khor sabargyad cu mtha' nas ram pa bco brgyad kyi tshul du bskor nasaganam sgo 'byed 'jug med pa' nyi zla' yang thog nas chos dbyangs skye 'gags 'gyur med kyi gsung dbyangs 'di ltar gnang ngo skyong dam chos ma j-i padme hūṃ: glu a la chos dbyings skye med glu: ma tha la bde stong 'gag med mdangs: gnas 'og min zhing la mchod pa 'bul: pha bka' rgyud bla ma mnyes gyur cig: yang zla

༄༅/ / gam dgu rdzogs bskang phyir bskrun: lhag lha'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig: o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling dbus nas: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mnyes gyur cig dam can pho nya las la sbran drag rtsal can rnams mthu stobs phyung : de ring bka' yi khri gdugs gong : ngas mdzad spyod 'gro phan phrin las bsgrubs: phyi'i yul sde 'dul badrag pos 'dul: nang nyon mongs 'dul ba dbang gis 'dul: gsang ba gnyis snang zhi bas 'dul: thams cad ro mnyam rgyas pas 'dul: stong pa chos dbyings pho brang nas chad pa'i mtha' grol ltad mo gda': steng na 'ja' 'od rma bya'i gdugs: de ka dag dbyings kyi snang ba red: de 'og 'ja' 'od dra ba bkram: de 'od gsal snang ba'i ri mo yin 'od lnga lhun grub thig le ru bzhi cu rtsa gnyis chos sku rdzogs: de zung 'jug 'od gsal snang ba yin: rigs bzhi rgyal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od lnga brtsegs thig le lu gu rgyud ye shes lnga yi gting mdangs ldan: de lhun grub bzhi sbyor snang ba yin: 'og na gdul bya'i bkod pa ni kong the'u rgyal khab rnam gsum 'di rtogs na sku gsum zhing la bsgral

ma rtog ngan song gsum gyi rgyu: ra ba'i rdzong khag brgyad po 'di rnam par grol na sgo brgyad yin: ma bsgral 'khrul ba tshogs brgyad yul: 'dren mdzad ston pa thugs rje can: lha o rgyan padma'i brin las nga : tsitta zangs mdog dpal ri nas: khams lnga 'dus pa mkha' 'gro'i gling : bde chen thig le dpal gyi ri: shes rab rang byung padma 'byung : gdangs rtsal ma 'gags lo paṇa 'khor: 'dren ston nga la lhun gyis grub ka ti chos dbyings ḍā ki'i yul: 'byung ba'i rgyang zhags sa spyod gnas: dbang po'i rgyang zhags mkha' spyod zhing : shes rab rgyang zhags gsang dbyings dal: gnas yul dur khrod he ru ga'i: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i nye 'du mdzad: 'dren ston nga la phun sum tshogs: dung khang bhan te 'i gzhal yas na 'aX ra 'das spyi dpal he ru ga: gnam zhal dbang phyug bde rgyas 'debs: rigs lnga gnas yul mkha' 'gro ma drug cu rtsa brgyad 'bar ba'i lha: 'dren mdzad nga la rang chas rdzogs: thabs kyi phyag rgya g.yas pa na shes rab mda' rnon 'jigs med bsten: stong pa g.yon gyi phyag rgya na snying rje'i gzhu chen 'gro la 'gugs bdag

༄༅/ / 'dzin mtshan ma gcod pa'i mtshon: mtshon chen ral gri rked la 'chang : snying stobs las byung gdon 'dul phyir: khrab dkar 'od stong sku la mnab rdul las byung ba'i gdon 'dul byir: rmog dkar bsam 'grub dbu la gsol: mun pa las byung gdon 'dul phyir: sog lham 'ja' 'khyugs rkang la bkra: sku mi g.yo ri rgyal lhunapo 'dra: gsung 'gag med tshangs dbyangs 'byug ltar sgogs: khyod 'khrul snang du tra'i 'byung ngag 'gags thugs mi 'khrul 'od gsal chos sku'i gzugs: khyod 'khrul snang rūtra'i dug gsum 'gags: de rjes bzhi char gnas pa de: ngo bo nyid sku'i gdul bya ste: bdag med byang sems mgon por 'gyur: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srung mar bzhag: ma 'ongs sangs rgyas lung bstan thob: mi 'gyur dam tshig rdo rje gtad: phrin las nub med thod rgyan gsal: 'gong po khu le gong rgyal gdags da lhun grub sgo brgyad snang ba yang sbra gur mtha' nas dbus bsdu bzhin: nang gsal chos skur zim pa dang : khyod bsgral 'dren byed pa dus mnyam yin: chos go bar gyis shig khrom 'bar rgyal: 'khrul ba ar

la gtad pa yin: bdag 'dzin rtsad nas gcod pa yin ma rig grong khyer gzhom pa yin: rnam rtog gi 'khrul 'khor bshig pa yin: bdud kyi sa bon stong pa yin: ma go na yang gsal sbyo/ med ces rdo rje'i gsungs bsgrags nas spyi gtsug ye shes kyi 'khor lo nas lha dbang chen yab yum spros te btsan po khrom 'bar rgyal dang sha za mi srun ku lang gnyis kyi rnam shes 'og min la bkod bde ba chen po'i rol rtsed mdzad phyogs skyong khro bo bcu za gsod pho nya dang bcas pa 'dzam gling rgyal po' sku'i gnas bcu las spros te gdul bya des phung khams la thal 'byin gya phur pa gdab ye shes kyi mtshon cha sprosate dug gsum nyon 'khrul bag chagasadang bcas pa bcom gyad kyi mi bo che dgu brgya go cig mngon spyod drag po' phrin lasal drangs phyi'i 'khor ba skyong ba' las pa 'bum khri 'bum stong slong seng chen rgyal po' mnga' 'og tu bsdus nas dam bzhag gsung bsgrags chos kyi bdud rtsis tshims par mdzad do gnyug mar gnas pa'i shes pa dregs pa 'i sde dpon gyi gral du bkod nas sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gnyer ka lag tu gtad do de nas sgo med sa nas zang thal du pho bra dbang rdzogs rdo rje' phug par rin chen sna bdun gyi khri khar bzhugs nas 'dzam gling skyes bu'i gzugs byad ci bzhin pa bstan nas kong me tog lha mdzes sgrol ma la 'od gsal bde stong rol ba'i glu 'ad ltar gnang ngo skyes ārya tā re hūṃ

༄༅/ / swā hā glu a la bde ba chen po'i ngang : ma tha la chags pa bral ba'i don: bde stong zung 'jug rol ston la: tshur nyon dang me tog lha mdzes sgrol: nga gangs can bod kyi srid 'dzin pa'i: chos kyi rgyal po ge sar yan: lta log mu stegs bstan skyong ba'i: hor 'jang mon dang rgya sog ste: rdzong khag mang po mang 'a dbang bsdus: lta log ston pa'i rgyal po 'dul: ja ma sman chen mang po de lha o rgyan chen po'i smon lam bzhin: blo sems 'dun pa nga la gtad: dung sman srung mar mnga' gsol yin khyod kyi sngon gnas rjes dran nam: dbyangs can lha mos sprul pa red: ngag gi bden pa grub pa yin: lha spyan gzigs khyed rgyan pad 'byung gi: thugs bskyed smon lam ji bzhin du: kong the'u rang ra rdzong phab pa'i phyir: kong za me tog lha mdzes sprul: ra ba'i rdzong khag brgyad po nas: dpa' rgod wa thul mched brgyad po: da ming tsam mi mnga' bsgral 'dren byas: kha che'i rgyal po lcags rna can ngas sku yi 'dul bar mdzad rgyu yin: sprul sku'i bstan pa skyong rgyu yin: rgya li mar dpa' bo stag tsha de ngas gsung gi 'dul bas 'dren rgyu yin:

longs sku'i bstan pa spel rgyu yin: kong the'u rgyal po bcan khrom 'bar: phrin las bzhi yi phyag rgyas btab: 'bras bu'i dbang bskur spyi blugs btsal: thugs dgongs 'gyur ba med pas btul: rnam shes 'og min zhing la spar sgyu lus phung por gsang sngags chos: ma bsgrags rang byung 'khor lo bskor chos sku'i bstan pas skyong rgyu yin gyad kyi dpung rnams bsgral 'dren byas dmangs kyi kha lo chos la bsgyur: kong za me tog lha mdzes lo: nga'i chos mdzad grogs mo byed dam ci: gsang sngags lde mig mi spro'am sgo gsum nga la 'bul lam mam: g.yo sgyu rdzun tshig mi mnga' bar bden drangs dam tshig ngag nas zlos: gtam sems la zungs shig lha sman lo: zhes rdo rje'i tha tshig 'byur ba med pa'i bka' gsung bsgrags tshe kong za me tog lha mdzes sgrol ma des g.yu sgra g.yas su byug rin chen za 'og ga na bza' sku chings bsdam sa mag sto nor bu'i rgyan cha lus la gsol chu dar stong ru g.yas 'khyil phyag tu bsnams shel sbos nyi zla'i sgron me phyag rten tu phul gser gzhong nor bu'i bkang ba mdun du bzhag dzā ti sman gyi a ru skyems su drangs gus phyag lan gsum 'tshal nas brtse bas rjes su 'dzin pa'i zhu gsol 'di ltar phul skye/ dam dzadas ma

༄༅/ / ṇi padme / bka' yang dag chos la skyabs su mchi: gnas ngan bdud kyi yul sa nas: da ni chos la 'god du gsol: sa 'di kong the'u gnam pa'i rdzong mkhar khog dgu dgu'i yang thog brtsegs: gzim khang nor bu'i mig stong bkra: mi shigs rdo rjes phug pa red: yab rje skye ba bdud ltar skye: shi ba dam pa'i chos la dril: nganasong 'khor ba'i skye sgo 'gags: thar lam thob pa bka' drin che: yum rje skye ba dmu la skye: shi ba gsang sngags thabs lam shi: rnam smin skal ma skad cig bsgyur: bsgrala'adren dus gcig bka' drin che: gyad kyi sgo srung sdig to can rig rig gsod pa'i shan pa tsho: bsam long 'khrul long med pa rba dgongs pa chos sku'i rgyas btab nas bsad dang 'dren pa bka' drin che 'khor ba'i dpung rnams gnag cing rtsub: sha za 'dre dang srin po'i rigs ma rig 'khrul ba ar gtad nas: blo sems snang ba dbangabasgyur nas: chos la 'god pa bka' drin che: kho mo pho brang nang na gnas: bya spyod kong the'u'i chul 'dzin dgos: blo sems dam pa chos la dkar: 'dul ba gsum gnang

bka' drin che: gang sku bee ḍūr lhun po 'dra chos kyi dbyings la 'gyur ba med: 'gyur med thugs kyi bstan pa ni: snga 'gyur gyi sgron me sbar du gsol: gang sku padma rā ga'i zhal bde chen chags kun bral ba'i mdzod: 'od gsal dga' bzhi'i bstan pa ni: phyis 'gyur gsang sngags gnang bar zhu: gang sku gangs ri'i lhun po la: bag chags rdul gyis ma gos pa'i: byang chub sems dpa'i lta spyod lam: kun 'byung bstan pa skyong bar zhu: nam mkha' sprin gyi gur nang nas: the'u rang bla ma dam la btags: seng zhen brgya dang nyi shu tshos: kong the'u bstan pa bsrung du gsol: bar snang stong pa'i dbyings rum nas the'u rang mkhan po e klong brub: bya zhen brgya dang nyi shus blangs kha che'i bstan pa chos bzhin bsrungs: gting med rgya mtsho'i ke'u tshangs nas: the'u rang rgyal po ar la gtad ra zhon brgya dang nyi shus bzung : rgya li mar chos srid bstan pa spel: shar dung brag nor bu'i rdzong chen gyi: lde mig dung za dngul lhas 'dzin: zhi ba'i thabs la drangs nas su: lha sras dgra lha rtse rgyal gyi: phyag la 'phrod zer nga tsho spro: lho brag byu ru dar rdzong gi: lde mig

༄༅/ / g.yu za lha dgas bsnams: rgyas pa'i phrin las zab mos bskul: 'dan sras nor bu bsam 'grub la: lde mig 'phrod zer nga rang spro nub zangs sgo'i go khrab mtshon rdzong gi: lde mig zangs lha sgon mes 'dzin: bde chen dbang gi rgyas btab nas: sdig can shan pa thog nag la: lde mig 'phrod zer nga rang spro: byang lcags sgo'i rta nor lug gi rdzong : sde mig lcags mo mi zan gyi: bu mo dar skyid lha mos 'dzin mngon spyod drag po'i gzir dbang gis: gdol ba a stag dpa' mo la: lde mig 'phrod zer nga rang spro shar lho mchong rdzong sman gyi mdzod: lde mig gnam lha spun mos 'dzin zhi ma rgyas pa'i gzir dbang gis: rang sgog btsa' shes dam mnos nas: 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur la: lde mig 'phrod zer nga rang spro: lho nub shel sbos g.yu yi rdzong : sde mig kho mi gzi sgron 'dzin rgyas ma dbang gi 'dul ba na: ro nye ring med par cha mnyam ste gzugs legs chos 'phan dar yag la: lde mig 'phrod zer nga rang spro: nub byang thod pa rdzas sngags rdzong : lde mig thod dgu lcam mos 'dzin: dbang ma drag pos dmag sde

btul: sgrogs ngar mas nus mthu ma bzod nas: 'bru sras thog rgod 'bar ba la: lde mig 'phrod zer nga rang spro: byang shar khra mo ra yi rdzong : lde mig kha che'i dpal sgron 'dzin drag ma zhi bas dmag sde btul: dung zhags dung mda'i rno dbal tsha: dpa' ma bzod sgog snying gsang thang shor: dung skyong stag lha khri dkar la: lde mig 'phrod zer nga rang spro gling spyi sde'i dpon po khro thung des dpa' a rgyal so pa khra mgo bsad: da yang rgyal gnam the'u bla ma btul: sngags dbang phyug de la skyabs su mchi: nga kong za me tog lha mdzes kyis: dpon de yi ja ma byed pa min: thabs bde stong bsgom pa'i grogs mo min: nga'i bsam pa dkar po gling la yod: bsam khog drang mo khyed la yod: chos bde stong bsgom pa'i grogs mo byed a ti rdzogs pa chen po'i gnad: nga la ngo sprod gnang bar zhu : zhu dar chu ri stong 'khyil yin: zhu rten gser gzhong nor bus bkang : shel spos nyi zla'i sgron me yin: glus mchod pa 'od gsal dpal wer zhog glu lan bdud rtsi'i char rgyun phob: zhes gsol ba btab tshe 'dzam gling skyes bu don 'grub des 'dzum zla zhal rgya mdangs bstan gsungs

༄༅// 'dzom glu ri mos rta la drangs thugs dgyes brtses rnam ra dang ldan pa sa gsungs lan 'di ltar gdab bo oṃ dam chos ma ṇi padme sa:bka' yang dag chos la gathegal ba 'debs gnas rigs drug 'khor ba' sa bon skem:yongs thar lam thob par byin gyis rlobs:glu mchod cig rdo rje 'chang dbang mchod:mchod gnyis nges pa lnga ldan mchod mchodagasum rigs gsum mgon po mchod:mchod bzhi dpal ri'i pad 'byung mchod:mchod lnga rigs lnga' mkha' 'gro mchod:mchod drug bcom ldan thub drug mchod:mchodabadun sangs rgyas rab bdun mchod mchod brgyad bde gshegs mched brgyad mchod:mchod dgu sa dgu'i sems dpa' mchod:mchod bcu phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas mchod bcu gcig dgongs kyi yar steng nas bcu drug ye shes bla ma'i bar:rig pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems mkhyen:gdul bya'i sgo gsum smin gyur cig:chos dbyings nam mkha'abee ḍūr zhal:nyi zla skar tshogs 'od gsal 'dzoms bar snang stong pa'i dbyings rum nas:'ja' khyim dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'dzoms:mgo bo ri rgyal lhun po la rnam rgyal

khang bzang rmog dkar 'dzoms sku lus ri bo mchog rab la: khrab dkar snang ba'i sgron me 'dzoms: phyag g.yas thabs kyi rang bzhin la: lcag tshan bsam pa'i don 'grub 'dzoms: g.yon pa shes rab snang cha la dgos 'dod kun 'byung gter bum 'dzoms: g.yas phyogs mdung mo rtse rgyal la dgra lha glog zhags dmar po 'dzoms: g.yon ngos ri mtshon khra bo la: pho nya dung khyung dkar po 'dzoms: spyan mig nyi zla gsal ba la: shes rab rang byung sgrol ma 'dzoms rdzi smin khyung chen lding 'dra la: bka' rgyud bla ma'i 'dren stobs 'dzoms zhal tshom dom nag ze ba la: mkha' 'gro'i bde stong rang 'bar 'dzoms: zhal 'dzum padma'i dkyil 'khor la 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dam chos 'dzoms:snyan dang shangs khung dkyil 'khor la: bde stong 'gag pa med par 'dzoms: dung khang bhanta'i dkyil 'khor la khrag 'thung khro bo'i lha tshogs 'dzoms: spyi bor gser 'khor rtsibs bzhi la: dngos grub kun 'byung dpa' bo 'dzoms: dza lanta ra'i ba gam la: pha bka' rgyud bla ma pad 'byung 'dzoms longs spyod 'khor lo lam pa shar: dpa' bo yab

༄༅/ / yum mched lnga 'dzoms gnyi ga'i yul dpal be'u lhun sangs rgyas bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis 'dzoms: tri sha ku na'i dkyil 'khor na: sa spyod mkha' spyodamakha' 'gro 'dzoms: pre ta pu ru'i bkod pa la: dpa' btsun dgra bla sum cu 'dzoms: sog pa g.yas kyi dkyil 'khor na: dgra bla mtshal stag dmar po 'dzoms: sog pagayon gyi phrag steng na: dgra bla dung seng dkar po 'dzoms: nu steng g.yas kyi dkyil 'khor na: zhi byed dung khyung dkar po 'dzoms: g.yon pa o ṭi ya na sa gdug pa tsharagacod dug khyung 'dzoms: mchan khung ka ma du pa'i yul rten 'brel brdas ston rus sbal 'dzoms: de bzhin g.yon pa ko sa lar: sa 'og gdon 'dul dur phag 'dzoms bol kong sidhi la na'i drung : lha min tshar gcod lcags sdig 'dzoms: sgal tshigs nyi shu rtsa brgyad la: dbang phyug gser gyi sring mo 'dzoms: lhu chen rnam pa bcu gnyis la lcam dral mo ma bcu gnyis 'dzoms: yan lag rnam pa bzhi dag la: phyogs skyong rgyal chen sde bzhi 'dzoms: ba spu nyi khri chig stong la: ḍā ki nyi khri chig stong 'dzoms: g.yo ba

brgyad khri bzhi stong la: dpa' mo 'bum sprin lhun 'grub 'dzoms: gnas pa rtsa yi dkyil 'khor la: dpa' bo thabs kyi cha rnams 'dzoms: kun 'byung byang chub sems dag la bde stong 'du 'bral med par 'dzoms: phyi sku gdung rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor la dpal chen khro bo rol pa 'dzoms: nang padma rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor la: dbang chen rta phagasras 'khor 'dzoms: gser sga nyi ma rang shar la: ser po tor 'dul dgra bla 'dzoms: bal stan sme ba dgu bsgrigs la: ta zig rdzong phab dgra bla 'dzoms: lcags kyi yobachen 'byug 'bur la sngon po mon 'dul dgra bla 'dzoms: bee ḍūrya yi gong rmed la: smug po 'jang 'dul dgra bla 'dzoms: srab lcags se rung ngar ma la: nag po bdud 'duladagra bla 'dzoms: dung srab g.yu yi mthur chung la: rgya nag 'dul ba'i dgra bla 'dzoms gdong thag byu ru'i phra chen la: nor rdzong bcu 'phrad dgra bla 'dzoms 1 len gseramig dgu bsgrigs la: rgya mtsho chu gter dgra bla 'dzoms: rta mchog rkyang rgod 'phur shes la: rdzong nyer lnga phab pa'i dgra bla 'dzoms: 'gros dgu'i bsgrod tshul ldan pa la: rim

༄༅/ / dgu'i chos ston 'gyed pa 'dzoms: e ha'i sgra skad sgog pa la 'dzam gling bde la bkod par 'dzoms: rmig bzhi lcags las grub pa la: dmyal zangs khalo bsgyur ba 'dzoms: 'phur rtsal rlung gi gshog pa la: phrin las thogs pa med pa ra 'dzoms: rmog la dar 'phru btsugs pa la: yab bka' rgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs 'dzoms khrab dkar gser thag bsdams pa la: yi dam sgrub rgyud dngos grub 'dzoms: sog lham nywa chab sgogs tsa na ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i phrin las 'dzoms: stag ral g.yas su sengaltar 'khyugs: sde dpon sum cu'i mda' ngar 'dzoms: gzig shubs g.yon du sbrul ltar 'khrugs: khams gsum dgra 'dul dbang sdud 'dzoms shes rab ral gri sked labarten: bdag 'dzin gcod pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzoms: kong za me tog lha mdzes 'phrad mkha' la nyi zla rang chas 'dzoms: thabs la shes rab ja 'dren de: 'brug dang rmabya'i dga' ston 'dzoms: bde stong rol rtsed bsgyur tsa na: gangs la gdong lnga brtse bar 'dzoms: rgyal khab chos kyis skyong pa na g.yu ljongs pad tshal bkra ba 'dzoms: dpon

slob bsam pa gcig pa de chu dang gser mig 'phrad ltar 'dzoms:glu chos dbyings stong pa'i rang sgra der:thos grol 'dren pa'i phrin las 'dzoms:kha che lcags rna rgyal po de sku yis 'dul ba bde legs 'dzoms:rgya li mar dpa' bo stag tsha de:gsung gis 'dul bas dpa' rtags 'dzoms:kong gi btsan po khrom 'bar rgyal:thugs ye shes kyisa'adul ba'i dpa' rtags 'dzoms:dung sman khos chang skyems drang ba de:sngon smon dag pa'i thugs bskyed 'dzoms:gling che rgyud gser shog bco brgyad la:bso sgras bskulabs 'bod pa 'dzoms 'bring rgyud 'om bu tsho drug la ki sgras bskul bas dung brda 'dzoms:chung rgyud mu spyang sde bzhi la:cha sgras snyan gsan rgyal rnga 'dzoms:spyan migagayas kyi gzigs tsa na:gser dmag kha char 'bab 'bab 'dzoms:sbyan mig g.yon gyis gzigs tsa na:'om dmag bu yug 'tshubs 'dzabs 'dzoms zhal 'dzum rkan sgrabasgrags pa na:dmu dmag thog ser khol khol 'dzoms:dgra bla'i dar lce phyar ba na:lta log bstan pa 'dul ba 'dzoms:rlung rta'i ba dan brdal ba na:gsod gcod bon

༄༅/ / btul nus mthu 'dzoms: ja ma dung sman nyi shu gcig: sgrol ma nyer gcig phrin las 'dzoms: phu nu thog rgod brgyad cu la: grub chen brgyad cu'i thugs bskyed 'dzoms: yang thul dam pa sum cu la: dpa' rtsal thog 'dra'i nus mthu 'dzoms 'gran med dpa' bo mched brgyad la: ra ba'i rdzong phab rten 'brel 'dzoms: gling sngags pa nus ldan rnam gsum gyi: the'u rang dam 'dogs nus mthu 'dzoms: rgyal khab rnam gsum btul ba yi: stobs dbang thang skyes bu nga la 'dzoms: ngag 'dzoms glu ring mos bden tshig brjod: bu'i 'dra ma yag gi rnam thar de: ma dbyangs can sprul pa'i thugs la zhog: yongs rgyal khams bde ba'i mdzad pa skyongs zhes gsu sa mi 'gags chos nyid kyi rang sgra bsgrags pa sa kong za me tog la mdzes de rjes su ya rang de nas kong za me tog la mdzes des khrims rnga 'brug stong skad gze sa zal gnon lan gsum brdungs mkhar rnga sto gsum sgras khyab lan dgur brdungs chos dung dga' ldan lhas gsan thengs gsum bus 'dzam gli skyes bu don 'grub des ka bso cha sgras mthu ldan skyes bu brgyad dang gling pa yongs la khab mdzad tsha che rgyud gser shog bco brgyad kyi las dmag gis kha che' rgyal khab man chad

gang 'bring rgyud 'om bu'i las dmag gas rgya la dmar chu shod yan chad bkang chu rgyud dmu spyang sde bzhi'i las dmag gis kong the'u rang gi rgyal khab gang bar mdzad sngags mkhan khro thung rgyal po la skyes sngags grub chen brgya dang brgyad cus bsgor te nam mkha' nas byon gling bla rdo rje drag rgyal la gli— chos sde'i ca ra smig 'dzan pa rnams kyis bskor te bar snang nas byon 'om bu' dar lu mtshal yag la sbas pa'i rnal 'byor drug cusabaskor nasas gzhi las yar dpag tsam mdzad de 'od lam lam zer 'khrigs 'khrigs byas te ze bas pa ra mdzad dpa 'a 'bum dgra lha rtse rgyal de tho rangs kyi skar chen bzhin du bdud 'dul lasakyi dmag spre'u dkar stong khyu da bcas te shar rdzong nas phebs 'dan sras nor bu bsam 'grub lcags se rung gi mgar dum chad chad byed bzhan gdul bya' las dmag dang bcas te sto nas phebs sdog can shan pa rme ru dmar nag glog zhags 'khyugs 'khyugs bka' nyan dmag sde dang bcasate nub nas phebs a stag dpa' ba'i klu mo thog chu khol khol rgya khrom pa spya thul dkar po ser nag 'khrigs 'khrigs byas te sha za' las dmag khrid nas bya rdzong nas phebs 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur des glag rog mo' gshog 'gyur byed byed mdzad de mthon po rta rna'i dmag bcas shar lho nas ze bas gling chos 'phan dar yag stag tshang nas thon thon byas te rngabs shod gtum po'i las dmag bcas lho nub phyogs nas phebs 'bru sras rdo rje thog rgod lho

ra gyi/ / 'brug byang ma'i ngar skad ldir ldir sdig pa lcags khrab can gyi las dmag bcasanub byang nas phebs dung skyong stag lha khri dkar rlung bsil mar gyi bu yug 'tshubasa'atshubs lang gar tsha chu 'o ma'i las dmag dang bcas te byang shar nas phebs so skyes bu rtsal ldan de dag gis dpa' rtags dgra la ngom nas che ba'i stobasartsal 'gran rabs rje seng chen rgyal po la yar zhus mdzad sna len dang ja 'dren skyes dar gtang rag gnang ngo mdzod brgyad po'i lde mig thams cad kong za me tog lha mdzes la phul de nas gling seng chen rgyal po de'i sku sprul dung gi zla ba des kha che'i rgyal po' cha lugs yo byad nyer lnga spras nas g.yas su bzhugs gsung sprul padma 'bum sprin 'byud pa des rgya li dmar stag tsha'i cha lugs bco brgyad mdzes par bklubs nas g.yon du bzhugs zugs sprul 'dzam gling skyes bu don 'grub des don 'grub gling gi la chas thams cad sku la mnabs kong rje'i ngan sngags kyi yo byad thams cad mdun du bkod g.yas gral la che rgyud dpa' bo gtso dgu'i dpa' thul rnams bzhugs g.yon gral du stag mo bu dgus gtsosadapa' thul rnamasabazhugs mdun gral du chung rgyud bra glag spyang gsum gyis gtsosadapa' thul thams cad bzhugs za 'og dgu brtsegs kyi khri khar khro thung bzhugs bdun brtsegs kyi khar gling bla rdo rje drag rgyal bzhugs lnga brtsegs kyi khar 'om bu dar lu bzhugs mtha' 'khor na che 'bring chung gi las dmag

thams cad nam mkha' la skar tshogs bkra ba lta bu sagazhi la pad tshal 'khrungs pa lta bu rgya mtsho la gzugs brtan bkod pa bzhin du bkrag mer mer lhun sdug sdug dpa' brjid brjed mdzad nas bzhugs ra ba'i dmag sde brgyadapo'i phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas mgo 'phang dma' bzhin du mtha' gral bskyangs so de'i tshe kong za me tog lha mdzes des 'dzam gling rgyal po la chang 'dren dang skyes dar phul kha che'i zi lan mtshos sngags pa khro thung la sha 'dren dang skyes dar phul rgya za de ba lhas dpa' bo mched brgyad la chang 'dren da skyes dar phul lde mig gnam lha'i bu mo brgyad kyis glang tsho drug lha sde rnams la ja chang sha yis ston 'byed mdzad skabs gling se chen rgyal po'i sku'i spru' pa dungazla dkar pos kha che'i rgyal po lcags rna can btul tshul gyi glu rdo rje' brda chos 'di ltar bsgrags so oṃ dam chos ma ṇi padme sa: bka' yang dag de la skyabs su mchi ma 'gro drug thar ba'i lam la drongs kong the'u rang chos kyis 'dul bar shog tshur nyon dang sngags kyi dbang phyug gsum: dpa' ya med dgra bla'i skyes bu brgyad: gling tsho drug lha sde dkar po lo: stod kha che'i rgyal po lcags rna can sha za sdig pa srin po'i rigs: lus zangs lcags khro zhun nyid las grub: dus rtag par gsod gcod shan las byed: brgya stong srog 'phrog pa'i
