gling par mun pa'i smag rum bcug rgyal ba byams mgon bstan pa'i dus: thar nas ngan song skye sgo 'gog: 'khor sa drug skor bcu gnyis kyis: lde mig kha che'i rgyal po yi sras lcam zi lan gnam khri mo bde stong dga' bzhi'i dbang du bsgyur: chags pa'i mtshan ma grol bar byas: gzugs byad mthong bas skom sel ba:sha za'i rigs can mgonon dka' gling spyi dpon khro thung rgyal po de: 'byung ba lnga la rang dbang thob sgyu lus bde stong lha skur smin snang ba dbang bsgyur he ru ga:thog mtha' bar gsum bka' drinache sku drin gso ba'i yon slad du thugs byon rig mar brtsal nas mchod: tshim pa drug ldan zlos gar rol: zhal 'dzum brtse bar bcas te bzhes: phyi mdzod rgyal po gsumagyi dkor ra ba'i rdzong khag brgyad po yin:nang mdzod gnag phyugs bsam mtha' yas: gling tsho drug lha sdes bgo rgyu yin: dar zab go khrab chas rgyan rigs:gling dpa' thularnams kyis gang dgar spyod gser g.yu rin chen gzi mchong che: gling ma sru bu mo thugs mthun longs: dar gdugs 'phan yab rol mo'i rigs gling sngags sde btsun sde

༄༅// rnams kyis yin ja chang zas sna dgu khri stong :dpon khro thung rgyal po'i bgo skal yin:lhab lhub gsang mdzod mig dgu po:dpa' ya med skyes bu brgyadakyi yin:'bru sman ri rgyal lhun po'i gter:drag rgyal dar lu'i thugs bzhed yin:'khor khri skor brgyad cu'i nor longs spyod:gling tsho drug lha sde dkar pos spyod:rgyu medathams cad phyug po gyis:zas med thams cad brgyag po gyis:dkor med thams cad phyur phyur gyis phywa g.yang mkha' ltar 'dzoms par mdzod:btsan phyug lho sprin ltar ldanamadzod:'phan dar nyi zla ltar gsal mdzod:dam pa chos kyi gzhi 'dzugs dgos:yang dgos thub bstan dam chos ni:srid na grags pas spangs rtogs dgos sems canabade skyid 'byung nges dgos rgyal ba'i thugs bzhed bskongs nges dgos gling ge sar bsam don 'grub nges dgos:dpa' thul thugs mthun zhe mthun dgos:bstan pa b.rachad med par dgos dgra btul ba'i dpa' rtags de 'dra red:gnyen skyong ba'i 'dun ma de 'dra red chos bstan pa skyong tshul de 'dra red:gling tsho drag lha sde'i thugs la

zungs: che rgyud la btsan phyug 'dzoms par sgo ga: 'bring rgyud la 'phan dar ldan par sgo ga: chung rgyud la dpa' rtsal 'dzoms gyur cig: gling spyi dpon a mye khra rgan dang : dbangaphyug khro thung rgyal po dang : 'dzam gling seng chen rgyal po yi: bstan pa rgya che rgyun ring nas: 'brel tshad 'dren pa'i bkra shis sgo ga zhes gsu sa nas sku sprul zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de sprul gzhi bee ḍūrya'i dal du bsdus gling wa ste rnams kyis bka' drin che ba'i lo rgyus dang bcas te re smon yid bzhin du grub nas kha dga' kha la 'dzum ro dga' ro la 'khyil sems dga' snying la gsal nas bde skyid chos bzhin du spyod do yang gsung sprul padma 'bum sprin 'jil ba'i rdo rje des bde ba chen po' rol ston la spyod bzhin pa ra gling shog gsum lha sde rgya mtsho dang dpa' ya thul dam pa rnams la rgya li mar stag tsha 'dul tshul gyi glu dga' ba'i me tog 'di ltar phul lo oṃ hya snyi wa na mo sa: dbang lha rta mgrin dmar po de: bde chen 'khor lo' rgyan du bzhugs: rjes chags 'dzum zhal rtag par ngom: glu a la skye ba med pa'i glu: pha bka' rgyud bla ma yab sras mchod ma tha la 'gags pa med pa'i glu: dbyings bde stong dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mchod: tha drangs bde stong zung 'jug glu: lha dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rje

༄༅// mchod:sems 'dun ma grub pa ngo mtshar gnas:chos lhag bsam dkar po'i me tog 'thor:tshad med rnam bzhi'i bdud rtsi dbab:phrin las bzhi yi phyagargyas btab zhe sdang rdo rje'i tshul bzung nas snying rje'i 'gal zla gzhom par byas:'dod chags rdo rje'i tshul bzung nas:tshul khrims 'gal zla tshar gcod byas:gti mug rdorje'i tshul bzung nas:ma rig mun khams 'joms par byas:tshur nyon dang 'dra ma lab rgyu yod:gling lha sde dkar po'i thugs la zungs yang sgos dpa' thul rnams la 'bul dpa' yang rgod dam pa mi brgyad kyis wa thul mched brgyad btul ba sogs:dpa' ya med rdzu 'phrul stobs 'gyed tshul:rlung bsil mar gyi phrin de rgyal khams bsgrags lho'abrug grags grags ldir ldir byed:go ma chod pa la gcig kyang med:don ma 'grub pa la gang ya med:ngas rgya sde dbang du bsdu ba'i tshul:li mar stag tsha 'dul ba'i tshul de bā lha chos la bsgrur ba'i tshul 'dra ma yag mdo tsam bshad kyis nyon:rgya li mar rgyal khab kha zhing che:btsan khro chu dngul rdzong dgung dang mnyam:mkhar nyis brgya nyi shus

nang bskor byas: bzhi brgya bzhi bcus phyi skor byas: mdzod mig stong phrag steng nas bcad: dpa' mkhar bdun cu bar skor byas: rgya has tir bdun cu srung mar 'dug: shel sna bdun las grub dkyil khang grub: phyi ni pha lam zhun gyis bsdams: nang ni nyi zla'i sgron me sbar: 'dod yon bu mo lnga bcus bstod thugs mthun de bā lha mo yin: 'byug tsangs nyal brgyad kyi khri yi khar: stag lpags dmar po brgyangs pa'i steng sdig pa dom nag khrag 'thung rgyal: rgya li mar dpa' bo stag tsha 'dug mgo ral ba'i dkyil na stag mgo yod: bu stag mo stong gis 'dul skal med: dpral ba'i dkyil na chu sbrul mig: zhe sdang can gyi 'dul skal med: gsang ba pho min ma ning tshul 'dod chags can gyis 5dul skal med: bzhag na 'dzam gling dbang du byed bshad na bon gyi bstan pa 'dzin: sgom na mu stegs lta ba bsgom: sgrub na the'u rang spun gsum bsgrub las ni gsod gcod shan las byed: brgya yis gcan gzan lpags pa 'jal stong gis sha rwa gla rtsi stob: khri yis rno ngar mtshon brdar byed: 'bum gyis sha 'jal khrag 'jal byed: 'dul ba

༄༅/ / mi dgos mthong ba sdug 'jig rten mi yis ga la thub: nga'i sku las rte'u phag chung sprul: kho yi 'dod chags mtshan ma btul: gsung las lcags khyung dugakhyung sprul: kho yi gti mug 'dul bar byas: thugs las khro bo khro mo spros: kho yi zhe sdang 'joms par byas gzugs lhu drug phung khams skye mched kyis: 'dzam gling sa gnas byeb rtsa dam sri mnan pa bye ba brtsams smon grub bye ba'i 'og tu mnan 'di 'dzam gling yun du bde ba'i phyir: 'don mi rung gter kha bkod pa yin: 'phar na nad mug mtshonagasum 'byung : ldang na mtha' mi'i rgyal khams phongs: de dam la 'dogs tshul de 'dra red: las byed has tir bdun cu po: thabs bdun cu'i mdzad pas 'dul bar byas 'dod yon bu mo zhe dgu po: sog a ro mṛ ta'i yul la sprugs: 'jag skya'i spyil bo gcig tu bkod: lnga bcing drug 'bur brgyag la sprad mgo la ting 'dzin mar me bzhag sems la rtog med dgongs rgya bkram bar bskal gcig la btson du bzung : thugs mthun de bā lha mo de: blo sems snang ba dbang du bsgyur: dam pa chos kyi lam la drangs

mdo sngags gzhung la yid ches thob:gling dpa' thul rnams kyi gral du bzhag:phyis 'byung rdzong khag bzhi phab tshe:sna len lde mig mthun rkyen la:med du mi rung smon lam yod mu spyang phyogs nas sde srid re:'dzin du bcug dgos rten 'brel che phyi khyung lding lcags kyi ra ba de:khro zhun gnam lcags thog gis phral phyi skor bzhi brgya bzhi bcu'i skor 'dzad med bgrangs kyis mi dpog pa:gling tsho drug lha sde dkar pos spyod:gser ba'i shog phyug nam mkhar mnyam 'om bu'i re ga dar bar snang gang mu spyang shog rgyas sagazhir khyab:dbul phongs rgud pa re zhig bor:btsan phyug 'phan dar re zhig 'dzoms:kun rdzob bden pa bsgru med yin:nam zhig 'phel 'grib 'byung ba na:don dam stongapa'i rang mdangs yin:nang skor nyis brgya nyi shu yi:dkor nor longs spyod zad med gter dpa' ya med skyes bu mchen brgyad dang :gling bla ma gsum gyi sku skal yin:noral hab thob mi byed par:thugs mthun dam tshig dag pas spyod:rtsod mi dgos dkor 'di phyug dbang gis las brgyags lus po gang skyed yod:sems brgyags sems kha

༄༅// gang bar yod:yul brgyags yul sde gang byed yod:dpa' bo' dpa' dar bstod byed yod:btsan po'i bcan dar phyar rgyu yod:ngar mas ngar skad sgrogathabs yod:che ba mi la ster rgyu yod:brgyags pa rang gis 'chang rgyu yod:snyan pa ma srur bshad rgyu yod:dga' ba pha khur lab rgyu yod:mdzes pa chung gral bkod rgyu yod gling spyi sde 'o brgyal med par brgyags:dpa' sde ya mtshan che bar brgyags:bu 'dzam gling bsam don 'grub nas brgyags:da dkor nor srid la chags rgyu min:dkar po'ichos la 'bad rgyur dgos:rgya li mar chu gzhung mda' stod smad:nang gsang sngags bstan pas skyong rgyu yin:sgom grwa brgya dang brgyad cu dgos:bshad grwa lnga bcu rtsa cig dgos nang don ri la bsgom zhig dgos:'khor 'das ru shan 'byed par dgos:rlung sems rang zhig rang deng dgos:chos brgyad bya ba ro snyoms dgos:lha sde bstan pa'i zhabasatog dgos bla ma rnams kyis chos sgrong dgos:dpon po yongs kyis sgrub grogs dgos:chos bstan gyis sa gzhir khyab pa dgos byin rlabs kyis nam mkha' gang ba

chos bzhin 'grub par 31ga: rgyal khams bkra shis ldan par 31ga: zhes gsungs nas gsung gi sprul pa pa dma 'bum spran 'khyil ba'i zhal bzang 'od du bsdus nas sprul gzhi bee ḍūrya'i sku ri rgyal gso de nas 'dzam gling seng chen rgyal po'i sku shel ra la nyin byed 'bum gyas 'byud pa'i bkrag mdangasa'abar bzhin 'dzam gling tha gru dgo sa pas brdal nasagasung sa dal glu ldem drug lha klu'i 'khri shing la drangs nas lha mdzes sgrol ma dang gling dpa' thul dam pa ma brgyad yang zul sngags kyi dbang phyug gsum phyi sde khri skor rgya mtsho la 'di ltar gsungs so skyod dam chos ma ṇi padme ( bka' yang dag de la gsol ba ma 'gro drug 'khor ba'i gnas stong zhing : gling lha sde'i chos srid rgyas par shog: skyabs baspu med sangs rgyas dkon mchog yin: gsungs nor med lung rtogs dam grogs skyon bral 'phags pa'i dge 'dun sde: deng mchog gsum thugs rjes bzung du gsol: sku dge bcu'i khrims bsrung bla ma yin gsung theg dgu'i bang mdzod

༄༅/ / yi dam lha: thugs bde stong 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro'i sprin deng rtsa ba gsum gyis skyabs mgon mdzod: stod kha che 'dul mdzad sprul pa'i sku smad li mar rgya 'dul longs spyod rdzogs: kong btsan po khrom 'bar chos skus btul: sku gsum rgyal bas byin gyis rlobs: steng nam mkha' yangs pa'i gur khyim nas: 'ja' thig le lnga brtsegs 'od kyi klong : dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor pa: gling lha sde'i mgon gcig khro thung gis: rdzu 'phrul grub rtags bsam yas bstan gnam the'u dkar podam la btags sprul pa brgya dang nyi shu po: skyes mchog rdo rje legs pa rtsal seng zhon brgya dang nyi shu yis: bran du bkod nas bstan pa gtad: da chos bstan 'dzugs la bar chad med: stod kha che'i rgyal po'i mnga' 'og kun: 'dul ba'i bstan pas bskyong rgyu la: mkhan po kun dga' 'od gsal yin: thugs mthun che rgyud bla ma lngas: dge slong dge tshul dge bsnyen gyi: sdom dang bstan pa dar thabs dgos phal ba dge bcu'i khrims kyis sdom: bar snang yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: gling bla rdo rje drag rgyal gyis che

ba'i dpa' rtags du mar bcas bar the'u khra bo dam la btags: sprul pa brgya dang nyi shu po: skyes mchog rdo rje legs pa yi: sprul pa bya zhon sde tshogs kyis 'khor du bkodanas bstan pa gnyer:chos bstan skyong la bar chad med: de yang sngags pa'i rgyal rtags yin: sa 'og rgya mtsho'i gting rum nas: klu gnas gtod kyi sa mdo na gling bla 'om budar li yis: che rtags rdzu 'phrul bsam yas pas: sa the'u nag po dam la btags: sprul pa brgya dang nyi shu po: skyes mchog rdo rje legs pa yi: sprul pa ra zhon sde tshogs kyis gral du bkod nas srung mar bzhag bstan pa srung ba'i so kha bcol: rgyal bstan spel la bar chad med: de yang sngags pa'i rgyal rtags red srid pa gsum gyi mnga' 'og gi 'gro ba mi rigs pho mo rnams: snang ba dbang bsgyur chos lam gzud: las bzhi'i phrin las thabs mang pos gang 'dul mdzad pa bsam mtha' yas: gling ge sar skyes bu'i thugs bzhed ltar: sngags kyi dngos grub mchog thob pa gling bla rdo rje drag rgyal dang :'om bu dar lu rnam gnyis kyis: 'gro la bde skyid spel bar mdzod: dam chos nyi ma shar

༄༅/ / shar gyis:gegs bdud bar chad med pa ni:mgon khro thung rgyal po'i sku drin yin:sngags pa'i che rtags dgung la mnyam:mdzad phrin dpal gyis gling sdeskyid:bka' drin gso phyir phyag rgya phul:bzhugs pa rgya nag yul du bzhugs:pho brang shel mkhar lnga ldan nang :chos bde stong 'od gsal ting 'dzan bsgom:sgom grwa sgrub grwabashad grwa ni:phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kun tu spel:rgya li mar zhing sa chen po na:padma dung can glang po dang :ri dwags ri mo can gyi rigs:bsam dang grangs las 'das payod:sngags dbang phyug khyed kyi gdul bya ste:bde stong bsgom pa'i grogs su phul:ma smin pa la gcig ma lus mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro'i gling dbus 'khod:dpal bdemachog byon dang khyad med pa'i:a nu'i bstan pa rgyas par mdzod:stod smad bar gyi rgyal khab gsum:ra ba'i rdzong brgyad dmag sde yi:spyi dpon 'dzam gling nga nyid yin sgosadapon dpa' thul mched brgyad yin:sngags ston khro thung rgyal po yin dge ston kun dga' 'od gsal yin:bstan skyong kong za lha mdzes yin:rgyal khab gsum gyi dmangs

sde yi gtam ci gsungs kong za'i ngag la nyon: las ci mdzad kong za'i spyod par ltos khrims ci bsdams kong za'i bka' ltar sdoms 'di rang srid skyong ba'i dpon mo red chos srid 'dzin pa'i lha mo red gling la lhag bsam dkar mi red: bsam pa chos la dkar mi red: nang don bde stong bsgom mi red: sgyu lus 'od gsal grub mi red legs nyes thugs la bkod mi red: bden rdzun shan drangs 'byed mi red: thub bstan 'degs pa'i sa gzhi red: sngags bstan skyong pa'i sgron me red: 'dzam gling skyes bu'i ja ma red gling phu nu'i mthun kha bsgrigs mi red:a khu mngon par bstod mi red dbyangs can lha mo'i 'dzum zhal red:'brel tshad rig 'dzin bsgod mi red: ra ba'i rdzong khag brgyad po yi: lde mig phyag la bsnams mi red: mdzod bdag 'dzam gling skyes bu red: mkho dgos che ba'i dus skabs su phu nu rnams la sprod mi red:ngo nye ring phyogs ris med pa red:rgyud mig ser khong khro med pa red: sman la ngo bstod ma yin dang : lha btsun kho mo'i khyad chos red: kong the'u rgyal po' rgyal khab la: bla rdzogs thugs gsum la

༄༅// brten nas:bsgom grwa sgrub grwa bshad grwa dgos:skye bo mchog dman thams cad nas chos 'don yig rtsis dge slob dgos sdig pa'i las la 'dzem bag dgos rtse 'dzin skyes bu nga yis byed:sems 'od gsal lta ba'i rdzong chen 'dzin:phyogs ris bral ba'i rig pa bsgom:gnyis 'dzin 'phrang brgal gnyis med rtogs:'khor 'das gnyis kyi gsang srog 'dren:spyod pas 'phrog lugs bzhi ldan bslabs:bla ma sangs rgyas yon tan sgrogs:gdam ngag bdud rtsi'i che ba bstod:bshad sgrub nyi zla'i sgron me sbar:da lo'i bskal pa 'di tsho nas:bstan pa'i gnas tshad ma rdzogs bar:rgyal khag gsum gyi mi rigs rnams las ngan ma yin las can red:dam pa chos kyi gdul byar 'dul:'brel tshad rnga yab dpal rir 'god:khyed 'dir tshogs thams cad thal mo spyor sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba thobs:yang dgos ra ba brgyad kyi dmag:dkar po'i chos la dad pa bskyed:nag po'i las la bshags sbrangs mdzod:bon gyi bstan pa basnrabs pa yin g.yag lug gson ma gsod rgyu min:sha khrag mchod pa byed rgyu

min:mu stegs lta ba gzhom pa yin:rtag chad gnyis kyi khyu nas bud chos nyid spros mtha' bral ba'i don 'od gsal phyogs ris bral bar sgoms:las ngan bag chags 'khrul rgyun gcod:'dren pa'i ded dpon nga nyid yin:'gro sa rnga yab dpal ri yin:lam sna dpa' bo mkha' 'gros 'dren 'jigs rung srin po'i sa 'phrang brgal sgrag mi dgos yi dam lhag lha yin:lha o rgyan padma'i thugs bskyed bzhin:chu mo sbrul lo'i sa ga zla'i:tshes nya gang nas de ring gnam gang bar:phyi'i sgo srung gnyis po tshar bcad byas rgya khrom pa spyang thul rang dbang bsgyur:nang ra ba'i rdzong khag brgyad po yang :dpa' ya med dpa' thul mched brgyad kyis:kong the'u wa thul mched brgyad btul gtso bo rnams ni tshar bcad byas:dmangs rnams gling sde'i gral du bkod:gsang ba rgyal khab chen po gsum:sku ya seng 'phrul gyi lde mig dang :ma seng nor bu dgra 'dul dang :bar seng bsam pa'i don 'grub kyis:bdud dpung cham la phab nas yod:dgra dpung ming med brlags nas yod:chos srid mnga' dbang bsgyur nas yod:mdzad pa sa gang gnam gang

༄༅/ / byas: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i che ba bstod: dkon mchog gsum gyi rgyal kha blangs: dam can srung ma'i dpa' rnga brdungs nag po'i sprin rgya phyogs su 'thor dkar po'i nyi zla gza' skar bkra: 'ja' tshon 'od kyi dar thag sbrel: zag med bdud rtsi yul la 'gyed: lcags khams thams cad gser du bsgyur gser zhing yid bzhin nor bus spras gsol btab dgos 'dod yid bzhin 'grub kong the'u rgyal ba bee ḍūr rgyal: thugs kyi gdul byar 'gyur bar shog: kha che rgyal ba dung ltar rgyal: sku yi gdulabyar 'gyur bar re ga: rgya li mar rgyal ba byu ru'i rgyal: gsung gi gdul byar 'gyur bar re ga sku mi g.yo ri rgyal lhun po la: rnam rgyal rgyal mtshan 'dzugs par re ga gsung mi 'gags nyi zla'i sgon me la: shes rab rang byung 'bar bar shog: thugs mi nub chos sku'i mchod sdo las: gzugs sku'i phrin las 'gyed par shog: rgyal khab mtha' dbusabade smid lngan: ging chos sde smong ba'i bsashis shog: lha'i me tog char du bsnyil bar shog kla'i dga' ston nor bu spangs par shog: ging bzhi'i lngad mo byed par shog: mthong

thos gdul byar 'gyur bar shog: snang ba dbang du 'du bar shog: bsam pa chos la 'khor bar shog: 'di snang zhen pa chod par shog: dag pa'i zhing khams sbyangs par shog smon pa'i re 'bras 'grub par 31ga: bde skyid phun sum tshogs par 31ga: ces pa'i rdo rje'i gsungs 'gyur ba med pa' tha tshag smon lam dang bcas pa gnang tshe gling sde'i rgan pa rnams kyas mchi ma 'thor stag shar thams cad thal mo sbyar dpa' bo thams cad 'dzum zhing spro me tog lha mdzes kyis phyag mchod phul khri skor rgya mtshos bstod bsngags 'ur ra ba'i las dmag thams cad yid ches blo thub ngo mtshar chen po dang ldan pa'ibashagasasbyangs rgya cher phul la smre sngags kyi gsol ba btab la thugs yid gcag 'dres byung ngo de nas kong za me tog lha mdzes des stod kha che' rgyal khab la 'dul ba'i bstan pa btsugs pa'i gtsug lag khang nang rten 'bur blugasabris grub kya rten mang po dang gsungs bka' bstan bcos glegs bam brag ra brtsegs pa ltar gdan drangs gling bla kun dga' 'od gsal che rgyud dge slong mi lnga sogs dge 'dun gyi sde bsam mi khyab pa la gsol chas yo byad phunasum tshogs par bsgrigs pa 'i bsod nams byas so rgya li mar chu yi phu mda' gzhus gsum la gtsug lag khang brgya dang brgyad cu sku gsung thugs rten bshad sgrub sgom grwa dang bcasapa'i sta gon chas bsgrigs legs par 'dzoms su

༄byukhya bcug sngags mkhan khro thung rgyal po' dbang phyug mi gsum rnga shon seng shon 'bag shon brgya phrag re dang gzhen du gar pa ging bud med sgra yi rgya mdud can brgya phrag re res rnga gdugs rol mos bsu ba byas te pho brang shel mkhar lnga brtsegs kyi nang du gdan 'dren mdzad de 'od stong a nu yo ga'i bstan pa 'dzin srung spel gsum mdzad gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bshad grwa sgom grwa thams cad legs 'dzoms bcug skye bo phal ba dag gisakyang chosa'abri chosa'adon chos klog chos bshad dgos pa'i bka' khrims bsdams kong the'u rgyal khab tu bla rdzogs thugs gsum rgya bstan pa'i sgron me sbar mdo'i bshad grwa dang sngags kyi sgrub grwa btsugs dge bcu'i khrims bsrungasaskye bo mchog dman thams cad dam pa'i chos kyi mnga' dbang bsdus nas sems can gyi blo kha dge ba'i phyogs su ma bsgyur ba gcag kyang med par byas gling che 'bring chung gsum gyi las dmag thams cad dga' ston gyis tshim noralongs spyod kyis mgu brgyan cha yo byad du mas phyug par byas nas ra yul gling chos srid dar ba'i yul du phebs sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gzhi bzung sems can la bde zhi skyid pa' bsod nams spel de rjes dpa' thul dam pa mched brgyad dang sku rje seng chen rgyal po dpon blon thams cad gsang ba gzi yi gzhal med khang mdzes pa'i nang ran chen sna bdun gyi khri za 'og dgu brtsegs kya khar skyes bu don 'grub bzhugs dar 'bol lnga brtsegs kyi khar skyes bu

dgra bla'i stag mo mched dgu bzhugs pa ra byas kong za me tog lha mdzes sgrol ma des rgya ja dang 'bras chang dra sa so rgya dar laji dgu bsgrigs re re dang gser bye ka to ra gang re phul 'dzam gling skyes bu don 'grub la rin chen sna tshogs stag gzig pags pa nor sna brgya 'bul byas nas bkra shis pa 'a chos glu ring mo 'di ltar blangs so glu a la rje btsun sgrol ma mchod: ma tha la ngag dbang dbyangs can mchod: gnas bde chen 'khor ba'i rgyan du bzhugs skad cig 'bral med byin gyis rlobs: de ring kho mo' glu sna drongs 'dzam gling skyes bu don 'grub dang: yang thul dam pa bu dgu gson: zhu dar btsugs nas zhu ba phul: zhu rten bkod nas dpa' dar btsugs: skye ba 'di yi snga thog la: rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing khams su tse rgyan padma'i spyan snga ru bdag cag smon lam gcig pa thebs gangs can bstan pa'i srung mar mngag: rdzong nyi shu rtsa lnga phab phyir springs: dam tshig smon lam mthu btsan pas: deng gi dus 'dir lhun byis grub kha che'i rgyal po lcags rna can bdud mi tri dmar po'i skye ba red: de 'dul ba'i dpa' rtags ngo so mtho: rgya li mar dpa' bo stag tsha de: bdud ha tri ya ma'i sprul pa red: de 'dul ba'i

༄༅/ / dpa' rtags ngo so mtho: kong the'u yab rgyal btsan khrom 'bar bdud ha shing ka ra'i skye ba red: de 'dul ba'i dpa' rtags ngo so mtho: rdzong ra ba'i dmagasde brgyad po yi: rtse 'dzin wa thul mched brgyad ni: gnod sbyin gdug pa spun brgyad yin: de 'dul ba'i dpa' rtags ngo so mtho nam mkha' bar snang sa 'og gi: the'u rangargyal po dam sri gsum: srid pa chags pa'i dus nas yod: 'dul mdzad dpa' bo su ma byung: de btul ba'i dpa' rtags ngo so mtho: gshin bon las skyes bdud rigs stong smon log ha la nag po can gtso bo gyad po wa thul dang: has tir rnams kyis brdzu ru zhugs: mthong rigs thams cad gsod par byed: bsad tshad dmyal ba'i gnas su'aphen: de ngan sngags dpa' bas mi 'dul yang: las smon lam phun sum tshogs pa yis: bsgral 'dren dpa' rtags ngo so mtho: mdzad pa de dag bka' drin che: yang cig snyanapa'i zhu mchod 'bul: shar dung brag nor bu'i rdzong chen gyi: lde mig dung za dngul lhas 'dzin: lha sras phyag nas nga la 'phrod: rin chen mdzod sgo de ring 'byed bkra shis skyid

pa de ring legs:'di la re mig dgu brgya yod:dngul gzhong shel gyi nor bus bltams:gser gzhong rin chen nor bus bltams:zangs gzhong bsam 'phel nor bus bltams:g.yu gzhong pha rol dpung 'joms bltams:bee ḍūr padma rā ga dang mchong dang shel gyi gzhong pa rnams:nor bu ya mtshan can gyis phyur:kun gyi dbus rdzong rin chen mdzod:dgos 'dod kun 'byung rin po che lha klu mi yi bsod nams rten:de 'dzam gling skyes bur mchod pa 'bul:gzhan pa dpa' thul sku skal red:rang rang so sos ngo len mdzod:re zhig sgrom mdzod 'di ru zhog:dgos pa che tshe nga yis sprad:srung ma'i las dmag rang 'khor yin:yang lho brag byu ru dar rdzong gi:lde mig g.yu za lha dgas bsgoms:'dan sras nor bus nga la 'phrod:de ring mdzod kyi gter sgo 'byed:bkra shis skyid pa'i nyi ma gang:'di la re mag dgu skor yod:shar na rgya dar shel gyi mdzod:lto na 'jang dar gser gyi mdzod:nub na mon dar byu ru'i mdzod byang na hor dar gzi yi mdzod:shar lho li dar ja yi mdzod:lto nub stag dar rdo yi mdzod:nub byang dmu

༄༅/ / dar pha lam mdzod:byang shar chos dar khrab kyi mdzod:dbus su rgya gar rgya nag dang phyogs mtshams za 'og sna dgu dang:che dgu gnyan bcu'i yo byad yod:de 'dzam gling skyes bu'i sku skal red:gzhan dpa' thul brgyad kyi sku skal yin:mdzod 'di ga'i nang rten tshul du zhog:dgos pa byung tshe nga yis sprad:bsam don thamasacad 'grub pa yin:nub zangs sgo'i go khrab mtshon rdzong gi lde mig zangs za sgron mes 'dzin:de shan pa'i lag nas nga la 'phrod:rin chen mdzod sgo de ring 'byed:bkra shisadapa' rtags de ring bstod:'di la re mig dgu skor yod:shar rdzong dkar po lcags kyi mdzod lho rdzong se rung lcags kyi mdzod nub rdzong zangs lcags 'dres pa'i mdzod byang rdzong gnam lcags 'dres ma'i mdzod:shar lho pha lam rigs kyi mdzod:lho nub sra brtan rdo yi mdzod:nub byang ngan sngags las grub mdzod:byang shar the'u rang mgarasgrub mdzod:dbus su khrab sna mtshon sna stong:'gran gyi ya med dpa' bo'i gos:skyes bu mthu rtsal can gyi chas:'dzam gling skyes bu'i sku skal yin:gzhan dpa' thul brgyad kyi
